source.text: Ἐπειδήπερ πολλοὶ ἐπεχείρησαν ἀνατάξασθαι διήγησιν περὶ τῶν πεπληροφορημένων ἐν ἡμῖν πραγμάτων, καθὼς παρέδοσαν ἡμῖν οἱ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς αὐτόπται καὶ ὑπηρέται γενόμενοι τοῦ λόγου, ἔδοξε κἀμοὶ παρηκολουθηκότι ἄνωθεν πᾶσιν ἀκριβῶς καθεξῆς σοι γράψαι, κράτιστε Θεόφιλε, ἵνα ἐπιγνῷς περὶ ὧν κατηχήθης λόγων τὴν ἀσφάλειαν.

records.literal_gloss: Inasmuch as many have undertaken to draw up a narrative concerning the having been fully accomplished among us matters, \v 2 as delivered to us the [ones] from beginning eyewitnesses and servants having become of the word, \v 3 it seemed good also to me, having followed from the first all things accurately, in order to you to write, most excellent Theophilus, \v 4 so that you may know concerning which you were instructed words the certainty.

en.L: Since many have undertaken to compile a narrative about the matters that have been brought to completion among us, \v 2 just as those who from [the] beginning were eyewitnesses and became servants of the word handed [them] down to us, \v 3 it seemed good to me also, having followed all things accurately from the start, to write [them] in order for you, most excellent Theophilus, \v 4 so that you may know the certainty concerning the words in which you were instructed.
en.B: Many people have set their hands to putting together an account of the events that have been brought to completion among us. \v 2 They wrote them down as they were passed on to us by those who saw them from the beginning and became servants of the word. \v 3 So I too, having followed the whole course of things closely from the start, decided to write them out for you in order, most excellent Theophilus, \v 4 so that you can be sure of the things you were taught.
en.R: Dear Theophilus: Many people have tried to write down the story of the things that have happened among us. \v 2 They wrote what was told to us by people who saw these things from the beginning and who then served by spreading the message. \v 3 I have looked carefully into all of it from the very start. So I decided that I too should write it all down for you in a clear order, \v 4 so that you can know that what you were taught is true.

es.L: Ya que muchos han emprendido componer un relato acerca de los hechos que han llegado a su pleno cumplimiento entre nosotros, \v 2 tal como nos [los] transmitieron los que desde [el] principio fueron testigos oculares y llegaron a ser servidores de la palabra, \v 3 me pareció bien también a mí, habiendo seguido todo con exactitud desde el comienzo, escribir[lo] para ti de manera ordenada, excelentísimo Teófilo, \v 4 para que conozcas la certeza acerca de las palabras en que fuiste instruido.
es.B: Muchos se han puesto a redactar un relato de los hechos que se han cumplido entre nosotros. \v 2 Los escribieron tal como nos los transmitieron quienes los vieron desde el principio y llegaron a ser servidores de la palabra. \v 3 Por eso también yo, después de seguir de cerca todo el curso de los acontecimientos desde su comienzo, decidí ponerlos por escrito para ti de forma ordenada, excelentísimo Teófilo, \v 4 para que estés seguro de las cosas que se te enseñaron.
es.R: Querido Teófilo: Muchas personas han intentado escribir la historia de lo que ha sucedido entre nosotros. \v 2 Escribieron lo que nos contaron quienes vieron estas cosas desde el principio y luego sirvieron dando a conocer el mensaje. \v 3 Yo he investigado todo con cuidado desde el mismo comienzo. Por eso decidí que también yo debía escribírtelo todo en un orden claro, \v 4 para que sepas que lo que te enseñaron es verdad.

fr.L: Puisque beaucoup ont entrepris d’ordonner un récit au sujet des faits pleinement accomplis parmi nous, \v 2 tels que nous [les] ont transmis ceux qui, depuis le commencement, ont été témoins oculaires et sont devenus serviteurs de la parole, \v 3 il m’a paru bon, à moi aussi, qui ai tout suivi avec précision depuis le début, de te [l’]écrire avec ordre, très excellent Théophile, \v 4 pour que tu connaisses la solidité des paroles dont tu as été instruit.
fr.B: Beaucoup de gens ont entrepris de rassembler en un récit les événements qui ont trouvé leur accomplissement parmi nous. \v 2 Ils les ont rapportés tels que nous les ont transmis ceux qui les ont vus depuis le commencement et qui sont devenus serviteurs de la parole. \v 3 C’est pourquoi, moi aussi, après avoir suivi de près tout leur déroulement depuis le début, j’ai décidé de te les écrire dans l’ordre, très honorable Théophile, \v 4 afin que tu puisses être sûr de ce qui t’a été enseigné.
fr.R: Cher Théophile, beaucoup de gens ont essayé d’écrire l’histoire de ce qui s’est passé parmi nous. \v 2 Ils ont écrit ce que nous ont raconté ceux qui ont vu ces choses depuis le début, et qui ont ensuite servi en répandant le message. \v 3 Moi, j’ai tout examiné avec soin, depuis le tout début. Alors j’ai décidé, moi aussi, de tout écrire pour toi dans un ordre clair, \v 4 pour que tu saches que ce qu’on t’a enseigné est vrai.

sw.L: Kwa kuwa wengi wamejaribu kutunga masimulizi kuhusu mambo yaliyofikia utimilifu kati yetu, \v 2 kama walivyotukabidhi wale ambao tangu mwanzo walikuwa mashahidi waliojionea na wakawa watumishi wa neno, \v 3 imeonekana vema kwangu pia, nikiwa nimefuatilia mambo yote kwa usahihi tangu mwanzo, kukuandikia [kwa] mpangilio, Mheshimiwa Theofilo, \v 4 ili upate kujua uhakika wa maneno uliyofundishwa.
sw.B: Watu wengi wamejitahidi kuandaa masimulizi ya matukio yaliyokamilika kati yetu. \v 2 Waliyaandika kama yalivyotufikia kutoka kwa wale walioyaona tangu mwanzo na wakawa watumishi wa neno. \v 3 Kwa hiyo mimi pia, nikiwa nimefuatilia kwa makini mwenendo wote wa mambo tangu mwanzo, niliamua kukuandikia kwa mpangilio, Mheshimiwa Theofilo, \v 4 ili uwe na hakika juu ya mambo uliyofundishwa.
sw.R: Mpendwa Theofilo: Watu wengi wamejaribu kuandika habari za mambo yaliyotokea kati yetu. \v 2 Waliandika yale tuliyoambiwa na watu walioyaona mambo hayo tangu mwanzo, ambao baadaye walitumika kwa kueneza ujumbe. \v 3 Nimechunguza kila kitu kwa uangalifu tangu mwanzo kabisa. Kwa hiyo niliamua kwamba mimi pia nikuandikie yote kwa mpangilio ulio wazi, \v 4 ili ujue kwamba yale uliyofundishwa ni kweli.

ko.L: 많은 사람이 우리 가운데서 완전히 이루어진 일들에 관한 이야기를 엮어 보려고 손을 대었습니다. \v 2 처음부터 목격자였고 말씀의 일꾼이 된 사람들이 우리에게 전해 준 그대로입니다. \v 3 저도 모든 일을 처음부터 정확하게 살펴 왔으므로, 존귀하신 데오빌로 각하, 각하께 순서대로 정리하여 써 드리는 것이 좋겠다고 여겼습니다. \v 4 각하께서 배우신 말씀들에 관하여 그 확실함을 아시게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 많은 사람이 우리 가운데서 이루어진 일들을 이야기로 엮어 보려고 애써 왔습니다. \v 2 그들은 처음부터 이 일들을 직접 보았고 말씀을 전하는 일꾼이 된 사람들이 우리에게 전해 준 대로 기록했습니다. \v 3 저 역시 이 모든 일을 처음부터 자세히 살펴 왔기에, 데오빌로 각하, 각하께 이 일들을 순서대로 정리하여 써 드리기로 하였습니다. \v 4 각하께서 배우신 것들이 틀림없다는 것을 확실히 아시게 해 드리려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 데오빌로 각하께 드립니다. 많은 사람이 우리 가운데서 일어난 일들을 글로 써 보려고 했습니다. \v 2 그들은 처음부터 이 일들을 자기 눈으로 보고, 그 뒤에 이 소식을 전하는 일을 맡은 사람들이 우리에게 알려 준 대로 썼습니다. \v 3 저도 이 모든 일을 처음부터 꼼꼼히 알아보았습니다. 그래서 저도 각하께 이 모든 일을 알기 쉬운 순서로 써 드리기로 했습니다. \v 4 각하께서 배우신 것이 참으로 사실이라는 것을 아시게 하려는 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì nhiều người đã ra tay biên soạn một bản tường thuật về những việc đã được hoàn tất giữa chúng ta, \v 2 đúng như những người từ ban đầu đã là nhân chứng tận mắt và đã trở nên người phục vụ lời [ấy] truyền lại cho chúng ta, \v 3 thì tôi cũng thấy nên, sau khi đã theo dõi kỹ càng mọi việc từ đầu, viết [lại] theo thứ tự cho ngài, thưa ngài Thê-ô-phi-lơ rất tôn quý, \v 4 để ngài biết sự chắc chắn của những lời ngài đã được dạy dỗ.
vi.B: Nhiều người đã bắt tay biên soạn một bản tường thuật về những việc đã được hoàn tất giữa chúng ta. \v 2 Họ viết đúng như điều đã được truyền lại cho chúng ta bởi những người đã tận mắt chứng kiến từ ban đầu và đã trở thành người phục vụ lời ấy. \v 3 Vì vậy, sau khi đã cẩn thận tìm hiểu mọi việc từ đầu, tôi cũng quyết định viết lại cho ngài theo thứ tự, thưa ngài Thê-ô-phi-lơ khả kính, \v 4 để ngài biết chắc những điều ngài đã được dạy là vững vàng.
vi.R: Kính gửi ngài Thê-ô-phi-lơ: Nhiều người đã cố gắng viết lại câu chuyện về những việc đã xảy ra giữa chúng ta. \v 2 Họ viết theo những gì đã được kể lại cho chúng ta bởi những người đã tận mắt thấy các việc ấy từ lúc đầu, rồi sau đó đi rao truyền sứ điệp. \v 3 Tôi đã tìm hiểu kỹ mọi việc ngay từ đầu. Vì vậy, tôi quyết định chính tôi cũng viết lại mọi điều cho ngài theo một thứ tự rõ ràng, \v 4 để ngài biết chắc rằng những điều ngài đã được dạy là thật.

decisions.choice: one long sentence: a formal preface in the style of Greek historians
decisions.reason: Verses 1-4 are a single carefully built Greek sentence, the most polished in the New Testament. Writers of history began this way: they named earlier works, their sources, their own method and their reader. From 1:5 on Luke changes style and tells the story in the plain manner of the Greek Old Testament.

decisions.choice: brought to completion: events that have run their full course, and that God has brought to fulfillment
decisions.reason: The verb can mean "fully convinced" (Romans 4:21) or "fulfilled, carried out fully". With "matters" or "events" it means things that have taken place in full. Luke goes on to tell the story as the fulfillment of what God promised (1:20, 45; 24:44).

decisions.choice: eyewitnesses and servants of the word: one group, who saw the events and then served by preaching them
alternatives: two groups, eyewitnesses and later preachers
decisions.reason: One article governs both nouns, so the same people are meant. "The word" is the message about Jesus, as in Acts 6:4 and 8:4. Luke does not claim to be one of them; he received what they handed down.

decisions.choice: having followed from the start: having traced the events carefully from their beginning
decisions.reason: The adverb can mean "from above" (John 3:3) but here it means "from the first", matching "from the beginning" in 1:2. Luke has kept close track of the events, as a careful historian does.

decisions.choice: in order: an orderly, well-arranged account
decisions.reason: The word means in sequence or in order. Luke does not say the order is always the order of time; he means a connected, well-arranged account.

decisions.choice: most excellent Theophilus: a real person, addressed with a title of rank
alternatives: any lover of God, as the name means
decisions.reason: The name means "friend of God", but "most excellent" was a title for men of high rank, such as the Roman governors Felix and Festus (Acts 23:26; 26:25). Luke dedicates Acts to him too (Acts 1:1).

decisions.choice: instructed ... certainty: what Theophilus has been taught, and how firmly it stands
decisions.reason: The verb is used of teaching about the faith (Acts 18:25; Galatians 6:6). The last word of the sentence is "certainty", the reliability of what he was taught: Luke's whole purpose.

decisions.choice: Dear Theophilus (at the start)
decisions.reason: Readable splits the long sentence and names the reader at the start, as a modern letter does.

decisions.choice: the things you were taught (B); what you were taught (R)
alternatives: the words in which you were instructed
decisions.reason: "Words" here means the matters taught, not single words.

decisions.choice: excelentísimo Teófilo (L, B); Querido Teófilo (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek is a courtesy title for a man of rank (meaning decision m6). "Excelentísimo" is still the Spanish form of that title; Readable opens like a letter, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: servidores de la palabra
decisions.reason: "Ministros" now sounds like a church or government office. "Servidores" says what meaning decision m3 describes: people who served by passing on the message.

decisions.choice: très excellent Théophile (L); très honorable Théophile (B); Cher Théophile (R)
decisions.reason: The title marks a man of rank (m6). Literal keeps the superlative of the Greek. In French today "excellent" mostly praises quality ("un excellent repas"), so Balanced uses "très honorable", the French form for addressing a person of standing. Readable names him at the start, as a letter does, following the English.

decisions.choice: passé composé at every level in the preface ("ont entrepris", "il m’a paru bon", "j’ai décidé")
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: In 1:1-4 Luke speaks in his own voice to Theophilus about what others and he himself have done, so French uses the tense of speech, as in a letter. The story that begins in 1:5 takes the narrative tenses (see 1:5).

decisions.choice: Mheshimiwa Theofilo (L, B); Mpendwa Theofilo (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek is a courtesy title for a man of rank (meaning decision m6). "Mheshimiwa" is the Swahili title of respect for a person in office; "mtukufu" (glorious, exalted) is used for God and royalty. Readable opens like a letter, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the preface in 합쇼체, with Luke as "저" and Theophilus as "각하" ("존귀하신 데오빌로 각하" at Literal); the story from 1:5 in the plain written style
decisions.reason: The preface is a letter to a man of rank (meaning decision), so Korean writes it in the formal polite style and replaces "you" with the title "각하", the courtesy used for a high official; Korean does not call such a person "당신". From 1:5 the narrative uses the plain written style of the rest of the Gospel (style guide, section 4).

decisions.choice: Theophilus is addressed as "ngài" with a title: "thưa ngài Thê-ô-phi-lơ rất tôn quý" (L), "thưa ngài Thê-ô-phi-lơ khả kính" (B), "Kính gửi ngài Thê-ô-phi-lơ" at the start (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says he is a real person addressed with a title of rank. "ngài" is the respectful Vietnamese "you" for such a person and is kept through the preface; lowercase, it is a human honorific and takes no deity_pronoun span. Readable opens like a Vietnamese letter, as the English Readable says "Dear Theophilus".

decisions.choice: "lời" lowercase for "the word" the eyewitnesses served, with "[ấy]" (L) and "ấy" (B)
decisions.reason: Here "the word" is the message about Jesus that was preached, not the personal Word of John 1:1 ("Ngôi Lời"), so it is lowercase. Readable says "sứ điệp", as the English Readable says "the message".

source.text: Ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου βασιλέως τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἱερεύς τις ὀνόματι Ζαχαρίας ἐξ ἐφημερίας Ἀβιά, καὶ γυνὴ αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Ἀαρών, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Ἐλισάβετ.

records.literal_gloss: There was in the days of Herod king of the Judea a priest certain by name Zechariah of [the] division of Abijah, and wife to him of the daughters of Aaron, and the name of her Elizabeth.

en.L: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a certain priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah, and he had a wife from the daughters of Aaron, and her name [was] Elizabeth.
en.B: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah. His wife was also descended from Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
en.R: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah. He belonged to the group of priests called the division of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth also came from the family of Aaron, the first priest.

es.L: En los días de Herodes, rey de Judea, había cierto sacerdote de nombre Zacarías, del turno de Abías, y [tenía] una esposa de las hijas de Aarón, y el nombre de ella [era] Isabel.
es.B: En tiempos de Herodes, rey de Judea, había un sacerdote llamado Zacarías, que pertenecía al turno sacerdotal de Abías. Su esposa también descendía de Aarón y se llamaba Isabel.
es.R: Cuando Herodes era rey de Judea, había un sacerdote llamado Zacarías. Pertenecía al grupo de sacerdotes llamado el turno de Abías. Su esposa Isabel también era de la familia de Aarón, el primer sacerdote.

fr.L: Il y eut, aux jours d’Hérode, roi de Judée, un certain prêtre du nom de Zacharie, de la classe d’Abia ; et il avait une femme d’entre les filles d’Aaron, et son nom [était] Élisabeth.
fr.B: Au temps d’Hérode, roi de Judée, il y avait un prêtre appelé Zacharie, qui appartenait à la classe sacerdotale d’Abia. Sa femme descendait elle aussi d’Aaron ; elle s’appelait Élisabeth.
fr.R: À l’époque où Hérode était roi de Judée, il y avait un prêtre qui s’appelait Zacharie. Il faisait partie du groupe de prêtres appelé la classe d’Abia. Sa femme, Élisabeth, venait elle aussi de la famille d’Aaron, le premier prêtre.

sw.L: Katika siku za Herode, mfalme wa Yudea, palikuwa na kuhani mmoja aitwaye Zakaria, wa kikundi cha Abiya, naye alikuwa na mke kutoka kwa binti za Haruni, na jina lake [lilikuwa] Elisabeti.
sw.B: Katika siku za Herode, mfalme wa Yudea, palikuwa na kuhani mmoja aitwaye Zakaria, wa kikundi cha makuhani cha Abiya. Mkewe naye alikuwa wa ukoo wa Haruni, na jina lake ni Elisabeti.
sw.R: Herode alipokuwa mfalme wa Yudea, palikuwa na kuhani mmoja aitwaye Zakaria. Alikuwa wa kundi la makuhani lililoitwa kikundi cha Abiya. Mkewe Elisabeti naye alitoka katika ukoo wa Haruni, kuhani wa kwanza.

ko.L: 유대 왕 헤롯의 날들에, 아비야 조 출신으로 이름이 사가랴인 어떤 제사장이 있었다. 그리고 그에게는 아론의 딸들 가운데서 [난] 아내가 있었는데, 그 여자의 이름은 엘리사벳이었다.
ko.B: 유대 왕 헤롯 때에, 아비야 조에 속한 사가랴라는 제사장이 있었다. 그의 아내도 아론의 자손이었는데, 이름은 엘리사벳이었다.
ko.R: 헤롯이 유대의 왕이었을 때에 사가랴라는 제사장이 있었다. 사가랴는 아비야 조라고 불리는 제사장 무리에 속해 있었다. 그의 아내 엘리사벳도 첫 제사장 아론의 집안 출신이었다.

vi.L: Trong những ngày của Hê-rốt, vua xứ Giu-đê, có một thầy tế lễ kia tên là Xa-cha-ri, thuộc ban A-bi-a, và ông có vợ [là một] trong các con gái của A-rôn, và tên bà là Ê-li-sa-bét.
vi.B: Vào thời Hê-rốt làm vua xứ Giu-đê, có một thầy tế lễ tên là Xa-cha-ri, thuộc ban thầy tế lễ A-bi-a. Vợ ông cũng thuộc dòng dõi A-rôn, tên là Ê-li-sa-bét.
vi.R: Khi Hê-rốt làm vua xứ Giu-đê, có một thầy tế lễ tên là Xa-cha-ri. Ông thuộc một nhóm thầy tế lễ gọi là ban A-bi-a. Vợ ông là Ê-li-sa-bét, cũng thuộc dòng họ A-rôn, thầy tế lễ đầu tiên.

decisions.choice: there was: Luke begins his story in the style of the Greek Old Testament
alternatives: a plain past tense with no wider echo
decisions.reason: The opening "It came to pass in the days of ..." is how many Old Testament stories begin (Judges 13:2; 1 Samuel 1:1; Ruth 1:1). After the polished preface, Luke tells the birth stories in the language of Israel's Scriptures.

decisions.choice: Herod, king of Judea: Herod the Great, who ruled the Jewish land under Rome and died in 4 BC
decisions.reason: Rome gave Herod the title "king". Judea here means the whole land of the Jews, not only the southern district (compare 4:44; 23:5).

decisions.choice: the division of Abijah: one of the twenty-four groups of priests that took turns serving in the temple
alternatives: a family or clan name only
decisions.reason: King David divided the priests into twenty-four divisions; Abijah's was the eighth (1 Chronicles 24:10). Each division served in the temple for a week, about twice a year.

decisions.choice: from the daughters of Aaron: Elizabeth was herself of priestly descent
alternatives: a figure of speech for a godly woman
decisions.reason: Aaron was the first high priest, and all priests descended from him. A priest who married within the priestly line was especially honored.

decisions.choice: the first priest
decisions.reason: Readable says who Aaron was.

decisions.choice: Isabel
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of the name. "Elisabet" is closer to the Greek but less familiar to Spanish readers.

decisions.choice: el turno de Abías
decisions.reason: The priests served in the temple by turns (meaning decision m3); "turno" says that plainly, and 1:8 takes up the same word.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R), with the imperfect for background ("il y avait") (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As in John and Mark: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; the passé composé is how French is spoken and how young readers meet stories, so Readable uses it throughout. Speech, including the songs of Mary and Zechariah, keeps the tenses of speech at every level. Luke tells this chapter in past tenses; where he uses a historic present later in the book, Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: la classe d’Abia
decisions.reason: "Classe" is the established French word for the twenty-four rotating groups of priests (m3). Readable adds "le groupe de prêtres" so that the word is understood.

decisions.choice: kikundi cha Abiya
decisions.reason: The priests were divided into groups that took turns in the temple (meaning decision m3). "Kikundi" names the group; "zamu" (turn of duty) is kept for 1:8, where the group is on duty.

decisions.choice: Protestant name forms "사가랴", "엘리사벳", "아비야", "아론", "헤롯"; "아비야 조" for the priestly division
decisions.reason: Names follow the Protestant tradition (style guide, Settled). "반열" is the older church word for the division and is opaque today; "조" (a group taking its turn) says what the division was, and Readable explains it as a group of priests.

decisions.choice: The Protestant forms of the names: "Xa-cha-ri", "A-bi-a", "A-rôn", "Ê-li-sa-bét"; "Hê-rốt" as in Mark
decisions.reason: The style guide settles the Protestant tradition's transliterations for names; these are the forms Protestant readers know from Luke 1. Used through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "thầy tế lễ" for a priest, and "ban" for his division
decisions.reason: "thầy tế lễ" is the Protestant word, used for the chief priests ("các thầy tế lễ cả") too. "ban" names one of the fixed groups of priests; "phiên" (turn) is kept for its turn of duty in 1:8.

source.text: ἦσαν δὲ δίκαιοι ἀμφότεροι ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ, πορευόμενοι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐντολαῖς καὶ δικαιώμασιν τοῦ κυρίου ἄμεμπτοι.

records.literal_gloss: They were and righteous both before the God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

en.L: And they were both righteous before God, walking blameless in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
en.B: Both of them were righteous in God's eyes, and they lived by every commandment and requirement of the Lord with no fault to be found in them.
en.R: Both of them did what was right in God's eyes. They obeyed all the Lord's commands and rules, and no one could find fault with them.

es.L: Y eran justos ambos ante Dios, caminando sin tacha en todos los mandamientos y preceptos del Señor.
es.B: Los dos eran justos a los ojos de Dios, y vivían conforme a todos los mandamientos y requisitos del Señor, sin que se les pudiera reprochar nada.
es.R: Los dos hacían lo que era correcto a los ojos de Dios. Obedecían todos los mandamientos y reglas del Señor, y nadie podía encontrarles ninguna falta.

fr.L: Et ils étaient justes tous les deux devant Dieu, marchant de façon irréprochable dans tous les commandements et ordonnances du Seigneur.
fr.B: Tous deux étaient justes aux yeux de Dieu : ils vivaient selon tous les commandements et toutes les prescriptions du Seigneur, sans qu’on puisse rien leur reprocher.
fr.R: Tous les deux faisaient ce qui est juste aux yeux de Dieu. Ils obéissaient à tous les commandements et à toutes les règles du Seigneur, et personne ne pouvait leur faire de reproche.

sw.L: Nao walikuwa wenye haki wote wawili mbele ya Mungu, wakienenda bila hatia katika amri zote na masharti ya Bwana.
sw.B: Wote wawili walikuwa wenye haki machoni pa Mungu, nao waliishi kwa kufuata kila amri na kila agizo la Bwana bila kosa lolote kuonekana kwao.
sw.R: Wote wawili walifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa Mungu. Walitii amri na kanuni zote za Bwana, na hakuna mtu aliyeweza kuwalaumu kwa jambo lolote.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 둘 다 하나님 앞에서 의로운 사람들이었고, 주님의 모든 계명과 규례 안에서 흠 없이 걸어갔다.
ko.B: 두 사람은 모두 하나님 보시기에 의로운 사람이었다. 그들은 주님의 모든 계명과 규례를 지키며 살았고, 아무도 그들에게서 흠을 찾을 수 없었다.
ko.R: 두 사람은 하나님 보시기에 바르게 사는 사람들이었다. 그들은 주님의 모든 명령과 규칙을 잘 지켰고, 아무도 그들을 나무랄 수 없었다.

vi.L: Và cả hai đều công chính trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, bước đi không chỗ trách được trong mọi điều răn và luật lệ của Chúa.
vi.B: Cả hai ông bà đều là người công chính trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, sống theo mọi điều răn và luật lệ của Chúa, không ai bắt lỗi được.
vi.R: Cả hai ông bà đều sống ngay thẳng trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời. Họ vâng giữ mọi điều răn và luật lệ của Chúa, và không ai chê trách họ được điều gì.

decisions.choice: righteous: living rightly before God, faithful to his law
alternatives: made right with God by faith
decisions.reason: The word describes their way of life, as the rest of the verse explains. It does not mean they never sinned; Zechariah will doubt the angel (1:20). Luke uses the same word for Simeon (2:25) and Joseph of Arimathea (23:50).

decisions.choice: commandments and ordinances: the whole law God gave Israel
alternatives: two different parts of the law
decisions.reason: The two words are paired in the Greek Old Testament for all that God requires (Genesis 26:5; Deuteronomy 4:40).

decisions.choice: blameless: no one could charge them with breaking the law
decisions.reason: The word is used of Job (Job 1:1) and of Paul's past keeping of the law (Philippians 3:6). It speaks of their visible conduct.

decisions.choice: lived by (B); obeyed (R)
decisions.reason: "Walk" is a Hebrew picture for how one lives. Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: did what was right in God's eyes
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word. This is the adjective, not the key term "righteousness", which stays the same at every level.

decisions.choice: justes (L, B); faisaient ce qui est juste (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "juste" and "la justice" for this word family. Readable explains the adjective as the English Readable does, but keeps the word "juste" inside the explanation.

decisions.choice: "계명과 규례" (L, B); "명령과 규칙" (R); "걸어갔다" (L) for the walk of life
decisions.reason: The two words together name the whole law (meaning decision). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of walking for the way one lives; Balanced and Readable say "지키며 살았다", "지켰다".

decisions.choice: "bước đi" for "walking" (L); "sống theo" (B); "vâng giữ" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of walking in the commandments, which Vietnamese Bible readers know; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τέκνον, καθότι ἦν ἡ Ἐλισάβετ στεῖρα, καὶ ἀμφότεροι προβεβηκότες ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ἦσαν.

records.literal_gloss: And not was to them a child, because was the Elizabeth barren, and both advanced in the days of them were.

en.L: And they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and both were advanced in their days.
en.B: But they had no children, because Elizabeth could not conceive, and both of them were getting on in years.
en.R: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was not able to have a baby. And now they were both very old.

es.L: Y no tenían hijo, porque Isabel era estéril, y ambos estaban avanzados en sus días.
es.B: Pero no tenían hijos, porque Isabel no podía concebir, y los dos eran ya mayores.
es.R: Pero no tenían hijos, porque Isabel no podía tener bebés. Y ya los dos eran muy ancianos.

fr.L: Et ils n’avaient pas d’enfant, parce qu’Élisabeth était stérile, et tous deux étaient avancés dans leurs jours.
fr.B: Mais ils n’avaient pas d’enfant, car Élisabeth ne pouvait pas en avoir, et tous deux étaient déjà avancés en âge.
fr.R: Mais ils n’avaient pas d’enfants, parce qu’Élisabeth ne pouvait pas avoir de bébé. Et maintenant, ils étaient tous les deux très âgés.

sw.L: Wala hawakuwa na mtoto, kwa sababu Elisabeti alikuwa tasa, na wote wawili walikuwa wamesonga mbele katika siku zao.
sw.B: Lakini hawakuwa na watoto, kwa sababu Elisabeti hakuweza kushika mimba, na wote wawili walikuwa wamekwisha kuzeeka.
sw.R: Lakini hawakuwa na watoto, kwa sababu Elisabeti hakuweza kupata mtoto. Tena sasa wote wawili walikuwa wazee sana.

ko.L: 그리고 그들에게는 아이가 없었다. 엘리사벳이 아이를 낳지 못하는 사람이었기 때문이다. 그리고 두 사람 다 그들의 날들이 많이 흘러 [나이가 많았다].
ko.B: 그러나 그들에게는 자녀가 없었다. 엘리사벳이 임신하지 못했기 때문이다. 게다가 두 사람 다 나이가 많았다.
ko.R: 그런데 그들에게는 아이가 없었다. 엘리사벳이 아기를 가질 수 없었기 때문이다. 이제 두 사람은 아주 늙었다.

vi.L: Và họ không có con, vì Ê-li-sa-bét son sẻ, và cả hai đều đã cao tuổi.
vi.B: Nhưng họ không có con, vì Ê-li-sa-bét không thể thụ thai, và cả hai ông bà đều đã cao tuổi.
vi.R: Nhưng họ không có con, vì Ê-li-sa-bét không sinh con được. Bây giờ cả hai đều đã già lắm rồi.

decisions.choice: a childless couple, old and righteous: the pattern of Sarah, Rebekah, Rachel and Hannah
decisions.reason: Israel's Scriptures tell of barren women to whom God gave a son: Sarah (Genesis 18:11), Rebekah (25:21), Rachel (30:22-23), Samson's mother (Judges 13:2) and Hannah (1 Samuel 1:2). Luke's readers would expect God to act.

decisions.choice: barren: unable to bear children; in that culture often seen as a shame
alternatives: a judgment of God on her
decisions.reason: Childlessness was a deep sorrow and could be taken as a mark of disgrace (1:25). Luke has just said both were righteous, so it is not a punishment.

decisions.choice: advanced in their days: old
alternatives: in the later part of the day
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of saying someone is old, used of Abraham and Sarah (Genesis 18:11).

decisions.choice: "그들의 날들이 많이 흘러 [나이가 많았다]" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean cannot say "advanced in their days" as it stands; Literal keeps the days and brackets the plain Korean idiom it means (meaning decision). Balanced and Readable say only "나이가 많았다", "늙었다".

decisions.choice: "đã cao tuổi" for "advanced in their days" (L, B)
alternatives: "đã cao niên trong những ngày của mình"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no natural way to say "advanced in days" word for word; "cao tuổi" (high in years) keeps the picture of advancing in age, which the meaning decision says means old.

source.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἱερατεύειν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ τάξει τῆς ἐφημερίας αὐτοῦ ἔναντι τοῦ θεοῦ κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἱερατείας ἔλαχε τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ κυρίου, καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ἦν τοῦ λαοῦ προσευχόμενον ἔξω τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ θυμιάματος·

records.literal_gloss: It came to pass then in the serving as priest him in the order of the division of him before the God, \v 9 according to the custom of the priesthood it fell by lot to him to burn incense having entered into the temple of the Lord, \v 10 and all the multitude was of the people praying outside at the hour of the incense;

en.L: And it happened, while he was serving as priest before God in the order of his division, \v 9 according to the custom of the priesthood, it fell to him by lot to burn incense, having entered into the temple of the Lord. \v 10 And the whole multitude of the people was praying outside at the hour of the incense.
en.B: Once, when Zechariah's division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God, \v 9 he was chosen by lot, as the custom of the priesthood was, to go into the sanctuary of the Lord and burn incense. \v 10 At the hour of the incense offering, the whole crowd of people was praying outside.
en.R: One time Zechariah's group was on duty at the temple, and he was serving God there as a priest. \v 9 The priests always chose by lot who would go into the holy place of the Lord's temple to burn incense. This time Zechariah was chosen. \v 10 While the incense was being offered, a large crowd of people was outside, praying.

es.L: Y sucedió que, mientras él servía como sacerdote delante de Dios en el orden de su turno, \v 9 según la costumbre del sacerdocio, le correspondió por sorteo quemar incienso, habiendo entrado en el templo del Señor. \v 10 Y toda la muchedumbre del pueblo oraba afuera a la hora del incienso.
es.B: Una vez, cuando le tocaba servir al turno de Zacarías y él ejercía como sacerdote delante de Dios, \v 9 fue elegido por sorteo, según la costumbre del sacerdocio, para entrar en el santuario del Señor y quemar incienso. \v 10 A la hora de la ofrenda del incienso, toda la multitud del pueblo estaba afuera orando.
es.R: Una vez le tocó al grupo de Zacarías servir en el templo, y él servía allí a Dios como sacerdote. \v 9 Los sacerdotes siempre echaban suertes para elegir quién entraría en el lugar santo del templo del Señor a quemar incienso. Esta vez eligieron a Zacarías. \v 10 Mientras se ofrecía el incienso, una gran multitud de gente estaba afuera orando.

fr.L: Or il arriva, tandis qu’il exerçait le sacerdoce devant Dieu au tour de sa classe, \v 9 selon la coutume du sacerdoce, [qu’]il lui échut par le sort de brûler l’encens, après être entré dans le temple du Seigneur. \v 10 Et toute la multitude du peuple était en prière dehors, à l’heure de l’encens.
fr.B: Un jour que la classe de Zacharie était de service et qu’il remplissait ses fonctions de prêtre devant Dieu, \v 9 il fut désigné par tirage au sort, selon la coutume des prêtres, pour entrer dans le temple du Seigneur et y brûler l’encens. \v 10 À l’heure de l’offrande de l’encens, toute la foule du peuple priait dehors.
fr.R: Un jour, c’était au tour du groupe de Zacharie de servir au temple, et il servait Dieu là-bas comme prêtre. \v 9 Les prêtres tiraient toujours au sort celui qui entrerait dans la salle sacrée du temple du Seigneur pour y brûler de l’encens. Cette fois, c’est Zacharie qui a été choisi. \v 10 Pendant qu’on offrait l’encens, une grande foule priait dehors.

sw.L: Ikawa, alipokuwa akihudumu kama kuhani mbele ya Mungu katika mpangilio wa zamu ya kikundi chake, \v 9 kufuatana na desturi ya ukuhani, alichaguliwa kwa kura kufukiza uvumba, akiwa ameingia ndani ya hekalu la Bwana. \v 10 Na wingi wote wa watu ulikuwa ukiomba nje saa ya uvumba.
sw.B: Siku moja, kikundi cha Zakaria kilipokuwa zamuni, naye akihudumu kama kuhani mbele ya Mungu, \v 9 alichaguliwa kwa kura, kama ilivyokuwa desturi ya ukuhani, aingie patakatifu pa Bwana na kufukiza uvumba. \v 10 Wakati wa sadaka ya uvumba, umati wote wa watu ulikuwa ukiomba nje.
sw.R: Wakati mmoja kikundi cha Zakaria kilikuwa zamuni hekaluni, naye alikuwa akimtumikia Mungu huko kama kuhani. \v 9 Makuhani walikuwa wakipiga kura kila mara kuchagua nani angeingia mahali patakatifu pa hekalu la Bwana ili kufukiza uvumba. Safari hii Zakaria ndiye aliyechaguliwa. \v 10 Uvumba ulipokuwa ukitolewa, umati mkubwa wa watu ulikuwa nje ukiomba.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 그가 자기 조의 차례에 따라 하나님 앞에서 제사장 직무를 하고 있을 때, \v 9 제사장 직분의 관례대로 제비를 뽑았는데, 그가 주님의 성전에 들어가 향을 피우게 되었다. \v 10 그리고 향을 피우는 시간에 백성의 온 무리가 밖에서 기도하고 있었다.
ko.B: 한번은 사가랴의 조가 일할 차례가 되어, 그가 하나님 앞에서 제사장 직무를 하고 있었다. \v 9 그때 제사장들의 관례에 따라 제비를 뽑았는데, 그가 주님의 성소에 들어가 향을 피우는 일을 맡게 되었다. \v 10 향을 피우는 시간에 많은 백성이 모두 밖에서 기도하고 있었다.
ko.R: 어느 날 사가랴가 속한 제사장 무리가 성전에서 일할 차례가 되었다. 사가랴는 하나님 앞에서 제사장으로 일하고 있었다. \v 9 제사장들은 늘 제비를 뽑아서, 누가 주님의 성전 안 거룩한 곳에 들어가 향을 피울지 정했다. 이번에는 사가랴가 뽑혔다. \v 10 향을 피우는 동안 많은 사람이 밖에서 기도하고 있었다.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi ông đang thi hành chức vụ thầy tế lễ trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời theo phiên của ban mình, \v 9 theo lệ của chức tế lễ, ông bắt thăm được phần vào đền thờ của Chúa để dâng hương. \v 10 Và cả đoàn dân đông đang cầu nguyện bên ngoài vào giờ dâng hương.
vi.B: Một lần, đến phiên ban của Xa-cha-ri, ông đang thi hành chức vụ thầy tế lễ trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời. \v 9 Theo lệ của chức tế lễ, ông được bắt thăm chọn vào nơi thánh của Chúa để dâng hương. \v 10 Vào giờ dâng hương, cả đám đông dân chúng đang cầu nguyện ở bên ngoài.
vi.R: Một lần, đến phiên nhóm của Xa-cha-ri phục vụ trong đền thờ, và ông đang làm thầy tế lễ phụng sự Đức Chúa Trời tại đó. \v 9 Các thầy tế lễ luôn bắt thăm để chọn người vào nơi thánh trong đền thờ của Chúa mà đốt hương. Lần này Xa-cha-ri được chọn. \v 10 Trong lúc dâng hương, có rất đông người ở bên ngoài đang cầu nguyện.

decisions.choice: it fell to him by lot to burn incense: a duty chosen by lot among the many priests, perhaps once in a lifetime
alternatives: a regular duty that came to him often
decisions.reason: There were many priests, and lots decided who would offer the incense on the golden altar inside the sanctuary (Exodus 30:7-8). Later Jewish tradition (the Mishnah, tractate Tamid) says a priest could do this only once in his life.

decisions.choice: the temple: the sanctuary building itself, which only priests could enter
alternatives: the whole temple area with its courts
decisions.reason: Luke uses a word for the inner building. The people stayed outside in the courts (1:10, 21).

decisions.choice: the hour of the incense: the time of the daily morning or evening offering, also a time of prayer
decisions.reason: Incense was burned every morning and evening (Exodus 30:7-8). The evening offering was a time of prayer (Acts 3:1; compare Psalm 141:2).

decisions.choice: sanctuary (B); holy place of the Lord's temple (R)
decisions.reason: In English "temple" suggests the whole complex. Balanced and Readable name the inner building Zechariah entered.

decisions.choice: le temple (L, B); la salle sacrée du temple (R)
alternatives: le sanctuaire (B), as the English Balanced says "sanctuary"
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "le temple" at every level for the temple building itself. In French, entering "le temple" while the crowd prays "dehors" already shows that Zechariah went into the building, and "sanctuaire" could be read as the innermost room. Readable names the holy place, as the English Readable does. The same in 1:21-22.

decisions.choice: hekalu (L); patakatifu (B); mahali patakatifu pa hekalu (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word here is the sanctuary building itself, which only priests entered (meaning decision m2). "Hekalu" is the whole temple; Balanced says "patakatifu" (the holy place), as the English says "sanctuary", and again in 1:21-22.

decisions.choice: "성전" (L); "성소" (B); "성전 안 거룩한 곳" (R) for the sanctuary building
decisions.reason: The word here is the sanctuary itself, which only priests entered (meaning decision), not the whole temple area. Literal keeps "성전", as the Korean John does for this word; Balanced says "성소", the holy place, as the English Balanced says "sanctuary", and Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" (L); "nơi thánh" (B); "nơi thánh trong đền thờ" (R) for the sanctuary building
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says this is the sanctuary itself, which only priests entered. "nơi thánh" says that plainly; Literal keeps the word used for the temple elsewhere. Balanced keeps "nơi thánh" in 1:21-22.

source.text: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἑστὼς ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ θυμιάματος.

records.literal_gloss: Appeared then to him an angel of [the] Lord standing at [the] right of the altar of the incense.

en.L: And an angel of [the] Lord appeared to him, standing at [the] right [side] of the altar of incense.
en.B: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the altar of incense.
en.R: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared to Zechariah. The angel stood at the right side of the altar where the incense was burned.

es.L: Y se le apareció un ángel del Señor, de pie al lado derecho del altar del incienso.
es.B: Entonces un ángel del Señor se le apareció; estaba de pie a la derecha del altar del incienso.
es.R: De pronto, un ángel del Señor se le apareció a Zacarías. El ángel estaba de pie al lado derecho del altar donde se quemaba el incienso.

fr.L: Et un ange du Seigneur lui apparut, se tenant à droite de l’autel de l’encens.
fr.B: Alors un ange du Seigneur lui apparut ; il se tenait à droite de l’autel de l’encens.
fr.R: Tout à coup, un ange du Seigneur est apparu à Zacharie. L’ange se tenait à droite de l’autel où l’on brûlait l’encens.

sw.L: Naye malaika wa Bwana alionekana kwake, akiwa amesimama upande wa kulia wa madhabahu ya uvumba.
sw.B: Kisha malaika wa Bwana alimtokea, naye alikuwa amesimama kulia kwa madhabahu ya uvumba.
sw.R: Ghafla malaika wa Bwana alimtokea Zakaria. Malaika huyo alisimama upande wa kulia wa madhabahu ambapo uvumba ulifukizwa.

ko.L: 그런데 주님의 천사가 그에게 나타나, 향 제단 오른쪽에 서 있었다.
ko.B: 그때 주님의 천사가 그에게 나타나 향 제단 오른쪽에 섰다.
ko.R: 그때 갑자기 주님의 천사가 사가랴에게 나타났다. 천사는 향을 피우는 제단 오른쪽에 서 있었다.

vi.L: Và một thiên sứ của Chúa hiện ra với ông, đứng bên phải bàn thờ dâng hương.
vi.B: Bấy giờ một thiên sứ của Chúa hiện ra với ông, đứng bên phải bàn thờ dâng hương.
vi.R: Bỗng nhiên, một thiên sứ của Chúa hiện ra với Xa-cha-ri. Thiên sứ đứng bên phải bàn thờ là nơi đốt hương.

decisions.choice: an angel of the Lord: a messenger sent from God
decisions.reason: In 1:19 the angel names himself Gabriel and says God sent him. "The Lord" here is God.

decisions.choice: the right side of the altar: the side of favor
decisions.reason: The right side was the place of honor and favor; the angel's place may already hint that the news is good.

decisions.choice: Suddenly
decisions.reason: Readable shows that the appearance was unexpected, as 1:12 makes clear.

decisions.choice: "주님의 천사"
decisions.reason: "천사" is the current word for a messenger from heaven (meaning decision); "사자" is kept for human messengers, as in the Korean Mark 1:2. "주님" is the respectful form used for the Lord throughout the Korean Gospels.

source.text: καὶ ἐταράχθη Ζαχαρίας ἰδών, καὶ φόβος ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And was troubled Zechariah having seen, and fear fell upon him.

en.L: And Zechariah was troubled when he saw [him], and fear fell upon him.
en.B: When Zechariah saw him, he was shaken, and fear came over him.
en.R: Zechariah was very upset when he saw the angel, and he was afraid.

es.L: Y Zacarías se turbó al ver[lo], y el temor cayó sobre él.
es.B: Al verlo, Zacarías se estremeció, y el miedo se apoderó de él.
es.R: Zacarías se asustó mucho cuando vio al ángel, y tuvo miedo.

fr.L: Et Zacharie fut troublé en [le] voyant, et la crainte tomba sur lui.
fr.B: En le voyant, Zacharie fut bouleversé, et la peur s’empara de lui.
fr.R: Quand Zacharie a vu l’ange, il a été très troublé et il a eu peur.

sw.L: Naye Zakaria alifadhaika alipomwona, na hofu ikamwangukia.
sw.B: Zakaria alipomwona alitetemeka, na hofu ikamjaa.
sw.R: Zakaria alishtuka sana alipomwona malaika, akaogopa.

ko.L: 그리고 사가랴는 [그를] 보고 당황하였고, 두려움이 그를 덮쳤다.
ko.B: 사가랴는 천사를 보고 몹시 당황했고, 두려움에 사로잡혔다.
ko.R: 사가랴는 천사를 보고 깜짝 놀랐다. 그리고 몹시 무서웠다.

vi.L: Và Xa-cha-ri bối rối khi thấy [thiên sứ], và sự sợ hãi giáng trên ông.
vi.B: Thấy thiên sứ, Xa-cha-ri bàng hoàng, và nỗi sợ hãi bao trùm lấy ông.
vi.R: Thấy thiên sứ, Xa-cha-ri hết sức bối rối và sợ hãi.

decisions.choice: fear fell upon him: he was overcome with fear
decisions.reason: The fear of one who meets a messenger from God, as in Judges 6:22-23 and Daniel 8:17. Luke often tells of fear at God's appearing (1:65; 2:9; 5:26).

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος· Μὴ φοβοῦ, Ζαχαρία, διότι εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς σου, καὶ ἡ γυνή σου Ἐλισάβετ γεννήσει υἱόν σοι, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννην·

records.literal_gloss: Said then to him the angel, Not fear, Zechariah, because was heard the prayer of you, and the wife of you Elizabeth will bear a son to you, and you will call the name of him John;

en.L: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you will call his name John.
en.B: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zechariah. Your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will give you a son, and you are to name him John.
en.R: But the angel told him, "Zechariah, do not be afraid! God has heard your prayer. Your wife Elizabeth will have a baby boy, and you must name him John.

es.L: Pero el ángel le dijo: «No temas, Zacarías, porque tu oración fue escuchada, y tu esposa Isabel te dará a luz un hijo, y llamarás su nombre Juan.
es.B: Pero el ángel le dijo: «No tengas miedo, Zacarías. Tu oración ha sido escuchada. Tu esposa Isabel te dará un hijo, y le pondrás por nombre Juan.
es.R: Pero el ángel le dijo: «¡Zacarías, no tengas miedo! Dios ha escuchado tu oración. Tu esposa Isabel va a tener un niño, y tienes que ponerle por nombre Juan.

fr.L: Mais l’ange lui dit : « Ne crains pas, Zacharie, car ta supplication a été entendue, et ta femme Élisabeth t’enfantera un fils, et tu appelleras son nom Jean.
fr.B: Mais l’ange lui dit : « N’aie pas peur, Zacharie. Ta prière a été entendue. Ta femme Élisabeth te donnera un fils, et tu l’appelleras Jean.
fr.R: Mais l’ange lui a dit : « Zacharie, n’aie pas peur ! Dieu a entendu ta prière. Ta femme Élisabeth va avoir un petit garçon, et tu devras l’appeler Jean.

sw.L: Lakini malaika akamwambia, "Usiogope, Zakaria, kwa sababu ombi lako limesikiwa, na mke wako Elisabeti atakuzalia mwana, nawe utaliita jina lake Yohana.
sw.B: Lakini malaika akamwambia, "Usiogope, Zakaria. Ombi lako limesikiwa. Mke wako Elisabeti atakuzalia mtoto wa kiume, nawe utampa jina Yohana.
sw.R: Lakini malaika akamwambia, "Zakaria, usiogope! Mungu amesikia ombi lako. Mke wako Elisabeti atapata mtoto wa kiume, nawe lazima umpe jina Yohana.

ko.L: 그러자 천사가 그에게 말했다. "두려워하지 마라, 사가랴. 너의 간구가 들렸기 때문이다. 너의 아내 엘리사벳이 너에게 아들을 낳아 줄 것이고, 너는 그의 이름을 요한이라고 부를 것이다.
ko.B: 그러자 천사가 그에게 말했다. "사가랴, 두려워하지 마라. 네 기도가 들렸다. 네 아내 엘리사벳이 너에게 아들을 낳아 줄 것이다. 너는 그 아이의 이름을 요한이라고 하여라.
ko.R: 천사가 사가랴에게 말했다. "사가랴, 무서워하지 마라! 하나님께서 네 기도를 들으셨다. 네 아내 엘리사벳이 아들을 낳을 것이다. 너는 그 아이의 이름을 요한이라고 지어야 한다.

vi.L: Nhưng thiên sứ nói với ông: "Đừng sợ, Xa-cha-ri, vì lời cầu xin của ông đã được nghe, và vợ ông là Ê-li-sa-bét sẽ sinh cho ông một con trai, và ông sẽ đặt tên cho con là Giăng.
vi.B: Nhưng thiên sứ nói với ông: "Xa-cha-ri, đừng sợ. Lời cầu xin của ông đã được nhậm. Ê-li-sa-bét, vợ ông, sẽ sinh cho ông một con trai, và ông phải đặt tên con là Giăng.
vi.R: Nhưng thiên sứ bảo ông: "Xa-cha-ri, đừng sợ! Đức Chúa Trời đã nghe lời cầu xin của ông. Ê-li-sa-bét, vợ ông, sẽ sinh một bé trai, và ông phải đặt tên cho bé là Giăng.

decisions.choice: your prayer: most likely his prayer for a son, perhaps also his prayer as a priest for Israel
alternatives: only the prayer offered with the incense for the nation
decisions.reason: The angel at once promises a son, so the prayer heard is most naturally his long-standing request for a child. But Zechariah is praying in the temple at the hour of Israel's prayer, and the son will bring Israel back to God (1:16-17), so the two may be one answer.

decisions.choice: has been heard: God has heard it
decisions.reason: The passive leaves God unnamed, as Jewish speech often did.

decisions.choice: you will call his name John: God himself names the child
decisions.reason: The future is a command, as in Matthew 1:21. The name John means "the LORD has been gracious". Luke does not explain it, but the naming becomes a turning point in 1:59-64.

decisions.choice: God has heard your prayer
decisions.reason: Readable names God, whom the passive implies.

decisions.choice: you are to name him (B); you must name him (R)
decisions.reason: The future tense here gives a command; Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: « » outside, “ ” inside; ¿ ? and ¡ !
decisions.reason: Standard Spanish typography, as in John and Matthew. The angel's words run to 1:17, so the guillemet opens here and closes there, as the English quotation marks do.

decisions.choice: a été entendue
decisions.reason: "Exaucée" would say that the prayer was granted. The Greek says that it was heard; what follows shows how God answers it, and m1 leaves open which prayer is meant.

decisions.choice: the angel speaks to people in 해라체 ("마라", "하여라", "너"), and they answer him in 합쇼체 with "저" (1:18; 1:34; 1:38), through Luke 1-2; the name alone as the address ("사가랴", "마리아")
decisions.reason: The angel speaks for God, and God speaks in the plain style (style guide, section 7a); a priest and a young woman answer a messenger from heaven with the formal polite style. "사가랴야" would sound as if spoken to a child, and "-여" is archaic, so the name stands alone, as in modern Korean speech.

decisions.choice: The angel speaks to Zechariah as "ông" and calls himself "tôi" (1:19-20)
decisions.reason: Zechariah is an old priest, so "ông" is the respectful address. The angel says "tôi", not "ta": "Ta" is kept for God and for Jesus speaking, with its deity_pronoun span, and an angel's "ta" would sound like God speaking.

decisions.choice: "Giăng" for John
decisions.reason: The Protestant form, as for John the Baptist in Mark and John; the style guide settles it.

source.text: καὶ ἔσται χαρά σοι καὶ ἀγαλλίασις, καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τῇ γενέσει αὐτοῦ χαρήσονται·

records.literal_gloss: And will be joy to you and gladness, and many at the birth of him will rejoice;

en.L: And you will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
en.B: He will be your joy and delight, and many people will be glad that he was born.
en.R: You will be full of joy and very happy, and many people will be glad because he has been born.

es.L: Y será para ti gozo y júbilo, y muchos se alegrarán de su nacimiento.
es.B: Él será tu gozo y tu deleite, y mucha gente se alegrará de que haya nacido.
es.R: Te llenarás de gozo y estarás muy feliz, y mucha gente se alegrará porque él ha nacido.

fr.L: Et il y aura pour toi joie et allégresse, et beaucoup se réjouiront de sa naissance.
fr.B: Il fera ta joie et ton bonheur, et bien des gens se réjouiront qu’il soit né.
fr.R: Tu seras rempli de joie et très heureux, et beaucoup de gens seront contents de sa naissance.

sw.L: Na kutakuwa na furaha kwako na shangwe, na wengi watashangilia kuzaliwa kwake.
sw.B: Yeye atakuwa furaha yako na shangwe yako, na watu wengi watafurahi kwamba amezaliwa.
sw.R: Utajaa furaha na kufurahi sana, na watu wengi watafurahi kwa sababu amezaliwa.

ko.L: 그리고 너에게 기쁨과 즐거움이 있을 것이고, 많은 사람이 그의 출생을 기뻐할 것이다.
ko.B: 그 아이는 너에게 기쁨과 즐거움이 될 것이고, 많은 사람이 그가 태어난 것을 기뻐할 것이다.
ko.R: 너는 무척 기쁘고 즐거울 것이다. 그리고 많은 사람이 그 아이가 태어난 것을 기뻐할 것이다.

vi.L: Và ông sẽ có niềm vui và sự hân hoan, và nhiều người sẽ vui mừng vì sự ra đời của con trẻ.
vi.B: Con trẻ sẽ là niềm vui và sự hân hoan của ông, và nhiều người sẽ vui mừng vì con trẻ ra đời.
vi.R: Ông sẽ tràn đầy niềm vui và rất sung sướng, và nhiều người sẽ vui mừng vì đứa bé được sinh ra.

decisions.choice: joy and gladness: deep joy, the joy of celebration
decisions.reason: The two words say the same thing twice to make it strong. The second is the joy of worship and festival; the same word returns in 1:44 and 1:47.

decisions.choice: many will rejoice: the joy reaches beyond the family
decisions.reason: The joy at John's birth is fulfilled when neighbors and relatives rejoice with Elizabeth (1:58), and points to what he will do for Israel (1:16).

decisions.choice: "niềm vui" for joy at every level
decisions.reason: Joy is a key term and keeps one word at every level; "niềm vui" is the plain modern word.

source.text: ἔσται γὰρ μέγας ἐνώπιον τοῦ κυρίου, καὶ οἶνον καὶ σίκερα οὐ μὴ πίῃ, καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου πλησθήσεται ἔτι ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ πολλοὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐπιστρέψει ἐπὶ κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτῶν·

records.literal_gloss: He will be for great before the Lord, and wine and strong drink not not he will drink, and of Spirit Holy he will be filled even from womb of mother of him, \v 16 and many of the sons of Israel he will turn to [the] Lord the God of them;

en.L: For he will be great before the Lord, and he will never drink wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with [the] Holy Spirit even from his mother's womb. \v 16 And he will turn many of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel to [the] Lord their God.
en.B: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even before he is born. \v 16 He will bring many of the people of Israel back to the Lord their God.
en.R: He will be great in the Lord's eyes. He must never drink wine or any other strong drink. Even before he is born he will be filled with the Holy Spirit. \v 16 He will lead many of the people of Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.

es.L: Porque será grande delante del Señor, y no beberá jamás vino ni bebida fuerte, y será lleno del Espíritu Santo aun desde el vientre de su madre, \v 16 y hará volver a muchos de los hijos de Israel al Señor su Dios.
es.B: Porque será grande a los ojos del Señor. Nunca deberá beber vino ni cerveza, y estará lleno del Espíritu Santo aun antes de nacer. \v 16 Hará que muchos del pueblo de Israel vuelvan al Señor su Dios.
es.R: Será grande ante los ojos del Señor. Nunca deberá beber vino ni ninguna otra bebida fuerte. Aun antes de nacer, estará lleno del Espíritu Santo. \v 16 Llevará a muchos del pueblo de Israel a volverse al Señor su Dios.

fr.L: Car il sera grand devant le Seigneur, et il ne boira jamais ni vin ni boisson forte, et il sera rempli de l’Esprit Saint dès le ventre de sa mère, \v 16 et il fera revenir beaucoup des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël au Seigneur leur Dieu.
fr.B: Car il sera grand aux yeux du Seigneur. Il ne devra jamais boire de vin ni de bière, et il sera rempli de l’Esprit Saint avant même sa naissance. \v 16 Il ramènera beaucoup d’Israélites au Seigneur leur Dieu.
fr.R: Il sera grand aux yeux du Seigneur. Il ne devra jamais boire de vin ni aucune autre boisson forte. Avant même sa naissance, il sera rempli de l’Esprit Saint. \v 16 Il aidera beaucoup de gens du peuple d’Israël à revenir vers le Seigneur leur Dieu.

sw.L: Kwa maana atakuwa mkuu mbele ya Bwana, na divai na kinywaji kikali hatakunywa kamwe, naye atajazwa Roho Mtakatifu hata akiwa bado tumboni mwa mama yake, \v 16 na wengi wa wana wa Israeli atawageuza warudi kwa Bwana Mungu wao.
sw.B: Kwa maana atakuwa mkuu machoni pa Bwana. Kamwe hatakunywa divai wala pombe, naye atajazwa Roho Mtakatifu hata kabla hajazaliwa. \v 16 Atawarudisha wengi wa watu wa Israeli kwa Bwana Mungu wao.
sw.R: Atakuwa mkuu machoni pa Bwana. Kamwe hatakunywa divai wala kinywaji kingine chochote kikali. Hata kabla hajazaliwa, atajazwa Roho Mtakatifu. \v 16 Atawaongoza watu wengi wa Israeli wamrudie Bwana Mungu wao.

ko.L: 그가 주님 앞에서 큰 [사람이] 될 것이기 때문이다. 그는 포도주와 독한 술을 결코 마시지 않을 것이고, 어머니의 태에서부터 이미 성령으로 충만할 것이다. \v 16 그리고 그는 이스라엘 자손 가운데 많은 사람을 주 그들의 하나님께로 돌아오게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 주님 보시기에 위대한 사람이 될 것이다. 그는 포도주나 독한 술을 결코 마셔서는 안 된다. 그는 태어나기 전부터 성령으로 충만할 것이다. \v 16 그리고 이스라엘 백성 가운데 많은 사람을 주 그들의 하나님께로 돌아오게 할 것이다.
ko.R: 그 아이는 주님 보시기에 큰 사람이 될 것이다. 그는 포도주나 다른 독한 술을 절대 마시면 안 된다. 그는 태어나기도 전에 성령으로 가득 찰 것이다. \v 16 그는 이스라엘 백성 가운데 많은 사람을 이끌어, 주 그들의 하나님께 다시 돌아오게 할 것이다.

vi.L: Vì người sẽ nên cao trọng trước mặt Chúa, và sẽ không bao giờ uống rượu nho hay thức uống say, và sẽ được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh ngay từ trong lòng mẹ, \v 16 và sẽ làm cho nhiều người trong con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên quay về với Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.B: Vì người sẽ nên cao trọng trước mặt Chúa. Người không bao giờ được uống rượu nho hay rượu mạnh, và sẽ được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh ngay khi còn trong lòng mẹ. \v 16 Người sẽ đưa nhiều người trong dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trở về với Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.R: Trước mặt Chúa, cậu bé sẽ là một người vĩ đại. Cậu không bao giờ được uống rượu nho hay bất cứ thứ rượu mạnh nào. Ngay từ khi chưa sinh ra, cậu đã được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh. \v 16 Cậu sẽ dẫn nhiều người trong dân Y-sơ-ra-ên quay trở về với Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời của họ.

decisions.choice: never drink wine or strong drink: a life set apart for God, like a Nazirite
decisions.reason: The words echo the Nazirite vow (Numbers 6:3) and the charge given about Samson (Judges 13:4) and the priests on duty (Leviticus 10:9). The Greek says "not, not": never. Strong drink is beer or other drink made from grain or fruit.

decisions.choice: filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother's womb: before his birth
alternatives: from the moment of his birth
decisions.reason: "Even from the womb" in the Greek Old Testament means before birth (Judges 13:5; Psalm 22:10). It is fulfilled when the unborn John leaps at Mary's greeting (1:41, 44).

decisions.choice: turn: bring back in repentance
decisions.reason: The verb is the prophets' word for turning back to God (Malachi 2:6; compare Luke 3:3, 8). John's work is to call Israel back to their God.

decisions.choice: beer (B); strong drink (R)
decisions.reason: In the ancient world strong drink was most often beer, made from barley; it was not distilled liquor. Readable keeps the general phrase.

decisions.choice: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: "Sons of Israel" means the Israelites, men and women. Literal keeps the Greek with a setting; Balanced and Readable use a word that is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: even before he is born
decisions.reason: Balanced says plainly what the Hebrew idiom means.

decisions.choice: los hijos de Israel, with no gender span
alternatives: {{gender:los hijos y las hijas|los hijos}} de Israel
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "sons" as the traditional alternative to "children". Spanish "hijos" already means children, sons and daughters, so there is nothing for the setting to change; Balanced and Readable say "el pueblo de Israel", as the English does.

decisions.choice: l’Esprit Saint (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As in John, Mark and Hebrews. French needs the article after "de", so Literal adds it without brackets.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "sons" as the traditional alternative to "children". Swahili "wana" already means children of either sex, and "wana wa kiume" would mean only the males, so there is nothing for the setting to change. The same holds for "watu" in 1:25.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" (L); "이스라엘 백성" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "children|sons" for the Greek "sons of Israel". Korean "자손" (descendants) and "백성" (people) already include women and men and have no traditional masculine counterpart here, so the setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: John in the angel's words is "người" (L, B) and "cậu bé", "cậu" (R)
decisions.reason: "người" is the respectful third person a prophecy uses for someone of standing; "nó" is too familiar for a promised prophet. Readable uses the plain word for a boy.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con cháu" (descendants) and "dân" (people) already include men and women, so no gender setting is needed (style guide section 7).

source.text: καὶ αὐτὸς προελεύσεται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ δυνάμει Ἠλίου, ἐπιστρέψαι καρδίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀπειθεῖς ἐν φρονήσει δικαίων, ἑτοιμάσαι κυρίῳ λαὸν κατεσκευασμένον.

records.literal_gloss: And he will go before before him in spirit and power of Elijah, to turn hearts of fathers to children and disobedient [ones] to [the] wisdom of righteous [ones], to prepare for [the] Lord a people having been made ready.

en.L: And he will go before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in [the] spirit and power of Elijah, to turn [the] hearts of fathers to [their] children, and [the] disobedient to [the] wisdom of [the] righteous, to make ready for [the] Lord a prepared people."
en.B: He will go ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of fathers back to their children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous, and so make ready a people prepared for the Lord."
en.R: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same spirit and power that Elijah the prophet had. He will bring fathers and their children back together. He will lead people who do not obey God to think the way good people do. He will get people ready for the Lord."

es.L: Y él irá delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en [el] espíritu y poder de Elías, para hacer volver [los] corazones de [los] padres hacia [los] hijos, y a [los] desobedientes a [la] sabiduría de [los] justos, para alistar para [el] Señor un pueblo preparado».
es.B: Irá delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con el espíritu y el poder de Elías, para hacer que los padres vuelvan su corazón hacia sus hijos y que los desobedientes vuelvan a la sabiduría de los justos, y así tener listo para el Señor un pueblo preparado».
es.R: Irá delante del Señor con el mismo espíritu y el mismo poder que tuvo el profeta Elías. Hará que los padres y sus hijos vuelvan a estar unidos. Llevará a los que no obedecen a Dios a pensar como piensa la gente buena. Preparará a la gente para el Señor».

fr.L: Et lui-même ira en avant devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans l’esprit et la puissance d’Élie, pour ramener les cœurs des pères vers les enfants, et les désobéissants à la sagesse des justes, pour apprêter au Seigneur un peuple préparé. »
fr.B: Il marchera devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec l’esprit et la puissance d’Élie, pour ramener le cœur des pères vers leurs enfants et les désobéissants à la sagesse des justes, et former ainsi pour le Seigneur un peuple bien préparé. »
fr.R: Il ira devant le Seigneur avec le même esprit et la même puissance que le prophète Élie. Il réconciliera les pères avec leurs enfants. Il amènera ceux qui n’obéissent pas à Dieu à penser comme les gens qui font le bien. Ainsi, il préparera un peuple prêt pour le Seigneur. »

sw.L: Naye mwenyewe atakwenda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika roho na nguvu ya Eliya, kuirudisha mioyo ya akina baba kwa watoto [wao], na wasiotii [wairudie] hekima ya wenye haki, ili kumwandalia Bwana watu waliotayarishwa."
sw.B: Atatangulia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} akiwa na roho na nguvu za Eliya, ili airudishe mioyo ya akina baba kwa watoto wao, na awarudishe wasiotii kwenye hekima ya wenye haki, na hivyo awaandae kwa Bwana watu waliotayarishwa."
sw.R: Atamtangulia Bwana akiwa na roho na nguvu zilezile alizokuwa nazo nabii Eliya. Atawapatanisha akina baba na watoto wao. Atawaongoza wale wasiomtii Mungu wafikiri kama watu wema wanavyofikiri. Atawaandaa watu kwa ajili ya Bwana."

ko.L: 그리고 그는 엘리야의 영과 능력으로 그분 앞에 먼저 갈 것이다. 아버지들의 마음을 자녀들에게로, 순종하지 않는 사람들을 의인들의 슬기로 돌이키게 하여, 준비된 백성을 주님께 마련하려는 것이다."
ko.B: 그는 엘리야의 영과 능력을 가지고 그분보다 앞서 갈 것이다. 그는 아버지들의 마음을 자녀들에게로 돌아서게 하고, 순종하지 않는 사람들을 의인들의 지혜로 돌아오게 하여, 주님을 맞이할 백성을 준비시킬 것이다."
ko.R: 그는 예언자 엘리야가 가졌던 것과 같은 영과 능력을 가지고 주님보다 먼저 올 것이다. 그는 아버지들과 자녀들이 다시 화목하게 할 것이다. 하나님께 순종하지 않는 사람들이 바르게 사는 사람들처럼 생각하게 할 것이다. 그렇게 해서 백성이 주님을 맞을 준비를 하게 할 것이다."

vi.L: Và chính người sẽ đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong tinh thần và quyền năng của Ê-li, để làm cho lòng các người cha quay về với con cái, và [những kẻ] không vâng phục [quay về] với sự khôn ngoan của người công chính, để chuẩn bị cho Chúa một dân đã được sửa soạn sẵn."
vi.B: Người sẽ đi trước {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tinh thần và quyền năng của Ê-li, để làm cho lòng cha quay lại với con cái, và người bất tuân trở về với sự khôn ngoan của người công chính, hầu chuẩn bị cho Chúa một dân sẵn sàng."
vi.R: Cậu sẽ đi trước Chúa, với cùng tinh thần và quyền năng mà nhà tiên tri Ê-li đã có. Cậu sẽ đem cha và con trở lại gần nhau. Cậu sẽ dẫn những người không vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời biết suy nghĩ như những người ngay lành. Cậu sẽ chuẩn bị một dân sẵn sàng đón Chúa."

decisions.choice: before him: before the Lord their God of 1:16
alternatives: before the Messiah, who has not yet been named
decisions.reason: The nearest "him" is "the Lord their God" in 1:16. John goes ahead of God himself, as Malachi 3:1 says. Luke's readers will see that God comes in Jesus (1:43, 76).

decisions.choice: the spirit and power of Elijah ... turn the hearts of fathers to their children: Malachi 4:5-6
decisions.reason: Malachi ends with God's promise to send Elijah before the great day of the Lord, to turn the hearts of fathers to their children (Malachi 4:5-6; 3:23-24 in the Hebrew). John is not Elijah come back to life, but he comes with Elijah's spirit and power, to do Elijah's work.

decisions.choice: the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous: bringing those who do not obey God to think and live as the righteous do
decisions.reason: The second phrase interprets Malachi: the turning is a turning back to God's ways, not only a mending of families.

decisions.choice: to make ready a prepared people: the goal of all John's work
alternatives: a third task alongside the others
decisions.reason: The last phrase sums up the purpose: when the Lord comes, a people will be ready for him.

decisions.choice: the Lord
decisions.reason: Readable names the one meant by "him".

decisions.choice: every French pronoun for God or Christ carries the deity_pronoun span, subject "il" included (for the whole book)
alternatives: subject pronouns without the span, as in Spanish
decisions.reason: As in John, Mark and Colossians. French must write the subject pronoun, so "il" for God or Jesus carries the span wherever the English "he" does, and object pronouns French needs where English has none ("on {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellera", 1:35) take it too. The forms are il, lui, le, l’, son, sa, ses. A pronoun at the start of a sentence is written plainly with its capital. Here "lui" is the Lord their God of 1:16 (m1).

decisions.choice: mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; no span on verb prefixes
alternatives: a span on the verb prefix as well
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb, and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives (yeye, yake, wake, lake). Swahili therefore has fewer spans than the English in this chapter.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Luke 1-3; "그분" (L, B), "주님" (R) for "him"
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; respect for God and Jesus is carried by "그분", "께서" and the honorific -시- at every level (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}" for "him", the Lord God of 1:16
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says "him" is the Lord their God, so the narrator's pronoun for God is used with its setting span.

decisions.choice: "tinh thần" for the spirit of Elijah
decisions.reason: Lowercase: this is the spirit Elijah had, not the Holy Spirit. "tinh thần" is the modern word for a person's inner disposition and drive.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν Ζαχαρίας πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον· Κατὰ τί γνώσομαι τοῦτο;

records.literal_gloss: And said Zechariah to the angel, By what will I know this?

en.L: And Zechariah said to the angel, "By what will I know this?
en.B: Zechariah said to the angel, "How can I be sure of this?
en.R: Zechariah asked the angel, "How can I know that this is true?

es.L: Y Zacarías dijo al ángel: «¿Por medio de qué sabré esto?
es.B: Zacarías le dijo al ángel: «¿Cómo puedo estar seguro de esto?
es.R: Zacarías le preguntó al ángel: «¿Cómo puedo saber que esto es verdad?

fr.L: Et Zacharie dit à l’ange : « Par quoi saurai-je cela ?
fr.B: Zacharie dit à l’ange : « Comment puis-je en être sûr ?
fr.R: Zacharie a demandé à l’ange : « Comment savoir que c’est vrai ?

sw.L: Naye Zakaria akamwambia malaika, "Kwa kitu gani nitalijua hili?
sw.B: Zakaria akamwambia malaika, "Nitawezaje kuwa na hakika na jambo hili?
sw.R: Zakaria akamwuliza malaika, "Nitawezaje kujua kwamba jambo hili ni kweli?

ko.L: 그리고 사가랴가 천사에게 말했다. "무엇으로 제가 이것을 알겠습니까?
ko.B: 사가랴가 천사에게 말했다. "제가 이 일을 어떻게 확신할 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 사가랴가 천사에게 물었다. "이 말이 사실인지 제가 어떻게 알 수 있습니까?

vi.L: Và Xa-cha-ri nói với thiên sứ: "Bởi đâu tôi sẽ biết điều này?
vi.B: Xa-cha-ri thưa với thiên sứ: "Làm sao tôi biết chắc điều này?
vi.R: Xa-cha-ri hỏi thiên sứ: "Làm sao tôi biết được điều này là thật?

decisions.choice: by what will I know this: a request for proof
alternatives: a simple question how it will happen
decisions.reason: Zechariah asks for a sign, as Abraham did ("By what shall I know?", Genesis 15:8 in the Greek). Mary's question in 1:34 is different: she asks how, not for proof. The angel answers Zechariah with a sign that is also a discipline (1:20).

source.text: ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι πρεσβύτης καὶ ἡ γυνή μου προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: I for am an old man and the wife of me advanced in the days of her.

en.L: For I am an old man, and my wife [is] advanced in her days."
en.B: I am an old man, and my wife is getting on in years."
en.R: I am old, and my wife is old too."

es.L: Porque yo soy un anciano, y mi esposa [está] avanzada en sus días».
es.B: Yo ya soy anciano, y mi esposa ya está entrada en años».
es.R: Yo soy anciano, y mi esposa también es anciana».

fr.L: Car moi, je suis un vieillard, et ma femme [est] avancée dans ses jours. »
fr.B: Je suis vieux, et ma femme est avancée en âge. »
fr.R: Je suis vieux, et ma femme aussi est vieille. »

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi ni mzee, na mke wangu [amekwisha] kusonga mbele katika siku zake."
sw.B: Mimi ni mzee, na mke wangu naye ameshakuwa na umri mkubwa."
sw.R: Mimi ni mzee, na mke wangu pia ni mzee."

ko.L: 저는 늙은 사람이고, 제 아내도 그의 날들이 많이 흘렀습니다."
ko.B: 저는 늙었고, 제 아내도 나이가 많습니다."
ko.R: 저는 늙었고, 제 아내도 늙었습니다."

vi.L: Vì tôi là người già, và vợ tôi đã cao tuổi."
vi.B: Tôi đã già, và vợ tôi cũng đã cao tuổi."
vi.R: Tôi già rồi, và vợ tôi cũng già rồi."

decisions.choice: advanced in her days: old
decisions.reason: The same idiom as in 1:7.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἐγώ εἰμι Γαβριὴλ ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἀπεστάλην λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ καὶ εὐαγγελίσασθαί σοι ταῦτα·

records.literal_gloss: And answering the angel said to him, I am Gabriel the [one] standing before the God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring good news to you these [things];

en.L: And answering, the angel said to him, "I am Gabriel, who stands before God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
en.B: The angel answered him, "I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
en.R: The angel answered, "I am Gabriel. I stand in front of God and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He sent me to talk to you and to tell you this good news.

es.L: Y respondiendo, el ángel le dijo: «Yo soy Gabriel, el que está de pie delante de Dios, y fui enviado para hablar contigo y anunciarte esta buena noticia.
es.B: El ángel le respondió: «Yo soy Gabriel. Estoy en la presencia de Dios, y he sido enviado para hablar contigo y darte esta buena noticia.
es.R: El ángel le respondió: «Yo soy Gabriel. Estoy de pie delante de Dios y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirvo. Él me envió a hablar contigo y a darte esta buena noticia.

fr.L: Et répondant, l’ange lui dit : « Je suis Gabriel, celui qui se tient devant Dieu, et j’ai été envoyé pour te parler et pour t’annoncer cette bonne nouvelle.
fr.B: L’ange lui répondit : « Je suis Gabriel. Je me tiens en présence de Dieu, et j’ai été envoyé pour te parler et t’annoncer cette bonne nouvelle.
fr.R: L’ange lui a répondu : « Je suis Gabriel. Je me tiens devant Dieu et je {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sers. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui m’a envoyé te parler et t’annoncer cette bonne nouvelle.

sw.L: Na malaika akajibu akamwambia, "Mimi ni Gabrieli, ninayesimama mbele ya Mungu, nami nilitumwa kusema nawe na kukupasha habari njema hizi.
sw.B: Malaika akamjibu, "Mimi ni Gabrieli. Ninasimama mbele za Mungu, nami nimetumwa kuzungumza nawe na kukujulisha habari hii njema.
sw.R: Malaika akajibu, "Mimi ni Gabrieli. Ninasimama mbele ya Mungu na kumtumikia. Yeye ndiye aliyenituma nije kuzungumza nawe na kukueleza habari hii njema.

ko.L: 그러자 천사가 대답하여 그에게 말했다. "나는 하나님 앞에 서 있는 가브리엘이다. 나는 너에게 말하고, 너에게 이 기쁜 소식을 전하라고 보내심을 받았다.
ko.B: 천사가 그에게 대답했다. "나는 가브리엘이다. 나는 하나님 앞에 서 있는 천사다. 나는 너에게 말하고 이 기쁜 소식을 전하려고 보내심을 받았다.
ko.R: 천사가 대답했다. "나는 가브리엘이다. 나는 하나님 앞에 서서 그분을 섬긴다. 하나님께서 나를 너에게 보내셔서, 이 기쁜 소식을 전하게 하셨다.

vi.L: Và thiên sứ đáp lời ông: "Tôi là Gáp-ri-ên, đấng đứng trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, và tôi đã được sai đến để nói với ông và báo cho ông tin vui này.
vi.B: Thiên sứ đáp: "Tôi là Gáp-ri-ên. Tôi đứng chầu trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, và tôi được sai đến để nói với ông và báo cho ông tin vui này.
vi.R: Thiên sứ trả lời: "Tôi là Gáp-ri-ên. Tôi đứng trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài sai tôi đến nói chuyện với ông và báo cho ông tin vui này.

decisions.choice: Gabriel: the angel who explained God's plans to Daniel
decisions.reason: Gabriel appears in Daniel 8:16 and 9:21, where he brings understanding about the time of God's deliverance, at the hour of the evening offering (Daniel 9:21).

decisions.choice: who stands before God: one of the angels who serve in God's presence
alternatives: one who stands to be judged
decisions.reason: To stand before a king was to be one of his servants at court (1 Kings 10:8). Gabriel's rank gives weight to his words.

decisions.choice: bring good news: announce good news
alternatives: preach the gospel, in the later sense
decisions.reason: This is the verb from which the word for the gospel comes. Here it is the first of many uses in Luke (2:10; 4:18), for news of God's saving acts.

decisions.choice: bring you this good news
decisions.reason: The verb means to announce good news. "Preach" would make it sound like a sermon.

decisions.choice: He sent me
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the sender.

decisions.choice: Et répondant, l’ange lui dit (L); répondit (B, R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Luke's participle with "said", as the English Literal "answering, the angel said" does; Balanced and Readable use the single French verb.

decisions.choice: "가브리엘"; "기쁜 소식을 전하다" for the verb of announcing good news, at every level
decisions.reason: "복음" is kept for the noun "gospel" (L, B), as in the Korean Mark; for the verb, which here is an angel announcing a happy event (meaning decision), "기쁜 소식을 전하다" says it plainly at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "báo ... tin vui" for the verb "bring good news"
decisions.reason: "Tin Lành" is kept for the gospel as a noun (Mark 1:1). Here an angel announces happy news about a birth, and "tin vui" says that plainly; "tin mừng" would echo the Catholic name for the gospel. Used again in 2:10.

decisions.choice: "Gáp-ri-ên"
decisions.reason: The Protestant transliteration of the name.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔσῃ σιωπῶν καὶ μὴ δυνάμενος λαλῆσαι ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας γένηται ταῦτα, ἀνθ’ ὧν οὐκ ἐπίστευσας τοῖς λόγοις μου, οἵτινες πληρωθήσονται εἰς τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And behold you will be silent and not being able to speak until which day happen these [things], because not you believed the words of me, which will be fulfilled in the time of them.

en.L: And look, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day these things happen, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their time."
en.B: And now you will be silent, unable to speak, until the day these things take place, because you did not believe my words. They will come true at their proper time."
en.R: But you did not believe what I told you. So now you will not be able to speak until the day all this happens. Everything I said will come true at the right time."

es.L: Y mira, estarás en silencio y sin poder hablar hasta el día en que ocurran estas cosas, ya que no diste crédito a mis palabras, que se cumplirán en el tiempo que les corresponde».
es.B: Y ahora te quedarás en silencio, sin poder hablar, hasta el día en que todo esto suceda, porque no creíste mis palabras. Ellas se harán realidad en el momento debido».
es.R: Pero no creíste lo que te dije. Por eso ahora no podrás hablar hasta el día en que todo esto suceda. Todo lo que te dije se hará realidad en el momento oportuno».

fr.L: Et voici, tu seras silencieux et incapable de parler jusqu’au jour où ces choses arriveront, parce que tu n’as pas cru mes paroles, qui s’accompliront en leur temps. »
fr.B: Dès maintenant, tu garderas le silence et tu ne pourras plus parler jusqu’au jour où cela arrivera, parce que tu n’as pas cru à mes paroles. Elles s’accompliront au moment fixé. »
fr.R: Mais tu n’as pas cru ce que je t’ai dit. Alors maintenant, tu ne pourras plus parler jusqu’au jour où tout cela arrivera. Tout ce que j’ai dit se réalisera au bon moment. »

sw.L: Na tazama, utakuwa kimya na usiyeweza kusema hadi siku mambo haya yatakapotokea, kwa sababu hukuamini maneno yangu, ambayo yatatimia wakati wake utakapowadia."
sw.B: Sasa utakuwa kimya, usiweze kusema, mpaka siku mambo haya yatakapotokea, kwa sababu hukuamini maneno yangu. Yatatimia wakati wake ufaao utakapofika."
sw.R: Lakini wewe hukuamini niliyokuambia. Kwa hiyo sasa hutaweza kusema mpaka siku mambo haya yote yatakapotokea. Kila kitu nilichosema kitatimia wakati unaofaa."

ko.L: 보아라, 이 일들이 일어나는 날까지 너는 잠잠하여 말을 할 수 없을 것이다. 제때에 이루어질 내 말들을 네가 믿지 않았기 때문이다."
ko.B: 이제 너는 이 일들이 일어나는 날까지 말을 못 하고 잠잠히 지낼 것이다. 네가 내 말을 믿지 않았기 때문이다. 내 말은 정한 때가 되면 그대로 이루어질 것이다."
ko.R: 그런데 너는 내 말을 믿지 않았다. 그래서 이제 이 모든 일이 일어나는 날까지 너는 말을 할 수 없을 것이다. 내가 한 말은 모두 하나님께서 정하신 때에 이루어질 것이다."

vi.L: Và này, ông sẽ câm lặng và không thể nói được cho đến ngày những việc này xảy ra, vì ông đã không tin lời tôi, là những lời sẽ được ứng nghiệm đúng kỳ của chúng."
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ ông sẽ phải im lặng, không nói được, cho đến ngày những việc ấy xảy ra, vì ông đã không tin lời tôi. Những lời ấy sẽ thành sự thật đúng thời điểm của chúng."
vi.R: Nhưng ông đã không tin điều tôi nói. Vì vậy, từ bây giờ ông sẽ không nói được cho đến ngày mọi việc này xảy ra. Mọi điều tôi đã nói sẽ thành sự thật đúng lúc."

decisions.choice: you will be silent: the sign Zechariah asked for, and a discipline for his unbelief
decisions.reason: Zechariah asked how he could know (1:18). The silence answers him: it is the sign, and it is also the consequence of not believing. It ends when he obeys the angel's word about the name (1:63-64).

decisions.choice: in their time: at the time God has set
decisions.reason: The word means the appointed time. God's word will be fulfilled when he has planned.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: the reason first: "But you did not believe ... So now ..."
decisions.reason: Readable puts the cause before the result, which is easier to follow.

decisions.choice: mira (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "ahora" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English and in Matthew: "he aquí" is archaic. Literal keeps the word with "mira"; Balanced and Readable let the sentence carry it. The same throughout this chapter.

decisions.choice: voici (L); "Dès maintenant" or not rendered as a separate word (B, R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: Unlike English "behold", French "voici" is current and natural for pointing to what follows, so Literal uses it rather than "regarde", which would sound like a command to look. Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: tazama (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "sasa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English and in Matthew: Literal keeps the word that draws attention; Balanced and Readable let the sentence carry it. The same throughout this chapter.

decisions.choice: "보아라" (L) for the Greek "behold", through Luke 1-3; not a separate word at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark, Literal keeps the word with the modern imperative "보아라"; "보라" is the older form. Balanced and Readable leave it out or say "이제", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "này" for "look" (L); "bây giờ" or nothing (B, R)
decisions.reason: "này" is the short Vietnamese word that draws attention, as "look" does in the English Literal; Balanced and Readable leave it out or say "now". The same in the rest of Luke 1-3.

source.text: Καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς προσδοκῶν τὸν Ζαχαρίαν, καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐν τῷ χρονίζειν ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And was the people waiting for the Zechariah, and they were wondering at the delaying in the temple him.

en.L: And the people were waiting for Zechariah, and they were wondering at his delaying in the temple.
en.B: Meanwhile the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he was staying so long in the sanctuary.
en.R: Meanwhile, the people outside were waiting for Zechariah. They wondered why he was staying inside the temple so long.

es.L: Y el pueblo aguardaba a Zacarías, y se asombraban de su tardanza en el templo.
