es.B: Mientras tanto, el pueblo esperaba a Zacarías y se preguntaba por qué se quedaba tanto tiempo en el santuario.
es.R: Mientras tanto, la gente que estaba afuera esperaba a Zacarías. Se preguntaban por qué se quedaba tanto tiempo dentro del templo.

fr.L: Et le peuple attendait Zacharie, et ils s’étonnaient de ce qu’il tardait dans le temple.
fr.B: Pendant ce temps, le peuple attendait Zacharie et se demandait pourquoi il restait si longtemps dans le temple.
fr.R: Pendant ce temps, les gens attendaient Zacharie dehors. Ils se demandaient pourquoi il restait si longtemps à l’intérieur du temple.

sw.L: Na watu walikuwa wakimsubiri Zakaria, nao walikuwa wakishangaa jinsi alivyochelewa ndani ya hekalu.
sw.B: Wakati huo watu walikuwa wakimsubiri Zakaria, wakijiuliza kwa nini anakaa muda mrefu hivyo patakatifu.
sw.R: Wakati huo watu waliokuwa nje walikuwa wakimsubiri Zakaria. Walijiuliza kwa nini alikaa ndani ya hekalu muda mrefu hivyo.

ko.L: 그리고 백성은 사가랴를 기다리고 있었고, 그가 성전에서 지체하는 것을 이상하게 여기고 있었다.
ko.B: 그동안 백성은 사가랴를 기다리면서, 그가 성소 안에서 왜 이렇게 오래 머무르는지 이상하게 여겼다.
ko.R: 그동안 밖에 있던 사람들은 사가랴를 기다리고 있었다. 그들은 사가랴가 왜 성전 안에서 이렇게 오래 있는지 궁금해했다.

vi.L: Và dân chúng đang chờ Xa-cha-ri, và họ lấy làm lạ vì ông ở lâu trong đền thờ.
vi.B: Trong khi đó, dân chúng đứng chờ Xa-cha-ri và thắc mắc sao ông ở trong nơi thánh lâu như vậy.
vi.R: Lúc ấy, dân chúng ở bên ngoài đang chờ Xa-cha-ri. Họ thắc mắc không biết sao ông ở trong đền thờ lâu như thế.

decisions.choice: they wondered at his delay: the priest was expected to come out soon
decisions.reason: After burning the incense the priest came out to bless the people (compare Numbers 6:24-26). A long delay could make people fear that something had gone wrong in God's presence.

decisions.choice: sanctuary
decisions.reason: As in 1:9, the inner building.

source.text: ἐξελθὼν δὲ οὐκ ἐδύνατο λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν ὅτι ὀπτασίαν ἑώρακεν ἐν τῷ ναῷ· καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν διανεύων αὐτοῖς, καὶ διέμενεν κωφός.

records.literal_gloss: Having come out then not he was able to speak to them, and they realized that a vision he had seen in the temple; and he was making signs to them, and remained mute.

en.L: And when he came out, he was not able to speak to them, and they realized that he had seen a vision in the temple; and he kept making signs to them, and remained mute.
en.B: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they realized that he had seen a vision in the sanctuary. He kept making signs to them, but he remained unable to speak.
en.R: When he finally came out, he could not speak to them. They understood that he had seen a vision inside the temple. He kept using his hands to show them what he meant, but he could not say a word.

es.L: Y al salir, no era capaz de hablarles, y se dieron cuenta de que había tenido una visión en el templo; y él seguía haciéndoles señas, y continuaba mudo.
es.B: Cuando salió, no podía hablarles, y se dieron cuenta de que había tenido una visión en el santuario. Él seguía haciéndoles señas, pero no podía decir nada.
es.R: Cuando por fin salió, no podía hablarles. Entendieron que había visto una visión dentro del templo. Él seguía usando las manos para mostrarles lo que quería decir, pero no podía decir ni una palabra.

fr.L: Et étant sorti, il ne pouvait pas leur parler, et ils comprirent qu’il avait vu une vision dans le temple ; et lui, il leur faisait des signes, et il demeurait muet.
fr.B: Quand il sortit, il ne put leur parler, et ils comprirent qu’il avait eu une vision dans le temple. Il leur faisait des signes, mais il restait incapable de parler.
fr.R: Quand il est enfin sorti, il ne pouvait pas leur parler. Ils ont compris qu’il avait eu une vision à l’intérieur du temple. Il essayait de leur expliquer avec ses mains, mais il ne pouvait pas dire un mot.

sw.L: Naye alipotoka nje, hakuweza kusema nao, nao wakafahamu kwamba alikuwa ameona maono ndani ya hekalu; naye aliendelea kuwaashiria, akabaki bubu.
sw.B: Alipotoka, hakuweza kusema nao, nao wakatambua kwamba ameona maono patakatifu. Aliendelea kuwaashiria kwa mikono, lakini akabaki bila kuweza kusema.
sw.R: Hatimaye alipotoka nje, hakuweza kusema nao. Walielewa kwamba alikuwa ameona maono ndani ya hekalu. Aliendelea kutumia mikono yake kuwaonyesha alichotaka kusema, lakini hakuweza kutamka neno lolote.

ko.L: 그런데 그는 나와서 그들에게 말을 할 수 없었다. 그리고 그들은 그가 성전에서 환상을 보았다는 것을 알아차렸다. 그는 그들에게 계속 손짓을 하였고, 말 못 하는 채로 있었다.
ko.B: 그는 밖으로 나왔지만 그들에게 말을 할 수 없었다. 사람들은 그가 성소에서 환상을 보았다는 것을 알아차렸다. 그는 그들에게 계속 손짓만 할 뿐, 여전히 말을 하지 못했다.
ko.R: 마침내 사가랴가 밖으로 나왔지만, 사람들에게 말을 할 수 없었다. 사람들은 그가 성전 안에서 환상을 보았다는 것을 알았다. 사가랴는 손짓으로 자기 뜻을 알리려고 했지만, 한마디도 할 수 없었다.

vi.L: Và khi đi ra, ông không thể nói với họ, và họ hiểu rằng ông đã thấy một khải tượng trong đền thờ; và ông cứ ra dấu cho họ, và vẫn câm.
vi.B: Khi ông ra, ông không nói được với họ, và họ hiểu rằng ông đã thấy một khải tượng trong nơi thánh. Ông cứ ra dấu cho họ, nhưng vẫn không nói được.
vi.R: Cuối cùng khi ông đi ra, ông không nói được với họ. Họ hiểu rằng ông đã thấy một khải tượng ở trong đền thờ. Ông cứ dùng tay ra dấu cho họ hiểu ý mình, nhưng không nói được một lời nào.

decisions.choice: mute: unable to speak, and perhaps also unable to hear
decisions.reason: The word can mean mute or deaf or both (7:22; 11:14). In 1:62 people make signs to him rather than speak, which suggests he could not hear either.

decisions.choice: sanctuary
decisions.reason: As in 1:9.

source.text: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς λειτουργίας αὐτοῦ, ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass as were fulfilled the days of the service of him, he went away to the house of him.

en.L: And it happened, when the days of his service were completed, he went away to his home.
en.B: When his days of service were over, he went home.
en.R: When his time of work at the temple was finished, Zechariah went back home.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando se completaron los días de su servicio, se fue a su casa.
es.B: Cuando terminaron sus días de servicio, se fue a su casa.
es.R: Cuando terminó su tiempo de trabajo en el templo, Zacarías regresó a su casa.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand les jours de son service furent accomplis, [qu’]il s’en alla dans sa maison.
fr.B: Quand ses jours de service furent terminés, il retourna chez lui.
fr.R: Quand son temps de travail au temple a été fini, Zacharie est rentré chez lui.

sw.L: Ikawa, siku za utumishi wake zilipokamilika, aliondoka kwenda nyumbani kwake.
sw.B: Siku zake za huduma zilipokwisha, alirudi nyumbani.
sw.R: Muda wake wa kazi hekaluni ulipokwisha, Zakaria alirudi nyumbani.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 그의 직무의 날들이 다 차자, 그는 자기 집으로 떠나갔다.
ko.B: 사가랴는 성전에서 맡은 직무 기간이 끝나자 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 성전에서 일할 기간이 끝나자, 사가랴는 집으로 돌아갔다.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi những ngày phục vụ của ông đã mãn, ông trở về nhà mình.
vi.B: Khi hết những ngày phục vụ, ông trở về nhà.
vi.R: Khi hết phiên làm việc ở đền thờ, Xa-cha-ri trở về nhà.

decisions.choice: service: his priestly duty in the temple
decisions.reason: The word was used for public service and, in the Greek Old Testament, for the service of priests and Levites (Numbers 8:22). His week of duty (1:5) ended.

decisions.choice: his home: in the hill country of Judea
decisions.reason: Many priests lived outside Jerusalem and came to the city when their division served. Mary visits him in a town in the hill country of Judah (1:39).

decisions.choice: "그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다" (L) for Luke's "and it came to pass", through Luke 1-3
alternatives: leaving the phrase out at Literal
decisions.reason: Luke opens scenes with this Old Testament formula (meaning decision on 1:5). Literal keeps it as a short sentence of its own, as the Korean Mark 1:9 does, bracketing the word Korean needs; Balanced and Readable leave it out or use "한번은", "그때".

source.text: Μετὰ δὲ ταύτας τὰς ἡμέρας συνέλαβεν Ἐλισάβετ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ· καὶ περιέκρυβεν ἑαυτὴν μῆνας πέντε, λέγουσα ὅτι Οὕτως μοι πεποίηκεν κύριος ἐν ἡμέραις αἷς ἐπεῖδεν ἀφελεῖν ὄνειδός μου ἐν ἀνθρώποις.

records.literal_gloss: After then these the days conceived Elizabeth the wife of him; and she hid herself months five, saying, \v 25 Thus to me has done [the] Lord in days in which he looked upon to take away reproach of me among men.

en.L: And after these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she kept herself hidden five months, saying, \v 25 "Thus [the] Lord has done for me in [the] days when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looked upon [me] to take away my disgrace among {{gender:people|men}}."
en.B: After this his wife Elizabeth became pregnant, and for five months she stayed in seclusion. \v 25 "The Lord has done this for me," she said. "In these days {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has looked on me with favor and taken away my disgrace among {{gender:people|men}}."
en.R: Soon after that, Zechariah's wife Elizabeth became pregnant. For five months she did not go out where people could see her. \v 25 She said, "The Lord has done this for me! He has been kind to me. Now people will no longer look down on me."

es.L: Y después de estos días, Isabel, su esposa, concibió, y se mantuvo oculta cinco meses, diciendo: \v 25 «Esto ha hecho por mí [el] Señor en [los] días en que puso {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos [en mí] para quitar mi deshonra entre {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}».
es.B: Después de esto, su esposa Isabel quedó embarazada, y durante cinco meses se mantuvo recluida. \v 25 «El Señor ha hecho esto por mí», decía. «En estos días me ha mirado con favor y ha quitado mi deshonra ante {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}».
es.R: Poco después, Isabel, la esposa de Zacarías, quedó embarazada. Durante cinco meses no salió adonde la gente pudiera verla. \v 25 Ella decía: «¡El Señor ha hecho esto por mí! Ha sido bueno conmigo. Ahora la gente ya no me despreciará».

fr.L: Et après ces jours-là, Élisabeth sa femme conçut ; et elle se tint cachée cinq mois, disant : \v 25 « Ainsi le Seigneur a agi pour moi aux jours où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [m’]a regardée pour enlever ma honte parmi {{gender:les gens|les hommes}}. »
fr.B: Après cela, sa femme Élisabeth devint enceinte, et pendant cinq mois elle vécut retirée. \v 25 « Voilà ce que le Seigneur a fait pour moi, disait-elle. En ces jours, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé sur moi un regard favorable et a enlevé la honte qui pesait sur moi aux yeux {{gender:des gens|des hommes}}. »
fr.R: Peu après, Élisabeth, la femme de Zacharie, est tombée enceinte. Pendant cinq mois, elle n’est pas sortie là où les gens pouvaient la voir. \v 25 Elle disait : « C’est le Seigneur qui a fait cela pour moi ! Il a été bon pour moi. Maintenant, les gens ne me mépriseront plus. »

sw.L: Na baada ya siku hizi Elisabeti mke wake alipata mimba, naye akajificha miezi mitano, akisema, \v 25 "Bwana amenitendea hivi katika siku ambazo aliniangalia ili kuniondolea fedheha yangu kati ya watu."
sw.B: Baada ya hapo mkewe Elisabeti alipata mimba, akakaa faraghani kwa miezi mitano. \v 25 "Bwana amenifanyia jambo hili," alisema. "Siku hizi ameniangalia kwa fadhili na kuiondoa fedheha yangu mbele ya watu."
sw.R: Muda mfupi baadaye, Elisabeti, mke wa Zakaria, alipata mimba. Kwa miezi mitano hakutoka nje mahali watu wangeweza kumwona. \v 25 Alisema, "Bwana amenifanyia jambo hili! Amenitendea wema. Sasa watu hawatanidharau tena."

ko.L: 그리고 이 날들 뒤에 그의 아내 엘리사벳이 임신하였다. 그리고 그는 다섯 달 동안 자신을 숨기며 말했다. \v 25 "주님께서 나를 돌아보셔서 사람들 가운데서 내 부끄러움을 없애 주신 날들에, 나에게 이렇게 해 주셨다."
ko.B: 그 뒤에 사가랴의 아내 엘리사벳이 임신하였다. 그리고 다섯 달 동안 사람들 앞에 나서지 않고 지냈다. \v 25 엘리사벳이 말했다. "주님께서 나에게 이 일을 해 주셨다. 이제 주님께서 나를 돌아보셔서, 사람들 앞에서 내가 당하던 부끄러움을 없애 주셨다."
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 사가랴의 아내 엘리사벳이 임신하였다. 엘리사벳은 다섯 달 동안 사람들 눈에 띄는 곳에 나가지 않았다. \v 25 엘리사벳이 말했다. "주님께서 나에게 이렇게 해 주셨구나! 주님께서 나를 따뜻하게 돌보아 주셨다. 이제 사람들이 더는 나를 업신여기지 않을 것이다."

vi.L: Và sau những ngày ấy, Ê-li-sa-bét vợ ông thụ thai, và bà ẩn mình năm tháng, nói rằng: \v 25 "Chúa đã làm cho tôi như thế này trong những ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đoái xem [tôi], để cất đi sự hổ nhục của tôi giữa mọi người."
vi.B: Sau đó, Ê-li-sa-bét vợ ông có thai, và bà ở ẩn trong nhà suốt năm tháng. \v 25 Bà nói: "Chúa đã làm điều này cho tôi. Trong những ngày này {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đoái thương tôi và cất đi nỗi hổ thẹn của tôi giữa mọi người."
vi.R: Ít lâu sau, Ê-li-sa-bét, vợ của Xa-cha-ri, có thai. Suốt năm tháng bà không ra ngoài cho người ta thấy. \v 25 Bà nói: "Chúa đã làm điều này cho tôi! Ngài đã thương xót tôi. Từ nay người ta sẽ không còn khinh tôi nữa."

decisions.choice: she kept herself hidden five months: she stayed out of public view
alternatives: she was ashamed of the pregnancy
decisions.reason: Luke does not say why. Perhaps she waited until her pregnancy could be seen, so that people would believe what God had done; in 1:26 and 1:36 the sixth month becomes the sign given to Mary.

decisions.choice: to take away my disgrace: the words of Rachel at the birth of Joseph
decisions.reason: When God gave Rachel a son she said, "God has taken away my disgrace" (Genesis 30:23). Childlessness was seen as a shame; now God has ended it.

decisions.choice: looked upon: looked with favor and care
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God watching over someone to help (Acts 4:29).

decisions.choice: stayed in seclusion (B); did not go out where people could see her (R)
decisions.reason: "Hid herself" suggests fear. Balanced and Readable say what she did without suggesting a reason Luke does not give.

decisions.choice: {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: As in English and in John 1:4: Spanish has two wordings here, the inclusive "la gente" and the traditional "los hombres", so the gender setting applies.

decisions.choice: ma honte (L); la honte qui pesait sur moi (B)
decisions.reason: "Opprobre" is the traditional word but is now literary; "honte" is the everyday word for the disgrace of childlessness (m2).

decisions.choice: fedheha
decisions.reason: "Aibu" is any shame or embarrassment; "fedheha" is the public disgrace of being looked down on, which is what childlessness brought (meaning decisions m2 and m3). No gender span: "watu" already means people of either sex.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "people|men"; Korean "사람" already means human beings of either sex, so there is nothing for the setting to change, as in the Korean Mark 1:17.

decisions.choice: "giữa mọi người" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "mọi người" already includes men and women, and Vietnamese has no narrower form that would be the traditional alternative.

source.text: Ἐν δὲ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἕκτῳ ἀπεστάλη ὁ ἄγγελος Γαβριὴλ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας ᾗ ὄνομα Ναζαρὲθ πρὸς παρθένον ἐμνηστευμένην ἀνδρὶ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰωσὴφ ἐξ οἴκου Δαυὶδ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς παρθένου Μαριάμ.

records.literal_gloss: In then the month the sixth was sent the angel Gabriel from the God to a city of the Galilee to which name Nazareth \v 27 to a virgin betrothed to a man to whom name Joseph of house of David, and the name of the virgin Mary.

en.L: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, \v 27 to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name [was] Joseph, of [the] house of David, and the name of the virgin [was] Mary.
en.B: In the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent by God to Nazareth, a town of Galilee, \v 27 to a virgin who was engaged to Joseph, a man of the house of David. Her name was Mary.
en.R: When Elizabeth was in her sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee. \v 27 He was sent to a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to marry Joseph, who came from the family of King David.

es.L: Y en el mes sexto fue enviado el ángel Gabriel de parte de Dios a una ciudad de Galilea cuyo nombre [es] Nazaret, \v 27 a una virgen prometida en matrimonio a un hombre de nombre José, de [la] casa de David; y el nombre de la virgen [era] María.
es.B: En el sexto mes, el ángel Gabriel fue enviado por Dios a Nazaret, un pueblo de Galilea, \v 27 a una virgen que estaba comprometida para casarse con José, un hombre de la casa de David. Ella se llamaba María.
es.R: Cuando Isabel estaba en su sexto mes, Dios envió al ángel Gabriel al pueblo de Nazaret, en Galilea. \v 27 Lo envió a una virgen llamada María. Ella estaba comprometida para casarse con José, que era de la familia del rey David.

fr.L: Et au sixième mois, l’ange Gabriel fut envoyé de la part de Dieu dans une ville de Galilée nommée Nazareth, \v 27 vers une vierge fiancée à un homme dont le nom [était] Joseph, de la maison de David, et le nom de la vierge [était] Marie.
fr.B: Au sixième mois, Dieu envoya l’ange Gabriel à Nazareth, une ville de Galilée, \v 27 auprès d’une vierge qui était fiancée à Joseph, un homme de la maison de David. Elle s’appelait Marie.
fr.R: Élisabeth en était à son sixième mois quand Dieu a envoyé l’ange Gabriel au village de Nazareth, en Galilée. \v 27 L’ange a été envoyé chez une jeune fille vierge qui s’appelait Marie. Elle était fiancée à Joseph, qui descendait du roi David.

sw.L: Na katika mwezi wa sita malaika Gabrieli alitumwa kutoka kwa Mungu kwenda mji mmoja wa Galilaya uitwao Nazareti, \v 27 kwa bikira aliyechumbiwa na mwanamume aitwaye Yusufu, wa nyumba ya Daudi, na jina la yule bikira [lilikuwa] Mariamu.
sw.B: Katika mwezi wa sita, malaika Gabrieli alitumwa na Mungu kwenda Nazareti, mji mdogo wa Galilaya, \v 27 kwa bikira aliyekuwa amechumbiwa na Yusufu, mtu wa nyumba ya Daudi. Bikira huyo aliitwa Mariamu.
sw.R: Elisabeti alipokuwa katika mwezi wake wa sita, Mungu alimtuma malaika Gabrieli kwenda mji wa Nazareti huko Galilaya. \v 27 Alitumwa kwa bikira mmoja aitwaye Mariamu. Mariamu alikuwa amechumbiwa na Yusufu, aliyetoka katika ukoo wa Mfalme Daudi.

ko.L: 그리고 여섯째 달에 천사 가브리엘이 하나님께로부터 보내심을 받아, 나사렛이라는 갈릴리의 한 성읍으로, \v 27 다윗의 집안 출신으로 이름이 요셉인 한 남자와 약혼한 처녀에게 [갔다]. 그리고 그 처녀의 이름은 마리아였다.
ko.B: 여섯째 달에 하나님께서 천사 가브리엘을 갈릴리 지방의 나사렛이라는 마을로 보내셨다. \v 27 다윗 집안 사람인 요셉과 약혼한 처녀에게 보내신 것이다. 그 처녀의 이름은 마리아였다.
ko.R: 엘리사벳이 임신한 지 여섯 달째 되었을 때, 하나님께서 천사 가브리엘을 갈릴리 지방의 나사렛 마을로 보내셨다. \v 27 가브리엘은 마리아라는 처녀에게 보내졌다. 마리아는 요셉과 결혼하기로 약혼한 사이였다. 요셉은 다윗 왕의 집안 출신이었다.

vi.L: Và vào tháng thứ sáu, thiên sứ Gáp-ri-ên được Đức Chúa Trời sai đến một thành của xứ Ga-li-lê tên là Na-xa-rét, \v 27 đến với một trinh nữ đã đính hôn với một người tên là Giô-sép, thuộc nhà Đa-vít, và tên của trinh nữ ấy là Ma-ri.
vi.B: Vào tháng thứ sáu, Đức Chúa Trời sai thiên sứ Gáp-ri-ên đến Na-xa-rét, một thị trấn thuộc xứ Ga-li-lê, \v 27 gặp một trinh nữ đã đính hôn với Giô-sép, là người thuộc dòng dõi Đa-vít. Trinh nữ ấy tên là Ma-ri.
vi.R: Khi Ê-li-sa-bét có thai được sáu tháng, Đức Chúa Trời sai thiên sứ Gáp-ri-ên đến làng Na-xa-rét ở miền Ga-li-lê. \v 27 Thiên sứ được sai đến gặp một trinh nữ tên là Ma-ri. Cô đã đính hôn với Giô-sép, người thuộc dòng dõi vua Đa-vít.

decisions.choice: the sixth month: of Elizabeth's pregnancy
alternatives: the sixth month of the year
decisions.reason: The count follows from 1:24 and is confirmed in 1:36.

decisions.choice: Nazareth in Galilee: a small village in the north, far from Jerusalem and the temple
decisions.reason: The word can mean any town, large or small. Nazareth was an obscure village, never named in the Old Testament (compare John 1:46). The contrast with the temple scene of 1:8-23 is deliberate.

decisions.choice: virgin: a young woman who has not had sexual relations
alternatives: a young woman of marriageable age, with no claim about virginity
decisions.reason: The word can mean a young unmarried woman, but its usual sense is a virgin, and Mary's own question in 1:34 makes that the meaning here. Luke says it twice.

decisions.choice: betrothed: legally pledged to marry, but not yet living together
decisions.reason: A Jewish betrothal was a binding contract that only divorce could end (compare Matthew 1:18-19). The bride usually stayed in her father's house for up to a year before the wedding.

decisions.choice: of the house of David: Joseph's descent
decisions.reason: The phrase stands next to Joseph's name. Luke traces Jesus's royal line through Joseph, his legal father (2:4; 3:23), as the angel's promise of David's throne requires (1:32).

decisions.choice: engaged
decisions.reason: "Betrothed" is an old word. "Engaged" is the nearest modern word, and the meaning decision says how much more binding it was.

decisions.choice: When Elizabeth was in her sixth month
decisions.reason: Readable says whose sixth month it was (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: prometida en matrimonio (L); comprometida para casarse (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Desposada" is old and is now often taken to mean already married. Meaning decision m4 says the couple were legally pledged but not yet living together, which these words say.

decisions.choice: aliyechumbiwa
decisions.reason: Both words describe a woman pledged to marry. "Kuchumbiwa" is the everyday word for being engaged and cannot be taken to mean already married; meaning decision m4 says the couple were legally pledged but not yet living together.

decisions.choice: "처녀"; "약혼한" for betrothed, at every level
decisions.reason: "약혼하다" is the current word for a pledge to marry, which in that culture was legally binding (meaning decision); "정혼" is old-fashioned. Literal brackets the verb "[갔다]" that Korean needs to end the clause.

decisions.choice: Mary is "cô" in the narrative and in the angel's address (1:28-38)
decisions.reason: "cô" is the respectful word for a young unmarried woman. "nàng" is literary and old-fashioned; "bà" suits a married or older woman, as Elizabeth is.

decisions.choice: "đã đính hôn" for betrothed
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says she was legally pledged but not yet living with Joseph; "đính hôn" is the formal engagement, which Vietnamese readers also take as binding. Used again in 2:5.

source.text: καὶ εἰσελθὼν πρὸς αὐτὴν εἶπεν· Χαῖρε, κεχαριτωμένη, ὁ κύριος μετὰ σοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And having come in to her he said, Rejoice, having been favored [one], the Lord with you.

en.L: And coming in to her, he said, "Greetings, you who have been favored! The Lord [is] with you."
en.B: He came to her and said, "Greetings! God has shown you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} favor. The Lord is with you."
en.R: The angel went to her and said, "Greetings! God has been very kind to you. The Lord is with you."

es.L: Y entrando adonde ella [estaba], dijo: «¡Te saludo, tú que has sido favorecida! El Señor [está] contigo».
es.B: Entró adonde ella estaba y le dijo: «¡Te saludo! Dios te ha mostrado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} favor. El Señor está contigo».
es.R: El ángel fue adonde ella estaba y le dijo: «¡Te saludo! Dios ha sido muy bueno contigo. El Señor está contigo».

fr.L: Et entrant auprès d’elle, il dit : « Je te salue, toi qui as été favorisée ! Le Seigneur [est] avec toi. »
fr.B: Il entra chez elle et dit : « Je te salue ! Dieu t’a accordé {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} faveur. Le Seigneur est avec toi. »
fr.R: L’ange est allé chez elle et lui a dit : « Je te salue ! Dieu a été très bon pour toi. Le Seigneur est avec toi. »

sw.L: Naye alipoingia kwake, akasema, "Salamu, wewe uliyefadhiliwa! Bwana [yuko] pamoja nawe."
sw.B: Malaika akamwendea akasema, "Salamu! Mungu amekuonyesha fadhili {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Bwana yuko pamoja nawe."
sw.R: Malaika akamwendea, akamwambia, "Salamu! Mungu amekutendea wema mkubwa. Bwana yuko pamoja nawe."

ko.L: 그리고 [천사가] 그 여자에게 들어가서 말했다. "기뻐하여라, 은혜를 입은 사람아! 주님께서 너와 함께 [계신다]."
ko.B: 천사가 마리아에게 와서 말했다. "기뻐하여라! 하나님께서 너에게 은혜를 베푸셨다. 주님께서 너와 함께 계신다."
ko.R: 천사가 마리아에게 가서 말했다. "기뻐하여라! 하나님께서 너에게 큰 은혜를 베푸셨다. 주님께서 너와 함께 계신다."

vi.L: Và đi vào chỗ cô, thiên sứ nói: "Chào cô, người đã được ban ân điển! Chúa ở cùng cô."
vi.B: Thiên sứ đến với cô và nói: "Chào cô! Đức Chúa Trời đã ban ân điển cho cô. Chúa ở cùng cô."
vi.R: Thiên sứ đến gặp cô và nói: "Chào cô! Đức Chúa Trời đã ban ơn lớn cho cô. Chúa ở cùng cô."

decisions.choice: greetings: the ordinary greeting, with an undertone of "rejoice"
decisions.reason: The word was the everyday Greek greeting, literally "rejoice". The prophets used it to call Zion to rejoice at God's coming (Zephaniah 3:14; Zechariah 9:9 in the Greek), and joy runs through this chapter, so some hear more than a greeting.

decisions.choice: favored one: one to whom God has shown grace
alternatives: full of grace, a fullness of grace she has to give
decisions.reason: The verb means to show grace or favor to someone; Ephesians 1:6 uses it of God's grace to all believers. The perfect participle says God has favored her. The Latin Vulgate's "full of grace" is not what the Greek says.

decisions.choice: the Lord is with you: a statement of God's presence
alternatives: a wish, "may the Lord be with you"
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. With an angel's announcement it is a statement, as when the angel greets Gideon (Judges 6:12).

decisions.choice: the greeting ends with "with you", the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: many later manuscripts add "blessed are you among women"
decisions.reason: The added words come from Elizabeth's greeting in 1:42. Early manuscripts do not have them here. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: God has shown you his favor (B); God has been very kind to you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who has favored her and what the title means.

decisions.choice: ¡Te saludo! ... has sido favorecida
decisions.reason: The Greek word was the everyday greeting, with an undertone of "rejoice" (meaning decision m1); "te saludo" keeps it a greeting. "Llena de gracia" comes from the Latin tradition; the Greek participle says that God has shown her favor (m2), which is what these words say.

decisions.choice: Je te salue
decisions.reason: The word was the ordinary greeting, with an undertone of joy that is uncertain (m1). "Je te salue" is the formal French greeting; "Salut" would sound casual today, and "Réjouis-toi" would make the undertone the main sense. Gabriel says "tu" to Mary, as to Zechariah, following the Greek singular.

decisions.choice: Salamu ... uliyefadhiliwa (L); Mungu amekuonyesha fadhili zake (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek greeting was the everyday "greetings", with an undertone of "rejoice" (meaning decision m1); "Salamu" keeps it a greeting. "Kufadhiliwa" is to be shown favor and kindness, which is what the Greek participle says God has done (m2), without making her the source of grace.

decisions.choice: "기뻐하여라" for the greeting, at every level; "은혜" for the favor shown
decisions.reason: The greeting is ordinary but carries the sense "rejoice" (meaning decision). Korean greetings ("안녕") carry nothing of it, and an angel greeting with "안녕하냐" would sound casual, so every level keeps "기뻐하여라", which still works as an opening call. The verb is built on the word for grace, so "은혜" keeps the link.

decisions.choice: "Chào cô" for the greeting
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the ordinary greeting, with an undertone of "rejoice". "Chào" is the ordinary greeting; "Mừng" would echo the Catholic "Kính mừng" and the Ave Maria tradition.

decisions.choice: "được ban ân điển" (L, B); "đã ban ơn lớn" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is formed from the word for grace, so Literal and Balanced use the key term "ân điển". "đầy ân sủng" is the Catholic phrase and reads the verb as a state of fullness, which the meaning decision does not.

source.text: ἡ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ διεταράχθη καὶ διελογίζετο ποταπὸς εἴη ὁ ἀσπασμὸς οὗτος.

records.literal_gloss: She and at the word was greatly troubled and was considering what kind might be the greeting this.

en.L: But she was greatly troubled at the statement, and she was considering what kind of greeting this might be.
en.B: His words disturbed her deeply, and she kept asking herself what such a greeting could mean.
en.R: Mary was very upset by what the angel said. She wondered what this greeting could mean.

es.L: Pero ella ante la palabra quedó muy turbada, y consideraba qué clase de saludo podría ser este.
es.B: Sus palabras la perturbaron profundamente, y se preguntaba qué podía significar semejante saludo.
es.R: María se inquietó mucho por lo que le dijo el ángel. Se preguntaba qué querría decir ese saludo.

fr.L: Mais elle, à cette parole, fut toute bouleversée, et elle se demandait de quelle sorte pouvait être cette salutation.
fr.B: Ces paroles la bouleversèrent profondément, et elle se demandait ce que voulait dire une pareille salutation.
fr.R: Marie a été très troublée par ce que l’ange avait dit. Elle se demandait ce que voulait dire cette salutation.

sw.L: Lakini yeye alifadhaika sana kwa neno hilo, akawa akitafakari salamu hii ingekuwa ya aina gani.
sw.B: Maneno yake yalimtia wasiwasi mwingi, naye akaendelea kujiuliza salamu kama hiyo ingeweza kumaanisha nini.
sw.R: Mariamu alifadhaika sana kwa yale malaika aliyosema. Alijiuliza salamu hiyo ilimaanisha nini.

ko.L: 그러나 그 여자는 그 말에 몹시 당황하여, 이 인사가 어떤 [인사]일까 하고 곰곰이 생각하고 있었다.
ko.B: 마리아는 그 말을 듣고 몹시 당황하여, 이 인사가 대체 무슨 뜻일까 하고 계속 생각했다.
ko.R: 마리아는 천사의 말을 듣고 몹시 놀랐다. 그리고 이 인사가 무슨 뜻일까 생각했다.

vi.L: Nhưng cô rất bối rối về lời ấy, và cứ suy nghĩ không biết lời chào này là thế nào.
vi.B: Lời ấy làm cô vô cùng xao xuyến, và cô cứ tự hỏi lời chào như vậy có nghĩa là gì.
vi.R: Ma-ri rất bối rối vì lời thiên sứ nói. Cô tự hỏi lời chào này có nghĩa gì.

decisions.choice: greatly troubled: thoroughly shaken
alternatives: frightened only by the sight of the angel
decisions.reason: The verb is stronger than the one used of Zechariah (1:12). Luke says she was troubled by the words, not by the sight.

decisions.choice: she was considering: she kept thinking it over
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense shows an ongoing, inward reflection, as in 2:19 and 2:51.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτῇ· Μὴ φοβοῦ, Μαριάμ, εὗρες γὰρ χάριν παρὰ τῷ θεῷ·

records.literal_gloss: And said the angel to her, Not fear, Mary, you found for grace with the God;

en.L: And the angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found grace with God.
en.B: The angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary. You have found favor with God.
en.R: The angel told her, "Mary, do not be afraid. God is pleased with you.

es.L: Y el ángel le dijo: «No temas, María, pues hallaste gracia ante Dios.
es.B: El ángel le dijo: «No tengas miedo, María. Has hallado el favor de Dios.
es.R: El ángel le dijo: «María, no tengas miedo. Dios está contento contigo.

fr.L: Et l’ange lui dit : « Ne crains pas, Marie, car tu as trouvé grâce auprès de Dieu.
fr.B: L’ange lui dit : « N’aie pas peur, Marie. Tu as trouvé grâce auprès de Dieu.
fr.R: L’ange lui a dit : « Marie, n’aie pas peur. Dieu est content de toi.

sw.L: Na malaika akamwambia, "Usiogope, Mariamu, kwa kuwa umepata neema mbele ya Mungu.
sw.B: Malaika akamwambia, "Usiogope, Mariamu. Umepata kibali kwa Mungu.
sw.R: Malaika akamwambia, "Mariamu, usiogope. Mungu amependezwa nawe.

ko.L: 그러자 천사가 그 여자에게 말했다. "두려워하지 마라, 마리아. 네가 하나님께 은혜를 입었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 천사가 마리아에게 말했다. "마리아, 두려워하지 마라. 너는 하나님께 은혜를 입었다.
ko.R: 천사가 말했다. "마리아, 무서워하지 마라. 하나님께서 너를 기쁘게 여기신다.

vi.L: Và thiên sứ nói với cô: "Đừng sợ, Ma-ri, vì cô đã được ân điển trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Thiên sứ nói với cô: "Ma-ri, đừng sợ. Cô đã được ân điển trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Thiên sứ bảo cô: "Ma-ri, đừng sợ. Đức Chúa Trời đã tỏ ân điển cho cô.

decisions.choice: you have found grace with God: God looks on you with favor
decisions.reason: An Old Testament phrase for being accepted by God (Genesis 6:8, of Noah). The favor is God's free gift, as "favored one" in 1:28 says.

decisions.choice: favor (B); God is pleased with you (R); grace (L)
decisions.reason: The key term is "grace", and Literal keeps it. But "found grace with" is not natural English; "found favor with" is the English idiom for the same thing. Readable says plainly what it means.

decisions.choice: tu as trouvé grâce auprès de Dieu (L, B)
alternatives: tu as trouvé faveur auprès de Dieu (B), as the English Balanced "favor"
decisions.reason: English Balanced says "favor" because "found grace with" is not English. "Trouver grâce auprès de quelqu’un" is a living French idiom with the same meaning, so Balanced can keep the key term "grâce" as well as Literal. Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "은혜를 입었다" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "은혜를 입다" is the natural Korean for finding favor, and keeps the key term "은혜" for grace at Literal and Balanced, where the English Balanced says "favor". Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ân điển" at every level, Readable included
alternatives: "Đức Chúa Trời hài lòng về cô" (R)
decisions.reason: Grace is a key term and keeps one word at every level (style guide section 5). The English Balanced and Readable say "favor" and "pleased"; Vietnamese "được ân điển trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời" is natural, so the key term can stay.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ συλλήμψῃ ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.

records.literal_gloss: And behold you will conceive in womb and will bear a son, and you will call the name of him Jesus.

en.L: And look, you will conceive in [your] womb and give birth to a son, and you will call {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name Jesus.
en.B: You will become pregnant and have a son, and you are to give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the name Jesus.
en.R: You will become pregnant and have a baby boy. You must name {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} Jesus.

es.L: Y mira, concebirás en [tu] vientre y darás a luz un hijo, y llamarás {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre Jesús.
es.B: Quedarás embarazada y tendrás un hijo, y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pondrás por nombre Jesús.
es.R: Vas a quedar embarazada y tendrás un niño. Tú {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pondrás por nombre Jesús.

fr.L: Et voici, tu concevras dans [ton] ventre et tu enfanteras un fils, et tu appelleras {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom Jésus.
fr.B: Tu vas être enceinte et tu mettras au monde un fils, et tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} donneras le nom de Jésus.
fr.R: Tu vas être enceinte et avoir un petit garçon. Tu devras {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appeler Jésus.

sw.L: Na tazama, utashika mimba tumboni na kuzaa mwana, nawe utaliita jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} Yesu.
sw.B: Utapata mimba na kuzaa mtoto wa kiume, nawe utampa jina Yesu.
sw.R: Utapata mimba na kuzaa mtoto wa kiume. Lazima umpe jina Yesu.

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 너는 태에 임신하여 아들을 낳을 것이다. 그리고 너는 그분의 이름을 예수라고 부를 것이다.
ko.B: 너는 임신하여 아들을 낳을 것이다. 그 아들의 이름을 예수라고 하여라.
ko.R: 너는 임신해서 아들을 낳을 것이다. 그 아기의 이름을 예수라고 지어라.

vi.L: Và này, cô sẽ thụ thai trong lòng và sinh một con trai, và cô sẽ đặt tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Giê-xu.
vi.B: Cô sẽ mang thai và sinh một con trai, và cô hãy đặt tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Giê-xu.
vi.R: Cô sẽ có thai và sinh một bé trai. Cô phải đặt tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Giê-xu.

decisions.choice: conceive and bear a son: an echo of Isaiah 7:14
decisions.reason: The words are close to Isaiah 7:14 in the Greek, which Matthew quotes (Matthew 1:23). Luke does not quote it but the virgin of 1:27 and these words recall it.

decisions.choice: you will call his name Jesus: the name is given by God
decisions.reason: Jesus is the Greek form of Joshua, "the LORD saves". As with John (1:13), God chooses the name. Here Mary is told to give it; in Matthew 1:21 Joseph is.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: "Giê-xu" without "Đức" where the name is given
decisions.reason: The angel gives the name itself, so the bare name is right; in the narrative he is "Đức Giê-xu" (2:52; 3:21).

decisions.choice: The promised child is "{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}" with the setting span
decisions.reason: The English gives the child the deity_pronoun setting; Vietnamese uses the narrator's pronoun for Jesus, which Vietnamese Christians use of him from his birth.

source.text: οὗτος ἔσται μέγας καὶ υἱὸς Ὑψίστου κληθήσεται, καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὸν θρόνον Δαυὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ βασιλεύσει ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰακὼβ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, καὶ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔσται τέλος.

records.literal_gloss: This will be great and son of Most High will be called, and will give to him [the] Lord the God the throne of David the father of him, \v 33 and he will reign over the house of Jacob to the ages, and of the kingdom of him not will be an end.

en.L: He will be great and will be called Son of [the] Most High, and [the] Lord God will give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the throne of David {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} father, \v 33 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom there will be no end."
en.B: He will be great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be called Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the throne of David, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} forefather, \v 33 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be king over the house of Jacob for all ages. There will be no end to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom."
en.R: He will be great. People will call {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} king, as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ancestor David was. \v 33 He will rule over the people of Israel forever, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} kingdom will never end."

es.L: Este será grande y será llamado Hijo del Altísimo, y [el] Señor Dios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dará el trono de David, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} padre, \v 33 y reinará sobre la casa de Jacob por los siglos, y de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino no habrá fin».
es.B: Él será grande, y será llamado Hijo del Altísimo. El Señor Dios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dará el trono de David, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} antepasado, \v 33 y será rey sobre la casa de Jacob por todos los siglos. No habrá fin para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino».
es.R: Será grande. La gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llamará Hijo del Dios Altísimo. El Señor Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hará rey, como lo fue David, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} antepasado. \v 33 Reinará sobre el pueblo de Israel para siempre, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reino nunca terminará».

fr.L: Celui-ci sera grand et sera appelé Fils du Très-Haut, et le Seigneur Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} donnera le trône de David {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} père, \v 33 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} régnera sur la maison de Jacob pour les siècles, et de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} royaume il n’y aura pas de fin. »
fr.B: Il sera grand, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera appelé Fils du Très-Haut. Le Seigneur Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} donnera le trône de David, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ancêtre, \v 33 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} régnera sur la maison de Jacob pour toujours. Son royaume sera sans fin. »
fr.R: Il sera grand. On {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellera le Fils de Dieu, le Très-Haut. Le Seigneur Dieu fera de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un roi, comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} ancêtre David. \v 33 Il régnera pour toujours sur le peuple d’Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} royaume ne finira jamais. »

sw.L: Huyu atakuwa mkuu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Aliye Juu Sana, na Bwana Mungu atampa kiti cha enzi cha Daudi baba {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 33 naye atatawala juu ya nyumba ya Yakobo hata milele, wala hakutakuwa na mwisho wa ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}."
sw.B: Atakuwa mkuu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Aliye Juu Sana. Bwana Mungu atampa kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, babu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 33 naye atakuwa mfalme juu ya nyumba ya Yakobo milele yote. Ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hautakoma kamwe."
sw.R: Atakuwa mkuu. Watu watamwita Mwana wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana. Bwana Mungu atamfanya mfalme, kama babu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} Daudi alivyokuwa. \v 33 Atawatawala watu wa Israeli milele, na ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hautakwisha kamwe."

ko.L: 그분은 크신 분이 될 것이며, 지극히 높으신 분의 아들이라고 불리실 것이다. 그리고 주 하나님께서 그분께 그분의 조상 다윗의 왕좌를 주실 것이다. \v 33 그리고 그분은 야곱의 집을 영원히 다스리실 것이며, 그분의 나라는 끝이 없을 것이다."
ko.B: 그분은 위대한 분이 되실 것이고, 지극히 높으신 분의 아들이라 불리실 것이다. 주 하나님께서 그분께 그분의 조상 다윗의 왕위를 주실 것이다. \v 33 그분은 야곱의 집안을 영원히 다스리실 것이며, 그분의 나라는 끝이 없을 것이다."
ko.R: 그분은 위대한 분이 되실 것이다. 사람들은 그분을 지극히 높으신 하나님의 아들이라고 부를 것이다. 주 하나님께서 그분을 왕으로 세우셔서, 그분의 조상 다윗처럼 왕이 되게 하실 것이다. \v 33 그분은 이스라엘 백성을 영원히 다스리실 것이고, 그분의 나라는 결코 끝나지 않을 것이다."

vi.L: Ngài sẽ nên cao trọng và sẽ được gọi là Con của Đấng Chí Cao, và Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngôi của Đa-vít, cha {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 33 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ trị vì nhà Gia-cốp đời đời, và vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không có cuối cùng."
vi.B: Ngài sẽ nên cao trọng và sẽ được gọi là Con của Đấng Chí Cao. Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngôi vua của Đa-vít, tổ phụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 33 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm vua cai trị nhà Gia-cốp mãi mãi. Vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt."
vi.R: Ngài sẽ là Đấng vĩ đại. Người ta sẽ gọi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Con của Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao. Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời sẽ lập {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm vua, như Đa-vít, tổ tiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đã làm vua. \v 33 Ngài sẽ cai trị dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đời đời, và vương quốc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bao giờ chấm dứt."

decisions.choice: the throne of David ... no end: God's promise to David in 2 Samuel 7
decisions.reason: God promised David a son whose throne and kingdom would last forever, and said, "I will be his father, and he will be my son" (2 Samuel 7:12-16; compare Isaiah 9:7). The angel says Jesus is that king.

decisions.choice: Son of the Most High: a title for the promised king, and more
alternatives: a title for any godly person
decisions.reason: "The Most High" is a name for God (Genesis 14:18-20). In the setting of 2 Samuel 7 the title marks the royal son; 1:35 explains that Jesus is God's Son in a deeper way, by his conception.

decisions.choice: David his father: his ancestor
alternatives: his father in the ordinary sense
decisions.reason: "Father" often means ancestor. Jesus is of David's line through Joseph (1:27).

decisions.choice: the house of Jacob: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Jacob, also named Israel, was the father of the twelve tribes.

decisions.choice: he: "this one", the son just named
decisions.reason: The pronoun points to the son of 1:31. Of John the angel said he would be great "before the Lord" (1:15); of Jesus he says simply "great", and names him Son of the Most High.

decisions.choice: forefather
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that "father" means ancestor here.

decisions.choice: make him king, as his ancestor David was; the people of Israel
alternatives: give him the throne of David his father; the house of Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pictures mean.

decisions.choice: le Très-Haut (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: The traditional French title, capitalised and hyphenated. French needs the article after "de" ("Fils du Très-Haut"), so Literal adds it without brackets. Readable says "Dieu, le Très-Haut" where the English Readable says "God Most High".

decisions.choice: Celui-ci (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek points to the son just named (m5); Literal keeps the demonstrative, which in French needs no span because it is not a personal pronoun.

decisions.choice: Aliye Juu Sana
decisions.reason: The Greek is a superlative used as a name for God, "the Highest". "Aliye Juu Sana" (the One who is most high) carries the superlative; the same title returns in 1:35 and 1:76.

decisions.choice: babu yake (B, R); baba yake (L)
decisions.reason: David lived about a thousand years earlier (meaning decision m3). Literal keeps "baba" (father) as the Greek has it; Balanced and Readable say "babu" (forefather), as the English says "forefather" and "ancestor".

decisions.choice: the angel speaks of the coming son with the honorific ("그분", "불리실", "다스리실"), through Luke 1-2; "지극히 높으신 분" for the Most High
decisions.reason: The child is the Son of the Most High and the promised king (meaning decision), so the angel refers to him respectfully, as John the Baptist speaks of the one coming after him in the Korean Mark 1:7. "지극히 높으신" is the title used in the Korean Mark 5:7.

decisions.choice: "그분의 조상 다윗" at every level, Literal included
decisions.reason: Korean "아버지" means only one's own father and would here suggest Joseph; the Greek "father" means ancestor (meaning decision), and "조상" says that.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Chí Cao" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao" (R)
decisions.reason: Mark 5:7 has "Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao"; "Chí Cao" is kept for the title through Luke 1, and Readable names God as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "cha" (L); "tổ phụ" (B); "tổ tiên" (R) for David "his father"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek word; the meaning decision says David is his ancestor, which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc" for kingdom
decisions.reason: As in Mark ("vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời") and Colossians.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριὰμ πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον· Πῶς ἔσται τοῦτο, ἐπεὶ ἄνδρα οὐ γινώσκω;

records.literal_gloss: Said then Mary to the angel, How will be this, since a man not I know?

en.L: And Mary said to the angel, "How will this be, since I do not know a man?"
en.B: Mary said to the angel, "How can this happen? I have never been with a man."
en.R: Mary asked the angel, "How can this happen? I am a virgin."

es.L: Y María dijo al ángel: «¿Cómo será esto, dado que yo no conozco hombre?».
es.B: María le dijo al ángel: «¿Cómo podrá suceder esto? Nunca he estado con un hombre».
es.R: María le preguntó al ángel: «¿Cómo puede pasar esto? Soy virgen».

fr.L: Et Marie dit à l’ange : « Comment en sera-t-il ainsi, puisque je ne connais pas d’homme ? »
fr.B: Marie dit à l’ange : « Comment est-ce possible ? Je n’ai jamais eu de relations avec un homme. »
fr.R: Marie a demandé à l’ange : « Comment est-ce que cela peut arriver ? Je suis vierge. »

sw.L: Naye Mariamu akamwambia malaika, "Hili litakuwaje, kwa kuwa mimi simjui mwanamume?"
sw.B: Mariamu akamwambia malaika, "Jambo hili litawezekanaje? Sijawahi kukutana na mwanamume."
sw.R: Mariamu akamwuliza malaika, "Jambo hili litawezekanaje? Mimi ni bikira."

ko.L: 그러자 마리아가 천사에게 말했다. "제가 남자를 알지 못하는데, 어떻게 이 일이 있겠습니까?"
ko.B: 마리아가 천사에게 말했다. "어떻게 그런 일이 있을 수 있습니까? 저는 남자를 가까이한 적이 없습니다."
ko.R: 마리아가 천사에게 물었다. "어떻게 그런 일이 일어날 수 있습니까? 저는 처녀입니다."

vi.L: Và Ma-ri nói với thiên sứ: "Điều này sẽ xảy ra thế nào, vì tôi không biết người nam?"
vi.B: Ma-ri hỏi thiên sứ: "Việc ấy xảy ra thế nào được, vì tôi chưa hề ăn ở với người nam nào?"
vi.R: Ma-ri hỏi thiên sứ: "Làm sao điều này xảy ra được? Tôi vẫn còn là trinh nữ mà."

decisions.choice: I do not know a man: I have not had sexual relations with a man
alternatives: I am not acquainted with any man
decisions.reason: "Know" is the Hebrew way of speaking of sexual union (Genesis 4:1; Matthew 1:25). Mary says she is a virgin.

decisions.choice: how will this be: a question about the way it will happen, not a doubt
alternatives: a request for proof like Zechariah's
decisions.reason: Zechariah asked how he could know (1:18) and was silenced; Mary asks how it will come about, and the angel explains (1:35). Elizabeth praises her for believing (1:45).

decisions.choice: since I do not know a man: she is a virgin, and the promise is for now, before her marriage
alternatives: a vow never to have relations with a man
decisions.reason: Mary is engaged to Joseph (1:27), so a child after the wedding would raise no question. She understands the angel to mean that she will conceive before she lives with Joseph. The present tense states her condition; it does not imply a vow.

decisions.choice: I have never been with a man (B); I am a virgin (R)
alternatives: I do not know a man
decisions.reason: In English "know" does not carry the Hebrew sense; Balanced and Readable say what Mary means.

decisions.choice: "chưa hề ăn ở với người nam nào" (B)
decisions.reason: "ăn ở với" is the plain, modest Vietnamese way of saying sexual relations, as the meaning decision explains the idiom; Literal keeps "biết".

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Πνεῦμα ἅγιον ἐπελεύσεται ἐπὶ σέ, καὶ δύναμις Ὑψίστου ἐπισκιάσει σοι· διὸ καὶ τὸ γεννώμενον ἅγιον κληθήσεται, υἱὸς θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: And answering the angel said to her, [The] Spirit Holy will come upon you, and power of Most High will overshadow you; therefore also the being born holy will be called, son of God;

en.L: And answering, the angel said to her, "[The] Holy Spirit will come upon you, and [the] power of [the] Most High will overshadow you; therefore also the holy one being born will be called Son of God.
en.B: The angel answered her, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will cover you with its shadow. So the child to be born will be holy, and will be called the Son of God.
en.R: The angel answered, "The Holy Spirit will come to you, and the power of God Most High will cover you like a cloud. So the baby will be holy. He will be called the Son of God.

es.L: Y respondiendo, el ángel le dijo: «[El] Espíritu Santo vendrá sobre ti, y [el] poder del Altísimo extenderá su sombra sobre ti; por eso también el santo que está naciendo será llamado Hijo de Dios.
es.B: El ángel le respondió: «El Espíritu Santo vendrá sobre ti, y el poder del Altísimo te envolverá con su sombra. Por eso el niño que va a nacer será santo, y será llamado Hijo de Dios.
es.R: El ángel le respondió: «El Espíritu Santo vendrá a ti, y el poder del Dios Altísimo te cubrirá como una nube. Por eso el niño será santo. Será llamado Hijo de Dios.

fr.L: Et répondant, l’ange lui dit : « L’Esprit Saint viendra sur toi, et la puissance du Très-Haut étendra son ombre sur toi ; c’est pourquoi aussi le saint qui va naître sera appelé Fils de Dieu.
fr.B: L’ange lui répondit : « L’Esprit Saint viendra sur toi, et la puissance du Très-Haut reposera sur toi comme une ombre. C’est pourquoi l’enfant qui va naître sera saint, et on {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellera Fils de Dieu.
fr.R: L’ange lui a répondu : « L’Esprit Saint viendra sur toi, et la puissance de Dieu, le Très-Haut, se posera sur toi comme un nuage. Alors le bébé sera saint. On {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}appellera le Fils de Dieu.

sw.L: Na malaika akajibu akamwambia, "Roho Mtakatifu atakuja juu yako, na uweza wa Aliye Juu Sana utakutia kivulini; kwa hiyo pia yule mtakatifu atakayezaliwa ataitwa Mwana wa Mungu.
sw.B: Malaika akamjibu, "Roho Mtakatifu atakushukia, na uweza wa Aliye Juu Sana utakufunika kwa kivuli chake. Kwa hiyo mtoto atakayezaliwa atakuwa mtakatifu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Mungu.
sw.R: Malaika akajibu, "Roho Mtakatifu atakujia, na uweza wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana utakufunika kama wingu. Kwa hiyo mtoto huyo atakuwa mtakatifu. Ataitwa Mwana wa Mungu.

ko.L: 그러자 천사가 대답하여 그 여자에게 말했다. "성령께서 너에게 임하시고, 지극히 높으신 분의 능력이 너를 덮어 그늘지게 할 것이다. 그러므로 태어날 거룩한 이는 하나님의 아들이라고 불리실 것이다.
ko.B: 천사가 대답했다. "성령께서 너에게 임하시고, 지극히 높으신 분의 능력이 그늘처럼 너를 덮을 것이다. 그러므로 태어날 아기는 거룩한 분이시며, 하나님의 아들이라고 불리실 것이다.
ko.R: 천사가 대답했다. "성령께서 너에게 오실 것이다. 지극히 높으신 하나님의 능력이 구름처럼 너를 덮을 것이다. 그래서 태어날 아기는 거룩하시다. 그분은 하나님의 아들이라고 불리실 것이다.

vi.L: Và thiên sứ đáp lời cô: "Đức Thánh Linh sẽ đến trên cô, và quyền năng của Đấng Chí Cao sẽ che phủ cô; vì vậy, Đấng thánh sẽ được sinh ra cũng sẽ được gọi là Con của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Thiên sứ đáp: "Đức Thánh Linh sẽ đến trên cô, và quyền năng của Đấng Chí Cao sẽ bao phủ cô như bóng che. Vì thế, con trẻ sẽ sinh ra là thánh, và sẽ được gọi là Con của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Thiên sứ trả lời: "Đức Thánh Linh sẽ đến với cô, và quyền năng của Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao sẽ bao phủ cô như một đám mây. Vì vậy, em bé ấy sẽ là thánh. Ngài sẽ được gọi là Con của Đức Chúa Trời.

decisions.choice: overshadow: God's presence resting on her, as the cloud rested on the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the cloud of God's glory that covered the tabernacle (Exodus 40:35 in the Greek) and of the cloud at the transfiguration (9:34). Nothing in it suggests a physical union; the child comes from God's creative power.

decisions.choice: the child to be born will be called holy, the Son of God
alternatives: the holy one to be born will be called the Son of God
decisions.reason: "Holy" can go with "the one being born" (the holy child) or be what he will be called. Both are possible; either way he is holy and the Son of God. Balanced and Readable make "holy" a statement about the child; Literal keeps the Greek order.

decisions.choice: therefore: because his conception is the work of God's Spirit, he will be called God's Son
alternatives: he becomes Son of God only because of this birth
decisions.reason: The angel gives a reason linked to how he will be conceived. Luke does not say this is the only sense in which Jesus is God's Son (compare 3:22; 10:22).

decisions.choice: the one being born, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: some manuscripts add "of you": the one born of you
decisions.reason: A few manuscripts add "of you". Most early manuscripts do not. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: cover you with its shadow (B); cover you like a cloud (R)
decisions.reason: "Overshadow" in English usually means to outshine. Balanced and Readable keep the picture of a shadow or cloud resting on her.

decisions.choice: God Most High
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that "the Most High" is God.

decisions.choice: étendra son ombre sur toi (L); reposera sur toi comme une ombre (B); se posera sur toi comme un nuage (R)
decisions.reason: The picture is of God's presence resting on her, as the cloud rested on the tent of meeting (m1). Each level keeps the shadow or the cloud; "son ombre" belongs to the power, not to God, so it carries no span.

decisions.choice: "덮어 그늘지게 하다" (L); "그늘처럼 덮다" (B); "구름처럼 덮다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures God's presence resting like the cloud over the tent of meeting (meaning decision). Literal uses the words of the Korean Mark 9:7, where the same verb describes the cloud, so the link stays visible.

decisions.choice: "bao phủ cô như bóng che" (B); "bao phủ cô như một đám mây" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision points to the cloud resting on the tent of meeting; Balanced keeps the shadow, Readable names the cloud, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἐλισάβετ ἡ συγγενίς σου καὶ αὐτὴ συνείληφεν υἱὸν ἐν γήρει αὐτῆς, καὶ οὗτος μὴν ἕκτος ἐστὶν αὐτῇ τῇ καλουμένῃ στείρᾳ·

records.literal_gloss: And behold Elizabeth the relative of you also she has conceived a son in old age of her, and this month sixth is to her the [one] called barren;

en.L: And look, Elizabeth your relative, she too has conceived a son in her old age, and this is [the] sixth month for her who was called barren.
en.B: Your relative Elizabeth, too, has conceived a son in her old age. People called her barren, yet this is her sixth month.
en.R: Your relative Elizabeth is very old, and people said she could never have a baby. But she is going to have a son, and she is already six months pregnant.

es.L: Y mira, Isabel, tu pariente, también ella ha concebido un hijo en su ancianidad, y este mes es el sexto para la que era llamada estéril.
es.B: También tu pariente Isabel ha concebido un hijo en su vejez. La gente decía que era estéril, y sin embargo ya está en su sexto mes.
es.R: Tu pariente Isabel es muy anciana, y la gente decía que nunca podría tener hijos. Pero va a tener un niño, y ya tiene seis meses de embarazo.

fr.L: Et voici, Élisabeth ta parente, elle aussi, a conçu un fils dans sa vieillesse, et c’est le sixième mois pour celle qu’on appelait stérile.
fr.B: Ta parente Élisabeth, elle aussi, attend un fils dans sa vieillesse. On la disait stérile, et pourtant elle en est à son sixième mois.
fr.R: Ta parente Élisabeth est très âgée, et les gens disaient qu’elle ne pourrait jamais avoir de bébé. Mais elle va avoir un fils, et elle est déjà enceinte de six mois.

sw.L: Na tazama, Elisabeti, jamaa yako, yeye pia amepata mimba ya mwana katika uzee wake, na mwezi huu ni wa sita kwake yule aliyekuwa akiitwa tasa.
sw.B: Hata Elisabeti, jamaa yako, amepata mimba ya mtoto wa kiume katika uzee wake. Watu walimwita tasa, lakini sasa ana mimba ya miezi sita.
sw.R: Jamaa yako Elisabeti ni mzee sana, na watu walisema hangeweza kamwe kupata mtoto. Lakini atapata mtoto wa kiume, na tayari ana mimba ya miezi sita.

ko.L: 그리고 보아라, 네 친척 엘리사벳, 그 여자도 늙은 나이에 아들을 임신하였다. 그리고 아이를 못 낳는다고 불리던 그 여자에게 이제 여섯째 달이다.
ko.B: 네 친척 엘리사벳도 늙은 나이에 아들을 임신하였다. 사람들이 아이를 낳지 못한다고 하던 그가 벌써 임신한 지 여섯 달이 되었다.
ko.R: 네 친척 엘리사벳은 나이가 아주 많다. 사람들은 엘리사벳이 아기를 가질 수 없다고 했다. 그런데 엘리사벳이 아들을 가졌고, 벌써 임신한 지 여섯 달이 되었다.

vi.L: Và này, Ê-li-sa-bét, bà con của cô, chính bà cũng đã thụ thai một con trai trong lúc tuổi già, và nay là tháng thứ sáu của người vốn bị gọi là son sẻ.
vi.B: Ê-li-sa-bét, bà con của cô, cũng đã có thai một con trai dù đã già. Người ta gọi bà là người hiếm muộn, vậy mà nay bà đã có thai được sáu tháng.
vi.R: Ê-li-sa-bét, bà con của cô, đã già lắm rồi, và ai cũng nói bà không thể có con. Nhưng bà sắp sinh một con trai, và đã có thai được sáu tháng rồi.

decisions.choice: your relative: a family member, the exact relationship unknown
decisions.reason: The word means a kinswoman. Luke does not say how Mary and Elizabeth were related; "cousin" says more than the Greek.

decisions.choice: a sign given without being asked
decisions.reason: Mary did not ask for a sign as Zechariah did, but the angel gives her one: what God has done for Elizabeth shows what he can do.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20 and 1:31, the angel points to something new. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: people said she could never have a baby
decisions.reason: As in 1:7, the plain meaning of the word.

decisions.choice: "bà con" for relative
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the exact relationship is unknown; "bà con" names a relative without saying which.

source.text: ὅτι οὐκ ἀδυνατήσει παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ πᾶν ῥῆμα.

records.literal_gloss: For not will be impossible with the God every word.

en.L: For no word from God will be impossible."
en.B: For with God, no promise will prove impossible."
en.R: God can do anything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says."

es.L: Porque ninguna palabra de parte de Dios será imposible».
es.B: Porque para Dios ninguna promesa resultará imposible».
es.R: Dios puede hacer todo lo que dice».

fr.L: Car aucune parole venant de Dieu ne sera impossible. »
fr.B: Car avec Dieu, aucune promesse ne se révélera impossible. »
fr.R: Dieu peut faire tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit. »

sw.L: Kwa maana hakuna neno litokalo kwa Mungu litakaloshindikana."
sw.B: Kwa maana kwa Mungu hakuna ahadi itakayoshindikana."
sw.R: Mungu anaweza kufanya kila kitu anachosema."

ko.L: 하나님께로부터 [온] 말씀은 어떤 것도 이루어지지 못할 것이 없기 때문이다."
ko.B: 하나님께서 하신 말씀은 무엇이든지 이루어지지 않는 것이 없다."
ko.R: 하나님께서는 말씀하신 것은 무엇이든지 하실 수 있다."

vi.L: Vì không lời nào từ Đức Chúa Trời là không thể [thực hiện]."
vi.B: Vì với Đức Chúa Trời, không lời hứa nào là không thể thực hiện."
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời có thể làm mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán."

decisions.choice: an echo of God's words to Abraham about Sarah
decisions.reason: When Sarah laughed at the promise of a son in her old age, God said, "Is anything impossible for the LORD?" (Genesis 18:14). The Greek Old Testament there uses the same verb and the same noun. Luke sets Elizabeth, and now Mary, in Sarah's story.

decisions.choice: word: what God has spoken, and so the thing he has said will happen
decisions.reason: The noun can mean a spoken word or a matter. Here it holds both: nothing God says will fail to happen. Mary answers with the same noun in 1:38: "according to your word".

decisions.choice: will not be impossible with God: "from God" goes with the word, or with the power
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean that no word coming from God will lack power, or that nothing is impossible on God's part. Both say the same in the end.

decisions.choice: no promise will prove impossible (B); can do anything he says (R)
decisions.reason: "No word will be impossible" is awkward in English. Balanced calls the word a promise, as the context shows it is; Readable says the same thing positively.

decisions.choice: "말씀" for the word God has spoken
decisions.reason: The Greek word means both what God has said and the thing he has said will happen (meaning decision). "말씀" keeps the first, and "이루어지다" (come true) carries the second.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριάμ· Ἰδοὺ ἡ δούλη κυρίου· γένοιτό μοι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου.

records.literal_gloss: Said then Mary, Behold the slave of [the] Lord; may it be to me according to the word of you.

en.L: And Mary said, "Look, the slave of [the] Lord; may it happen to me according to your word."
en.B: Mary said, "I am the Lord's servant. Let it happen to me as you have said."
en.R: Mary said, "I belong to the Lord, and I am ready to do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants. Let everything you said happen to me."

es.L: Y María dijo: «Mira, la esclava del Señor; que me suceda según tu palabra».
es.B: María dijo: «Soy la sierva del Señor. Que me suceda tal como has dicho».
es.R: María dijo: «Pertenezco al Señor, y estoy lista para hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiera. Que me pase todo lo que has dicho».

fr.L: Et Marie dit : « Voici l’esclave du Seigneur ; qu’il m’advienne selon ta parole. »
fr.B: Marie dit : « Je suis la servante du Seigneur. Que tout se passe pour moi comme tu l’as dit. »
fr.R: Marie a dit : « J’appartiens au Seigneur, et je suis prête à faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut. Que tout ce que tu as dit m’arrive. »

sw.L: Naye Mariamu akasema, "Tazama, mtumwa wa Bwana; na iwe kwangu kulingana na neno lako."
sw.B: Mariamu akasema, "Mimi ni mtumishi wa Bwana. Yanitokee kama ulivyosema."
sw.R: Mariamu akasema, "Mimi ni mali ya Bwana, na niko tayari kufanya anachotaka. Kila kitu ulichosema na kinitokee."

ko.L: 그러자 마리아가 말했다. "보십시오, 주님의 여종입니다. 말씀대로 저에게 이루어지기를 바랍니다."
ko.B: 마리아가 말했다. "저는 주님의 여종입니다. 말씀하신 대로 저에게 이루어지기를 바랍니다."
ko.R: 마리아가 말했다. "저는 주님께 속한 사람입니다. 주님께서 원하시는 대로 하겠습니다. 말씀하신 일이 모두 저에게 그대로 이루어지기를 바랍니다."

vi.L: Và Ma-ri nói: "Này, [tôi là] nô lệ của Chúa; xin điều ấy xảy đến cho tôi theo lời ông."
vi.B: Ma-ri nói: "Tôi là đầy tớ của Chúa. Xin điều ông nói xảy ra cho tôi."
vi.R: Ma-ri nói: "Tôi thuộc về Chúa, và tôi sẵn sàng làm theo ý {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin mọi điều ông nói xảy ra cho tôi."

decisions.choice: slave: a woman who belongs to her master and is at his disposal
decisions.reason: The word is the feminine of the word for a slave (Philippians 2:7). Mary calls herself the Lord's slave: she belongs to him and puts herself at his command. Her place is that of one who belongs to a master, not of one in paid employment.

decisions.choice: may it happen to me: a wish and an act of consent
decisions.reason: The rare optative mood expresses a wish. Mary gives herself to God's purpose. "Word" is the same noun as in 1:37.

decisions.choice: I am (B); not rendered (R); look (L)
decisions.reason: Here the word means "here I am": Mary presents herself. Balanced says "I am".

decisions.choice: I belong to the Lord, and I am ready to do what he wants
decisions.reason: Readable explains what being the Lord's servant means for Mary here. This explains the word; the meaning decision gives the word itself.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that she belongs to the Lord, and Literal keeps "slave". Readable explains the word instead (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: esclava (L); sierva (B)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: Literal shows that the Greek word is the one for a slave woman who belongs to her master (meaning decision m1); Balanced says "sierva", as the English says "servant"; Readable says what it means. The same in 1:48.

decisions.choice: Voici l’esclave du Seigneur (L); Je suis la servante du Seigneur (B)
decisions.reason: French "voici" is how one presents oneself ("me voici"), so Literal can keep the Greek word where English needs "look". The term sheet has "esclave" at Literal and "servante" at Balanced; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that she belongs to the Lord.

decisions.choice: mtumwa (L); mtumishi (B)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: Literal shows that the Greek word is the one for a slave who belongs to her master (meaning decision m1); Balanced says "mtumishi" (servant), as the English does. "Mjakazi" (slave woman) is exact but now old. The same in 1:48.

decisions.choice: "여종" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "종" for this word at every level; the feminine "여종" is the woman who belongs to her master and is at his disposal (meaning decision). Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. "보십시오" (L) keeps "behold" in Mary's polite speech.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B)
decisions.reason: As the style guide does for doulos: "nô lệ" at Literal, "đầy tớ" at Balanced. Both words serve for a woman; "nữ tì" is archaic. The same in 1:48.

decisions.choice: Mary calls the angel "ông" and herself "tôi"
decisions.reason: The angel appears as a man and speaks to her as "cô"; "ông" answers that respectfully. "ngài" might suggest she takes him for God.

source.text: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ὁ ἄγγελος.

records.literal_gloss: And went away from her the angel.

en.L: And the angel departed from her.
en.B: Then the angel left her.
en.R: Then the angel went away.

es.L: Y se apartó de ella el ángel.
es.B: Entonces el ángel la dejó.
es.R: Luego el ángel se fue.

fr.L: Et l’ange s’en alla d’auprès d’elle.
fr.B: Puis l’ange la quitta.
fr.R: Ensuite, l’ange est parti.

sw.L: Na malaika akaondoka kwake.
sw.B: Kisha malaika akamwacha.
sw.R: Kisha malaika akaondoka.

ko.L: 그리고 천사가 그 여자에게서 떠나갔다.
ko.B: 그리고 천사는 마리아에게서 떠나갔다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 천사는 떠나갔다.

vi.L: Và thiên sứ lìa khỏi cô.
vi.B: Rồi thiên sứ rời cô.
vi.R: Rồi thiên sứ đi khỏi.

source.text: Ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Μαριὰμ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν μετὰ σπουδῆς εἰς πόλιν Ἰούδα, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ζαχαρίου καὶ ἠσπάσατο τὴν Ἐλισάβετ.

records.literal_gloss: Having arisen then Mary in the days these went into the hill country with haste to a city of Judah, \v 40 and entered into the house of Zechariah and greeted the Elizabeth.

en.L: And in these days Mary arose and went with haste into the hill country, to a city of Judah, \v 40 and she entered the house of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
en.B: In those days Mary set out and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judah. \v 40 She went into Zechariah's house and greeted Elizabeth.
en.R: Soon after this, Mary set off quickly for a town in the hills of Judah. \v 40 She went into Zechariah's house and said hello to Elizabeth.

es.L: Y habiéndose levantado María en estos días, se dirigió con premura a la región montañosa, a una ciudad de Judá, \v 40 y entró en la casa de Zacarías y saludó a Isabel.
es.B: En esos días María se puso en camino y fue a toda prisa a un pueblo de la región montañosa de Judá. \v 40 Entró en la casa de Zacarías y saludó a Isabel.
es.R: Poco después, María salió rápidamente hacia un pueblo en las montañas de Judá. \v 40 Entró en la casa de Zacarías y saludó a Isabel.

fr.L: Or, s’étant levée en ces jours-là, Marie se rendit en hâte dans la région montagneuse, vers une ville de Juda, \v 40 et elle entra dans la maison de Zacharie et salua Élisabeth.
fr.B: En ces jours-là, Marie partit et se rendit en hâte dans une ville de la région montagneuse de Juda. \v 40 Elle entra dans la maison de Zacharie et salua Élisabeth.
fr.R: Peu de temps après, Marie est vite partie pour une ville dans les collines de Juda. \v 40 Elle est entrée dans la maison de Zacharie et elle a dit bonjour à Élisabeth.

sw.L: Na Mariamu akiisha kuinuka katika siku hizi, alikwenda upesi hadi eneo la milimani, kwenye mji wa Yuda, \v 40 akaingia katika nyumba ya Zakaria akamsalimia Elisabeti.
sw.B: Siku hizo Mariamu alijiandaa, akaharakisha kwenda mji mmoja katika nchi ya milima ya Yuda. \v 40 Aliingia nyumbani kwa Zakaria, akamsalimia Elisabeti.
sw.R: Muda mfupi baadaye, Mariamu aliondoka haraka kwenda mji mmoja katika milima ya Yuda. \v 40 Aliingia nyumbani kwa Zakaria, akamsalimia Elisabeti.

ko.L: 그 날들에 마리아가 일어나 서둘러 산골로, 유다의 한 성읍으로 가서, \v 40 사가랴의 집에 들어가 엘리사벳에게 인사하였다.
ko.B: 그 무렵 마리아는 길을 떠나 서둘러 유다 산골에 있는 한 마을로 갔다. \v 40 그리고 사가랴의 집에 들어가 엘리사벳에게 인사하였다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 곧 마리아는 서둘러 유다 지방의 산골 마을로 떠났다. \v 40 마리아는 사가랴의 집에 들어가 엘리사벳에게 인사를 했다.

vi.L: Và trong những ngày ấy, Ma-ri đứng dậy vội vàng đi lên miền đồi núi, đến một thành của Giu-đa, \v 40 và vào nhà Xa-cha-ri và chào Ê-li-sa-bét.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, Ma-ri lên đường, vội vã đến một thành trong miền đồi núi xứ Giu-đa. \v 40 Cô vào nhà Xa-cha-ri và chào Ê-li-sa-bét.
vi.R: Ít lâu sau, Ma-ri vội vã lên đường đến một thị trấn ở vùng đồi núi xứ Giu-đa. \v 40 Cô vào nhà Xa-cha-ri và chào hỏi Ê-li-sa-bét.

decisions.choice: a town of Judah in the hill country: south of Jerusalem, about 80 to 100 miles from Nazareth
decisions.reason: Luke does not name the town. Judah's hill country lies around and south of Jerusalem. The journey from Nazareth took several days.

decisions.choice: having arisen: she got ready to go
decisions.reason: A Hebrew-style way of saying someone set out (15:18, 20).

decisions.choice: with haste: eagerly, without delay
decisions.reason: She goes at once to see the sign the angel gave her (1:36).

decisions.choice: "유다" for Judah here; "유대" for Judea (1:5; 1:65)
decisions.reason: The Greek names the tribe and land of Judah, not the Roman region of Judea, and Korean has the two forms the Protestant tradition uses for them.

decisions.choice: "Giu-đa" for Judah
decisions.reason: The Greek here has the old tribal name Judah, not the province Judea ("Giu-đê", 1:5); Vietnamese keeps the two names apart as the Greek does.

source.text: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν τὸν ἀσπασμὸν τῆς Μαρίας ἡ Ἐλισάβετ, ἐσκίρτησεν τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπλήσθη πνεύματος ἁγίου ἡ Ἐλισάβετ, καὶ ἀνεφώνησεν κραυγῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ εἶπεν· Εὐλογημένη σὺ ἐν γυναιξίν, καὶ εὐλογημένος ὁ καρπὸς τῆς κοιλίας σου.

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass as heard the greeting of the Mary the Elizabeth, leaped the baby in the womb of her, and was filled of Spirit Holy the Elizabeth, \v 42 and she cried out with a cry loud and said, Blessed [are] you among women, and blessed the fruit of the womb of you.

en.L: And it happened, when Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with [the] Holy Spirit, \v 42 and she called out with a loud cry and said, "Blessed [are] you among women, and blessed [is] the fruit of your womb!
en.B: As Mary's greeting reached Elizabeth, the child in her womb leaped, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit. \v 42 She cried out in a loud voice, "Of all women, you are the most blessed, and blessed is the child you carry!
en.R: As soon as Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby inside her jumped. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit. \v 42 She called out loudly, "God has blessed you more than any other woman! And God has blessed the baby you will have!

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Isabel oyó el saludo de María, el niño saltó dentro de su vientre, e Isabel fue llena del Espíritu Santo, \v 42 y alzó la voz con un gran grito y dijo: «¡Bendita [eres] tú entre las mujeres, y bendito [es] el fruto de tu vientre!
es.B: En cuanto el saludo de María llegó a Isabel, el niño saltó en su vientre, e Isabel quedó llena del Espíritu Santo. \v 42 Exclamó en voz alta: «¡Eres la más bendecida de todas las mujeres, y bendito es el niño que llevas en tu seno!
es.R: Apenas Isabel oyó el saludo de María, el bebé que llevaba dentro dio un salto. E Isabel fue llena del Espíritu Santo. \v 42 Entonces dijo en voz alta: «¡Dios te ha bendecido más que a ninguna otra mujer! ¡Y Dios ha bendecido al bebé que vas a tener!

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Élisabeth entendit la salutation de Marie, [que] l’enfant tressaillit dans son ventre, et Élisabeth fut remplie de l’Esprit Saint, \v 42 et elle éleva la voix dans un grand cri et dit : « [Tu es] bénie parmi les femmes, et béni [est] le fruit de ton ventre !
fr.B: Dès qu’Élisabeth entendit la salutation de Marie, l’enfant bondit en elle, et Élisabeth fut remplie de l’Esprit Saint. \v 42 Elle s’écria d’une voix forte : « De toutes les femmes, tu es la plus bénie, et béni est l’enfant que tu portes !
fr.R: Dès qu’Élisabeth a entendu la salutation de Marie, le bébé a fait un bond en elle. Et Élisabeth a été remplie de l’Esprit Saint. \v 42 Elle s’est écriée : « Dieu t’a bénie plus que toutes les autres femmes ! Et Dieu a béni le bébé que tu vas avoir !

sw.L: Ikawa, Elisabeti aliposikia salamu ya Mariamu, kichanga kiliruka tumboni mwake, na Elisabeti alijazwa Roho Mtakatifu, \v 42 akapiga kelele kwa sauti kuu akasema, "Wewe umebarikiwa miongoni mwa wanawake, na tunda la tumbo lako limebarikiwa!
sw.B: Salamu ya Mariamu ilipomfikia Elisabeti, mtoto aliyekuwa tumboni mwake aliruka, naye Elisabeti akajazwa Roho Mtakatifu. \v 42 Akapaza sauti, akasema, "Kati ya wanawake wote, wewe ndiye uliyebarikiwa kuliko wote, na mtoto unayembeba amebarikiwa!
sw.R: Mara Elisabeti aliposikia salamu ya Mariamu, mtoto aliyekuwa tumboni mwake aliruka. Naye Elisabeti akajazwa Roho Mtakatifu. \v 42 Akasema kwa sauti kubwa, "Mungu amekubariki kuliko mwanamke mwingine yeyote! Na Mungu amembariki mtoto utakayemzaa!

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 엘리사벳이 마리아의 인사를 들었을 때, 아기가 그의 태 안에서 뛰놀았고, 엘리사벳은 성령으로 충만하게 되었다. \v 42 그리고 그는 큰 소리로 외쳐 말했다. "너는 여자들 가운데서 복을 받았고, 네 태의 열매도 복을 받았다!
ko.B: 엘리사벳이 마리아의 인사를 듣자, 배 속의 아기가 뛰놀았다. 그리고 엘리사벳은 성령으로 충만해졌다. \v 42 엘리사벳이 큰 소리로 외쳤다. "너는 모든 여자 가운데 가장 큰 복을 받았고, 네가 품은 아기도 복을 받았다!
ko.R: 엘리사벳이 마리아의 인사를 듣자마자, 배 속의 아기가 뛰었다. 그리고 엘리사벳은 성령으로 가득 찼다. \v 42 엘리사벳이 큰 소리로 말했다. "하나님께서 다른 어떤 여자보다 너에게 더 큰 복을 주셨구나! 네가 낳을 아기에게도 하나님께서 복을 주셨다!

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi Ê-li-sa-bét nghe lời chào của Ma-ri, thai nhi nhảy lên trong bụng bà, và Ê-li-sa-bét được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh, \v 42 và bà kêu lớn tiếng mà nói: "Em được phước giữa các người nữ, và trái của lòng em cũng được phước!
vi.B: Khi lời chào của Ma-ri vừa đến tai Ê-li-sa-bét, thai nhi trong bụng bà nhảy lên, và Ê-li-sa-bét được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh. \v 42 Bà kêu lớn: "Trong các phụ nữ, em là người được phước nhất, và con em đang mang cũng được phước!
vi.R: Vừa nghe Ma-ri chào, đứa bé trong bụng Ê-li-sa-bét liền nhảy lên. Ê-li-sa-bét được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh. \v 42 Bà nói lớn: "Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho em hơn mọi phụ nữ khác! Và Đức Chúa Trời cũng ban phước cho đứa bé mà em sẽ sinh ra!

decisions.choice: the baby leaped: the unborn John moves, and Elizabeth takes it as joy (1:44)
alternatives: an ordinary movement with no meaning
decisions.reason: The angel said John would be filled with the Holy Spirit before birth (1:15). Elizabeth explains in 1:44 that he leaped for joy. The verb is used in Genesis 25:22 (Greek) of the twins in Rebekah's womb.

decisions.choice: blessed among women: the most blessed of all women
decisions.reason: Hebrew expresses the highest degree this way. Jael (Judges 5:24) is praised with similar words.

decisions.choice: the fruit of your womb: your child
decisions.reason: A Hebrew phrase for children (Deuteronomy 28:4).

decisions.choice: blessed: blessed by God
decisions.reason: The participle means having received God's blessing. A different word, "happy" or "blessed" in the sense of fortunate, comes in 1:45.

decisions.choice: the child you carry (B); the baby you will have (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means. The child is still in Mary's womb.

decisions.choice: God has blessed
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who blesses.

decisions.choice: ventre (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the belly or womb. "Sein" is the traditional word in French Bibles, but today it is read first as "breast"; "ventre" is the plain word for where a baby grows. Balanced and Readable say "en elle", "l’enfant que tu portes".

decisions.choice: Elizabeth speaks to Mary in 해라체 ("너", "받았다"), but honours her as "내 주님의 어머니" with the honorific ("오시다니", 1:43)
decisions.reason: Elizabeth is the older relative, and an older Korean woman speaks to a young kinswoman in the plain style; the honorific for "the mother of my Lord" shows the reverence the Greek expresses (meaning decision on 1:43). A reviewer may prefer the polite style for the whole greeting.

decisions.choice: Elizabeth speaks to Mary as "em" and of herself as "tôi" (1:42-45)
decisions.reason: Elizabeth is an older relative, so "em" is the natural warm address; "tôi" for herself keeps the humility of 1:43 ("Who am I ...?"), where "chị" would sound like a family chat. A reviewer may prefer another pair.

decisions.choice: "trái của lòng em" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew-style idiom, which Vietnamese readers know from older Bibles; the meaning decision says it means "your child", as Balanced and Readable say.

source.text: καὶ πόθεν μοι τοῦτο ἵνα ἔλθῃ ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ κυρίου μου πρὸς ἐμέ;

records.literal_gloss: And from where to me this that should come the mother of the Lord of me to me?

en.L: And from where [does] this [come] to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
en.B: Who am I, that the mother of my Lord should come to visit me?
en.R: Why should God be so good to me? The mother of my Lord has come to visit me!

es.L: ¿Y de dónde [me viene] esto a mí, que la madre de mi Señor venga a mí?
es.B: ¿Quién soy yo para que la madre de mi Señor venga a visitarme?
es.R: ¿Por qué Dios es tan bueno conmigo? ¡La madre de mi Señor ha venido a visitarme!

fr.L: Et d’où me [vient] ceci, que la mère de mon Seigneur vienne vers moi ?
fr.B: Qui suis-je pour que la mère de mon Seigneur vienne me rendre visite ?
fr.R: Pourquoi Dieu est-il si bon avec moi ? La mère de mon Seigneur est venue me voir !

sw.L: Na hili limetoka wapi kwangu, kwamba mama wa Bwana wangu aje kwangu?
sw.B: Mimi ni nani hata mama wa Bwana wangu aje kunitembelea?
sw.R: Kwa nini Mungu amenitendea wema hivi? Mama wa Bwana wangu amekuja kunitembelea!

ko.L: 그리고 내 주님의 어머니가 나에게 오시다니, 이것이 어디서 나에게 [온 일인가]?
ko.B: 내가 누구이기에 내 주님의 어머니가 나를 찾아오시는가?
ko.R: 하나님께서 어찌 나에게 이렇게 좋은 일을 베푸실까? 내 주님의 어머니가 나를 찾아오셨구나!

vi.L: Và bởi đâu điều này [đến] với tôi, là mẹ của Chúa tôi đến với tôi?
vi.B: Tôi là ai mà được mẹ của Chúa tôi đến thăm?
vi.R: Sao Đức Chúa Trời lại tốt với tôi đến thế? Mẹ của Chúa tôi đã đến thăm tôi!

decisions.choice: my Lord: Elizabeth calls Mary's unborn child her Lord
decisions.reason: In this chapter "the Lord" is God again and again (1:6, 9, 11, 15-17, 25, 28, 38). Elizabeth, filled with the Holy Spirit (1:41), now uses the word of the child Mary carries. Luke calls Jesus "the Lord" in his own narrative (7:13; 10:1).

decisions.choice: from where is this to me: why am I given such an honor?
alternatives: a question about where Mary came from
decisions.reason: A humble question: she does not deserve the visit. Compare David's words in 2 Samuel 6:9, "How can the ark of the LORD come to me?"

decisions.choice: Who am I (B); Why should God be so good to me? (R)
alternatives: Why is this granted to me?
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the humble question in English idiom.

source.text: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡ φωνὴ τοῦ ἀσπασμοῦ σου εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου, ἐσκίρτησεν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ μου.

records.literal_gloss: Behold for as came the sound of the greeting of you into the ears of me, leaped in gladness the baby in the womb of me.

en.L: For look, as the sound of your greeting came into my ears, the baby in my womb leaped with gladness.
