en.B: The moment your greeting reached my ears, the child in my womb leaped with delight.
en.R: As soon as I heard your voice, the baby inside me jumped because he was so happy.

es.L: Pues mira, apenas el sonido de tu saludo entró en mis oídos, saltó de júbilo el niño en mi vientre.
es.B: Apenas oí tu saludo, el niño que llevo dentro saltó de júbilo.
es.R: En cuanto oí tu voz, el bebé que llevo dentro saltó porque estaba muy feliz.

fr.L: Car voici, dès que le son de ta salutation est parvenu à mes oreilles, l’enfant a tressailli d’allégresse dans mon ventre.
fr.B: Au moment même où ta salutation est parvenue à mes oreilles, l’enfant a bondi de joie en moi.
fr.R: Dès que j’ai entendu ta voix, le bébé a fait un bond en moi, tellement il était heureux.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, mara sauti ya salamu yako ilipofika masikioni mwangu, kichanga kiliruka kwa shangwe tumboni mwangu.
sw.B: Mara salamu yako ilipoyafikia masikio yangu, mtoto aliye tumboni mwangu aliruka kwa furaha.
sw.R: Mara niliposikia sauti yako, mtoto aliye tumboni mwangu aliruka kwa sababu alifurahi sana.

ko.L: 보아라, 네 인사하는 소리가 내 귀에 들렸을 때, 내 태 안의 아기가 크게 기뻐하며 뛰놀았다.
ko.B: 네 인사 소리가 내 귀에 들리는 순간, 내 배 속의 아기가 기뻐서 뛰놀았다.
ko.R: 네 목소리를 듣자마자, 내 배 속의 아기가 너무 기뻐서 뛰었다.

vi.L: Vì này, khi tiếng chào của em vừa đến tai tôi, thai nhi trong bụng tôi đã nhảy lên vì vui mừng.
vi.B: Ngay khi lời chào của em vừa đến tai tôi, đứa con trong bụng tôi nhảy lên vì mừng rỡ.
vi.R: Vừa nghe tiếng em, đứa bé trong bụng tôi đã nhảy lên vì vui sướng quá.

decisions.choice: with gladness: with the joy of celebration
decisions.reason: The noun is the gladness promised at John's birth (1:14) and the word of Mary's song (1:47). Even before birth John greets the Lord.

decisions.choice: look, for (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: Elizabeth points to what has just happened; Balanced and Readable carry it in the flow of the sentence.

source.text: καὶ μακαρία ἡ πιστεύσασα ὅτι ἔσται τελείωσις τοῖς λελαλημένοις αὐτῇ παρὰ κυρίου.

records.literal_gloss: And blessed the [one] having believed that will be fulfillment to the things having been spoken to her from [the] Lord.

en.L: And blessed [is] she who believed that there will be a fulfillment of the things spoken to her from [the] Lord."
en.B: Blessed is the woman who believed that what the Lord said to her would be carried out!"
en.R: You are blessed, because you believed that the Lord would do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told you!"

es.L: Y dichosa la que creyó que habrá cumplimiento de las cosas que le fueron habladas de parte del Señor».
es.B: ¡Dichosa la mujer que creyó que se cumpliría lo que el Señor le había dicho!».
es.R: ¡Qué dichosa eres, porque creíste que el Señor cumpliría lo que te había dicho!».

fr.L: Et bienheureuse celle qui a cru qu’il y aura un accomplissement des choses qui lui ont été dites de la part du Seigneur. »
fr.B: Heureuse celle qui a cru que ce que le Seigneur lui a dit s’accomplirait ! »
fr.R: Tu es bien heureuse d’avoir cru que le Seigneur ferait ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a dit ! »

sw.L: Na heri yeye aliyeamini kwamba kutakuwa na utimizo wa mambo aliyoambiwa kutoka kwa Bwana."
sw.B: Heri mwanamke aliyeamini kwamba yale Bwana aliyomwambia yatatimizwa!"
sw.R: Wewe ni heri, kwa sababu uliamini kwamba Bwana atafanya yale aliyokuambia!"

ko.L: 그리고 주님께로부터 자기에게 하신 말씀들이 이루어질 것을 믿은 여자는 복이 있다!"
ko.B: 주님께서 자기에게 하신 말씀이 이루어질 것을 믿은 여자는 복이 있다!"
ko.R: 너는 복을 받았다. 주님께서 너에게 말씀하신 일을 그대로 이루실 것이라고 믿었기 때문이다!"

vi.L: Và phước cho người đã tin rằng những điều Chúa đã phán với người sẽ được ứng nghiệm."
vi.B: Phước cho người phụ nữ đã tin rằng lời Chúa phán với mình sẽ được thực hiện!"
vi.R: Em thật có phước, vì em đã tin rằng Chúa sẽ làm đúng như điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với em!"

decisions.choice: blessed: fortunate, in a happy state because of God's favor
alternatives: blessed by God, the word of 1:42
decisions.reason: This is the word of the Beatitudes (6:20-22), not the participle of 1:42. It declares her fortunate. Mary takes it up in 1:48.

decisions.choice: that: what she believed
alternatives: because: she is blessed because the promise will be fulfilled
decisions.reason: The word can give the content of her faith or the reason she is blessed. Both make sense; the first follows the verb "believe" most naturally.

decisions.choice: she who believed: Mary, spoken of in the third person
alternatives: a general saying about anyone who believes
decisions.reason: Elizabeth speaks to Mary but praises her in the third person, as a blessing is often pronounced. Her faith stands against Zechariah's unbelief (1:20).

decisions.choice: You are blessed, because you believed
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to Mary directly, as Elizabeth is speaking to her.

decisions.choice: dichosa
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the Greek of the beatitudes: "bienaventurada" is now old, and "bendita" belongs to the different Greek word of 1:42 (blessed by God). The same word returns in 1:48.

decisions.choice: bienheureuse (L); heureuse (B, R), kept apart from "bénie" in 1:42 (for the whole book)
alternatives: bénie at every level, as the English "blessed"
decisions.reason: English says "blessed" for two Greek words. French keeps them apart: "béni(e)" for the one God blesses (1:42, 1:68), "heureux" or "bienheureux" for the one who is fortunate because of God's favor (m1), as the Beatitudes will be later in the book.

decisions.choice: heri
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the Greek of the beatitudes, a person in a happy state because of God's favor (meaning decision m1). "Kubarikiwa" (be blessed by God) is kept for the different Greek word of 1:42. The same word returns in 1:48.

decisions.choice: "phước", "có phước" for blessed
decisions.reason: "phước" is the Bible word for the happy state God gives; "hạnh phúc" is only feeling happy. Used for "blessed" in 1:42 and 1:48 too.

source.text: Καὶ εἶπεν Μαριάμ· Μεγαλύνει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν κύριον, καὶ ἠγαλλίασεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρί μου·

records.literal_gloss: And said Mary, Magnifies the soul of me the Lord, \v 47 and rejoiced the spirit of me in the God the Savior of me;

en.L: And Mary said, "My soul magnifies the Lord, \v 47 and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
en.B: And Mary said, "My soul declares the greatness of the Lord, \v 47 and my spirit has found its delight in God my Savior,
en.R: Then Mary said, "With all my heart I praise the Lord. \v 47 I am so glad because God is my Savior.

es.L: Y María dijo: «Mi alma engrandece al Señor, \v 47 y mi espíritu se ha alegrado en Dios mi Salvador,
es.B: Y María dijo: «Mi alma proclama la grandeza del Señor, \v 47 y mi espíritu ha encontrado su gozo en Dios mi Salvador,
es.R: Entonces María dijo: «Con todo mi corazón alabo al Señor. \v 47 Estoy muy feliz porque Dios es mi Salvador.

fr.L: Et Marie dit : « Mon âme magnifie le Seigneur, \v 47 et mon esprit a exulté en Dieu mon Sauveur,
fr.B: Alors Marie dit : « Mon âme proclame la grandeur du Seigneur, \v 47 et mon esprit a trouvé sa joie en Dieu, mon Sauveur,
fr.R: Alors Marie a dit : « De tout mon cœur, je loue le Seigneur. \v 47 Je suis si heureuse, parce que Dieu est mon Sauveur.

sw.L: Naye Mariamu akasema, "Nafsi yangu inamkuza Bwana, \v 47 na roho yangu imeshangilia katika Mungu Mwokozi wangu,
sw.B: Naye Mariamu akasema, "Nafsi yangu inatangaza ukuu wa Bwana, \v 47 na roho yangu imepata furaha yake katika Mungu Mwokozi wangu,
sw.R: Kisha Mariamu akasema, "Kwa moyo wangu wote ninamsifu Bwana. \v 47 Nimefurahi sana kwa sababu Mungu ni Mwokozi wangu.

ko.L: 그러자 마리아가 말했다. "내 영혼이 주님을 크게 높인다. \v 47 그리고 내 영이 내 구원자 하나님 안에서 크게 기뻐하였다.
ko.B: 마리아가 말했다. "내 영혼이 주님의 위대하심을 높인다. \v 47 내 영이 나의 구원자 하나님 안에서 기쁨을 누렸다.
ko.R: 그러자 마리아가 말했다. "나는 온 마음으로 주님을 찬양한다. \v 47 하나님께서 나의 구원자이시니, 나는 너무나 기쁘다.

vi.L: Và Ma-ri nói: "Linh hồn tôi tôn cao Chúa, \v 47 và tâm linh tôi đã mừng vui trong Đức Chúa Trời, Cứu Chúa của tôi,
vi.B: Ma-ri nói: "Linh hồn tôi ca tụng sự cao cả của Chúa, \v 47 và tâm linh tôi tìm được niềm hân hoan trong Đức Chúa Trời, Cứu Chúa của tôi,
vi.R: Bấy giờ Ma-ri nói: "Tôi hết lòng ca ngợi Chúa. \v 47 Tôi vui mừng biết bao vì Đức Chúa Trời là Cứu Chúa của tôi.

decisions.choice: magnifies: declares how great the Lord is
decisions.reason: The verb means to make great, and so to praise as great. Mary cannot add to God's greatness; she proclaims it.

decisions.choice: my soul ... my spirit: my whole self
alternatives: two different parts of a person
decisions.reason: Hebrew poetry says one thing twice in parallel lines. Soul and spirit mean Mary herself, with all her being.

decisions.choice: Mary's song echoes Hannah's song (1 Samuel 2:1-10) and the Psalms
alternatives: a song with no Old Testament roots
decisions.reason: Hannah, another woman given a son by God, sang "My heart rejoices in the LORD" (1 Samuel 2:1). Almost every line of Mary's song (1:46-55) uses the words of Scripture: compare Psalm 35:9 and Habakkuk 3:18 for "rejoice in God my Savior".

decisions.choice: Mary, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: Elizabeth, the reading of a few Latin manuscripts
decisions.reason: Almost all manuscripts give the song to Mary. A few Latin witnesses read "Elizabeth". Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: has rejoiced: a past tense beside a present
alternatives: a different time from the first line
decisions.reason: The second verb is in the aorist, the first in the present. In Hebrew-style poetry the two lines say the same thing; the aorist may look back to the moment of the announcement.

decisions.choice: With all my heart
decisions.reason: Readable says what the parallel lines mean: Mary praises God with her whole self.

decisions.choice: engrandece (L); proclama la grandeza (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the Greek verb, "makes great"; Balanced says what it means, declaring how great the Lord is (meaning decision m1). Mary's song runs to 1:55, where the guillemet closes.

decisions.choice: passé composé for God's acts in Mary's song at every level ("a exulté", "a fait", "a dispersé")
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The song is Mary's speech, and speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level; the passé composé also keeps the sense that what God has done still stands (m5). The same holds for Zechariah's song in 1:68-79.

decisions.choice: inamkuza (L); inatangaza ukuu wa (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the Greek verb with "kukuza" (make great); Balanced says what it means, declaring how great the Lord is (meaning decision m1). "Kutukuza" is kept for "glorify".

decisions.choice: Mary's song (1:46-55) in the plain written style, with the honorific for God ("높인다", "돌아보셨다", "하셨다")
decisions.reason: Mary sings about God, not to him, as the psalmists often do; the style guide (section 7a) gives the plain style with the honorific for speaking about God in praise.

decisions.choice: "구원자" for Savior
decisions.reason: "구원자" is the current word and keeps the link with "구원" (salvation) in 1:69-77; "구주" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: "Cứu Chúa" for Savior
decisions.reason: As in John 4:42. "Đấng Cứu Độ" is the Catholic form. Used again in 2:11.

decisions.choice: "tôn cao" for "magnifies" (L); "ca tụng sự cao cả của" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says Mary declares how great the Lord is; "tôn cao" keeps the picture of making great, and "tôn vinh" is kept for "glorify". Readable says simply "ca ngợi".

source.text: ὅτι ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῆς δούλης αὐτοῦ, ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μακαριοῦσίν με πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαί·

records.literal_gloss: Because he looked upon the low state of the slave of him, behold for from the now will call blessed me all the generations;

en.L: because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has looked upon the low position of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} slave. For look, from now on all generations will call me blessed,
en.B: because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has looked with care on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant in her lowly state. From this day people of every generation will call me blessed,
en.R: He has noticed me, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, though I am not important. From now on, people of every time and place will say that I am blessed.

es.L: porque ha puesto los ojos en la humilde condición de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} esclava. Pues mira, desde ahora todas las generaciones me llamarán dichosa,
es.B: porque se ha fijado con bondad en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sierva, en su humilde condición. Desde hoy, gente de todas las generaciones me llamará dichosa,
es.R: Se ha fijado en mí, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sierva, aunque yo no soy importante. Desde ahora, la gente de todos los tiempos y lugares dirá que soy dichosa.

fr.L: parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a regardé vers la petitesse de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} esclave. Car voici, à partir de maintenant, toutes les générations me déclareront bienheureuse,
fr.B: parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé un regard bienveillant sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} servante dans son humble condition. Dès aujourd’hui, toutes les générations me proclameront heureuse,
fr.R: Il a fait attention à moi, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} servante, alors que je ne suis pas importante. Désormais, les gens de tous les temps et de tous les pays diront que je suis heureuse.

sw.L: kwa kuwa ameangalia hali ya chini ya mtumwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Kwa maana tazama, kuanzia sasa watu wa vizazi vyote wataniita heri,
sw.B: kwa kuwa amemwangalia kwa upendo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} katika hali yake duni. Tangu leo watu wa kila kizazi wataniita heri,
sw.R: Ameniona mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, ingawa mimi si mtu muhimu. Kuanzia sasa watu wa nyakati zote na mahali pote watasema kwamba mimi ni heri.

ko.L: 그분께서 그분의 여종의 낮은 처지를 돌아보셨기 때문이다. 보아라, 이제부터 모든 세대가 나를 복되다 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그분의 여종인 나의 낮은 처지를 살펴 주셨기 때문이다. 이제부터 모든 세대 사람들이 나를 복되다고 할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 주님의 종이고 대단하지 않은 사람인데, 주님께서 나를 돌아보셨다. 이제부터 모든 시대, 모든 곳의 사람들이 나를 복 받은 사람이라고 부를 것이다.

vi.L: vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đoái xem địa vị thấp hèn của nô lệ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì này, từ nay về sau mọi thế hệ sẽ gọi tôi là người có phước,
vi.B: vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đoái thương đến người đầy tớ hèn mọn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Từ nay, mọi thế hệ sẽ gọi tôi là người có phước,
vi.R: Ngài đã để ý đến tôi, là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, dù tôi chẳng là gì cả. Từ nay về sau, người ta ở mọi thời đại và mọi nơi sẽ nói rằng tôi là người có phước.

decisions.choice: low position: humble status, not humiliation
decisions.reason: The noun means a low and humble condition. Hannah prayed that God would look on her "affliction" (1 Samuel 1:11), using the same noun in the Greek. Mary is a young woman of no rank from an unknown village.

decisions.choice: slave: a woman who belongs to her master and is at his disposal
decisions.reason: The word is the feminine of the word for a slave (Philippians 2:7). Mary calls herself the Lord's slave: she belongs to him and puts herself at his command. Her place is that of one who belongs to a master, not of one in paid employment.

decisions.choice: call me blessed: declare me fortunate
decisions.reason: The verb is related to "blessed" in 1:45. Elizabeth was the first to do so.

decisions.choice: people of every time and place
decisions.reason: Readable explains "all generations".

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m2) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

source.text: ὅτι ἐποίησέν μοι μεγάλα ὁ δυνατός, καὶ ἅγιον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γενεὰς τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Because did to me great things the Mighty [One], and holy the name of him, \v 50 and the mercy of him to generations and generations to the [ones] fearing him.

en.L: because the Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, \v 50 and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy [is] for generations and generations to those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: for the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, \v 50 and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy reaches from one generation to the next for those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: God, the Mighty One, has done great things for me. His name is holy. \v 50 In every generation {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is kind to people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: porque el Poderoso ha hecho grandes cosas por mí, y santo [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, \v 50 y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia [es] por generaciones y generaciones para los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen.
es.B: porque el Poderoso ha hecho grandes cosas por mí. Santo es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, \v 50 y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia alcanza de una generación a otra a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen.
es.R: Dios, el Poderoso, ha hecho grandes cosas por mí. Su nombre es santo. \v 50 En cada generación es bondadoso con la gente que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honra y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} obedece.

fr.L: parce que le Puissant a fait pour moi de grandes choses, et saint [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, \v 50 et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde [est] pour des générations et des générations envers ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent.
fr.B: car le Puissant a fait pour moi de grandes choses. Saint est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, \v 50 et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde s’étend d’une génération à l’autre sur ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent.
fr.R: Dieu, le Puissant, a fait pour moi de grandes choses. Son nom est saint. \v 50 À chaque génération, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respectent et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent.

sw.L: kwa kuwa Mwenye Nguvu amenifanyia mambo makubwa, na takatifu [ni] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \v 50 na huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [ni] kwa vizazi na vizazi kwa wale wanaomcha.
sw.B: kwa maana Mwenye Nguvu amenifanyia mambo makubwa. Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni takatifu, \v 50 na huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inawafikia wanaomcha, kizazi baada ya kizazi.
sw.R: Mungu, Mwenye Nguvu, amenifanyia mambo makubwa. Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni takatifu. \v 50 Katika kila kizazi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huwahurumia watu wanaomheshimu na kumtii.

ko.L: 능하신 분께서 나에게 큰일들을 하셨기 때문이다. 그리고 그분의 이름은 거룩하다. \v 50 그리고 그분의 자비는 그분을 두려워하는 사람들에게 대대로 [있다].
ko.B: 능하신 분께서 나에게 큰일을 행하셨기 때문이다. 그분의 이름은 거룩하다. \v 50 그분을 경외하는 사람들에게는 그분의 자비가 대대로 이어진다.
ko.R: 능력이 많으신 하나님께서 나에게 놀라운 일을 해 주셨다. 그분의 이름은 거룩하다. \v 50 그분은 그분을 높이고 그분께 순종하는 사람들에게 어느 시대에나 자비를 베푸신다.

vi.L: vì Đấng Quyền Năng đã làm cho tôi những việc lớn lao, và danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thánh, \v 50 và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [còn] từ thế hệ này đến thế hệ khác cho những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: vì Đấng Quyền Năng đã làm cho tôi những việc lớn lao. Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thánh, \v 50 và lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, từ đời này sang đời kia.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng Quyền Năng, đã làm cho tôi những việc lớn lao. Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thánh. \v 50 Đời nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng thương xót những người tôn kính và vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: holy is his name: God himself is holy
decisions.reason: In the Bible a name stands for the person (Psalm 111:9).

decisions.choice: his mercy for generations to those who fear him: Psalm 103:17
decisions.reason: Psalm 103:17 says the LORD's steadfast love is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear him. "Mercy" in the Greek Old Testament often stands for God's faithful, covenant love.

decisions.choice: fear him: revere God and live in awe of him
decisions.reason: To fear God is to honor him and obey him (Proverbs 1:7). Readable says so.

decisions.choice: honor him and obey him
decisions.reason: "Fear" in modern English suggests terror. Readable gives the sense.

decisions.choice: huruma
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for mercy. "Rehema" is also standard, but "huruma" is the everyday word for pity that acts, and the same word serves in 1:54, 1:58, 1:72 and 1:78.

decisions.choice: "자비" for mercy, through Luke 1; "두려워하다" (L), "경외하다" (B), "높이고 순종하다" (R) for fearing God
decisions.reason: "긍휼" is an older church word; the Korean Mark uses "자비" for the mercy God shows (Mark 5:19). Fearing God here is reverent awe (meaning decision): Literal keeps the plain verb, Balanced the word for reverent fear, and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Quyền Năng" for "the Mighty One"
decisions.reason: "Đấng Toàn Năng" is the usual word for "the Almighty", a different Greek word; "Quyền Năng" keeps "mighty".

source.text: Ἐποίησεν κράτος ἐν βραχίονι αὐτοῦ, διεσκόρπισεν ὑπερηφάνους διανοίᾳ καρδίας αὐτῶν·

records.literal_gloss: He did might with the arm of him, he scattered proud [ones] in [the] thought of heart of them;

en.L: He has done mighty deeds with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has scattered [the] proud in [the] thought of their heart.
en.B: He has acted with the strength of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arm; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has scattered the proud, with all the schemes of their hearts.
en.R: He has shown how strong {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is. He has scattered people who are proud and full of their own plans.

es.L: Ha obrado poderosamente con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo; ha dispersado a [los] arrogantes en [los] pensamientos de su corazón.
es.B: Ha actuado con la fuerza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo; ha dispersado a los soberbios, con todos los planes de su corazón.
es.R: Ha mostrado lo fuerte que es. Ha dispersado a la gente orgullosa y llena de sus propios planes.

fr.L: Il a fait œuvre de puissance par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dispersé les orgueilleux dans les pensées de leur cœur.
fr.B: Il a agi avec la force de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dispersé les orgueilleux avec tous les projets de leur cœur.
fr.R: Il a montré combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est fort. Il a dispersé les gens orgueilleux, pleins de leurs propres projets.

sw.L: Ametenda kwa uweza kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; amewatawanya wenye majivuno katika fikira za moyo wao.
sw.B: Ametenda kwa nguvu za mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; amewatawanya wenye kiburi pamoja na hila zote za mioyo yao.
sw.R: Ameonyesha jinsi alivyo na nguvu. Amewatawanya watu wenye kiburi na waliojaa mipango yao wenyewe.

ko.L: 그분께서 그분의 팔로 권능을 행하셨고, 마음의 생각이 교만한 사람들을 흩으셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그 팔로 힘 있는 일을 행하셔서, 마음속에 교만한 생각을 품은 사람들을 흩으셨다.
ko.R: 그분은 그분이 얼마나 강하신지 보여 주셨다. 잘난 체하며 자기 꾀만 믿는 사람들을 흩어 버리셨다.

vi.L: Ngài đã làm việc quyền năng bằng cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm tan tác những kẻ kiêu ngạo trong ý tưởng của lòng họ.
vi.B: Ngài đã ra tay bằng sức mạnh của cánh tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm tan tác những kẻ kiêu ngạo cùng mọi mưu tính trong lòng họ.
vi.R: Ngài đã cho thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mạnh mẽ biết bao. Ngài đã làm tan tác những kẻ kiêu ngạo và đầy những toan tính riêng.

decisions.choice: his arm: God's power in action
decisions.reason: The arm of the LORD is a biblical picture for God's power, above all in rescuing Israel from Egypt (Deuteronomy 4:34; Psalm 89:11, 14; Isaiah 51:9).

decisions.choice: the proud in the thought of their heart: the arrogant, with their proud plans
alternatives: people who are proud in their heart, but not in their plans
decisions.reason: "In the thought of their heart" says where their pride lives and what it plans. God scatters them and their plans with them.

decisions.choice: he has shown ... scattered ... brought down: what God has done, seen as already done
alternatives: only past events in Israel's history
only what God will do in the future
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the aorist, the Greek tense for a completed act. Mary may be praising what God has always done for his people, or speaking of what he is now doing through her son as if it were already done, as the prophets did. Both readings are possible.

decisions.choice: schemes
decisions.reason: The noun is the thinking that plans and decides; with the proud it is their scheming.

source.text: καθεῖλεν δυνάστας ἀπὸ θρόνων καὶ ὕψωσεν ταπεινούς, πεινῶντας ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν καὶ πλουτοῦντας ἐξαπέστειλεν κενούς.

records.literal_gloss: He brought down rulers from thrones and exalted lowly [ones], \v 53 hungry [ones] he filled with good things and being rich [ones] he sent away empty.

en.L: He has brought down rulers from [their] thrones and has lifted up [the] lowly; \v 53 [the] hungry {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has filled with good things, and [the] rich {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has sent away empty.
en.B: He has pulled the mighty down from their thrones and raised up the lowly. \v 53 The hungry {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has filled with good things, and the rich {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has sent away with nothing.
en.R: He has taken rulers off their thrones, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made humble people great. \v 53 He has given good things to hungry people, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has sent rich people away with nothing.

es.L: Ha derribado a [los] gobernantes de [sus] tronos y ha levantado a [los] humildes; \v 53 a [los] hambrientos ha llenado de cosas buenas, y a [los] ricos los ha despedido vacíos.
es.B: Ha bajado de sus tronos a los poderosos y ha levantado a los humildes. \v 53 A los hambrientos los ha llenado de bienes, y a los ricos los ha despedido sin nada.
es.R: Ha quitado a los gobernantes de sus tronos, y ha hecho grandes a los humildes. \v 53 Ha dado cosas buenas a los que tienen hambre, pero a los ricos los ha despedido sin nada.

fr.L: Il a fait descendre les souverains de [leurs] trônes et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a élevé les humbles ; \v 53 les affamés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a comblés de biens, et les riches, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a renvoyés vides.
fr.B: Il a fait tomber les puissants de leurs trônes et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a élevé les petits. \v 53 Les affamés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a comblés de biens ; les riches, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a renvoyés les mains vides.
fr.R: Il a fait descendre les chefs de leur trône, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu grands les gens humbles. \v 53 Il a donné de bonnes choses à ceux qui avaient faim, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a renvoyé les riches sans rien.

sw.L: Amewaangusha watawala kutoka katika viti [vyao] vya enzi na kuwainua wanyenyekevu; \v 53 wenye njaa amewajaza vitu vyema, na matajiri amewaondoa bila kitu.
sw.B: Amewashusha wenye mamlaka kutoka katika viti vyao vya enzi, akawainua walio wa hali ya chini. \v 53 Wenye njaa amewapa vitu vizuri tele, na matajiri amewafukuza bila chochote.
sw.R: Amewaondoa watawala katika viti vyao vya enzi, na amewafanya wanyenyekevu kuwa wakubwa. \v 53 Amewapa watu wenye njaa vitu vizuri, lakini matajiri amewafukuza bila kitu.

ko.L: 그분께서 통치자들을 왕좌에서 끌어내리셨고, 낮은 사람들을 높이셨다. \v 53 굶주린 사람들을 좋은 것들로 채우셨고, 부유한 사람들을 빈손으로 떠나보내셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 권세 있는 통치자들을 왕좌에서 끌어내리시고, 낮은 사람들을 높이셨다. \v 53 배고픈 사람들을 좋은 것으로 배부르게 하시고, 부자들을 빈손으로 돌려보내셨다.
ko.R: 그분은 왕들을 왕좌에서 끌어내리시고, 낮은 사람들을 높여 주셨다. \v 53 배고픈 사람들에게는 좋은 것을 주셨지만, 부자들은 빈손으로 돌려보내셨다.

vi.L: Ngài đã truất những kẻ cầm quyền khỏi ngai và nâng cao những người thấp hèn; \v 53 {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho kẻ đói được đầy dẫy của tốt, và đuổi kẻ giàu về tay không.
vi.B: Ngài đã kéo những kẻ quyền thế xuống khỏi ngai và nâng những người thấp hèn lên. \v 53 Ngài đã cho người đói được no đầy của tốt, và đuổi người giàu về tay không.
vi.R: Ngài đã truất các vua chúa khỏi ngai, và nâng những người hèn mọn lên cao. \v 53 Ngài đã ban những điều tốt lành cho người đói, nhưng đuổi người giàu đi tay không.

decisions.choice: God brings down and lifts up: Hannah's song again
decisions.reason: Hannah sang that God brings low and lifts up, that the full hire themselves out for bread while the hungry are satisfied (1 Samuel 2:5-8; compare Psalm 107:9; Job 5:11). God reverses human rank; Jesus says the same in 6:20-26.

decisions.choice: the lowly: the humble and poor, people of low rank
alternatives: only those who are humble in attitude
decisions.reason: The word is related to Mary's "low position" in 1:48. It describes people of low standing, who often were humble before God as well.

decisions.choice: the hungry ... good things: real hunger and real food, and more
decisions.reason: The poor of Israel went hungry; God feeds them (Psalm 146:7). In Luke the same reversal reaches to those hungry for God (6:21).

decisions.choice: he has shown ... scattered ... brought down: what God has done, seen as already done
alternatives: only past events in Israel's history
only what God will do in the future
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the aorist, the Greek tense for a completed act. Mary may be praising what God has always done for his people, or speaking of what he is now doing through her son as if it were already done, as the prophets did. Both readings are possible.

source.text: ἀντελάβετο Ἰσραὴλ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ, μνησθῆναι ἐλέους, καθὼς ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν, τῷ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

records.literal_gloss: He helped Israel servant of him, to remember mercy, \v 55 as he spoke to the fathers of us, to the Abraham and to the seed of him to the age.

en.L: He has helped Israel {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, remembering mercy, \v 55 as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed forever."
en.B: He has come to the aid of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Israel and has not forgotten to show mercy, \v 55 as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to our ancestors, to Abraham and to his descendants forever."
en.R: He has helped Israel, the people who serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He has remembered to be kind to them, \v 55 just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised our ancestors. He promised to be kind to Abraham and to his family forever."

es.L: Ha venido en ayuda de Israel, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, para acordarse de [la] misericordia, \v 55 tal como habló a nuestros padres, a Abraham y a su simiente para siempre».
es.B: Ha venido en ayuda de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Israel y no se ha olvidado de mostrar misericordia, \v 55 como había dicho a nuestros antepasados, a Abraham y a sus descendientes para siempre».
es.R: Ha ayudado a Israel, el pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirve. Se ha acordado de ser bondadoso con ellos, \v 55 tal como lo prometió a nuestros antepasados. Prometió ser bondadoso con Abraham y con su familia para siempre».

fr.L: Il a secouru Israël {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, pour se souvenir de la miséricorde, \v 55 selon qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait parlé à nos pères, à Abraham et à sa descendance pour toujours. »
fr.B: Il est venu en aide à Israël, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas oublié de faire miséricorde, \v 55 comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait dit à nos ancêtres, à Abraham et à ses descendants pour toujours. »
fr.R: Il a aidé Israël, le peuple qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sert. Il n’a pas oublié d’être bon pour eux, \v 55 comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait promis à nos ancêtres. Il a promis d’être bon pour Abraham et pour sa famille, pour toujours. »

sw.L: Amemshika mkono Israeli mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akikumbuka huruma, \v 55 kama alivyonena kwa baba zetu, kwa Ibrahimu na kwa mbegu yake hata milele."
sw.B: Amekuja kumsaidia Israeli mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, wala hakusahau kuonyesha huruma, \v 55 kama alivyowaambia babu zetu, Ibrahimu na wazao wake milele."
sw.R: Amewasaidia Israeli, watu wanaomtumikia. Amekumbuka kuwahurumia, \v 55 kama alivyowaahidi babu zetu. Aliahidi kumhurumia Ibrahimu na jamaa yake milele."

ko.L: 그분께서 그분의 종 이스라엘을 붙들어 도우시고 자비를 기억하셨다. \v 55 우리 조상들에게, 아브라함과 그의 씨에게 영원히 말씀하신 그대로이다."
ko.B: 그분께서 자비를 잊지 않으시고 그분의 종 이스라엘을 도우셨다. \v 55 우리 조상들, 곧 아브라함과 그 자손에게 영원히 말씀하신 그대로이다."
ko.R: 그분은 그분을 섬기는 백성 이스라엘을 도우셨다. 그들에게 자비를 베푸시겠다고 하신 약속을 기억하셨다. \v 55 우리 조상들에게 약속하신 그대로 하셨다. 아브라함과 그 자손에게 영원히 자비를 베푸시겠다고 약속하셨다."

vi.L: Ngài đã giúp đỡ Y-sơ-ra-ên, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mà nhớ lại lòng thương xót, \v 55 như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với tổ phụ chúng ta, với Áp-ra-ham và dòng dõi người đến đời đời."
vi.B: Ngài đã đến cứu giúp Y-sơ-ra-ên, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và không quên tỏ lòng thương xót, \v 55 như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với tổ tiên chúng ta, với Áp-ra-ham và dòng dõi ông mãi mãi."
vi.R: Ngài đã giúp đỡ Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đã nhớ lại lòng thương xót của mình đối với họ, \v 55 đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với tổ tiên chúng ta. Ngài đã hứa sẽ thương xót Áp-ra-ham và con cháu ông mãi mãi."

decisions.choice: Israel his servant: the title of Isaiah 41:8-9
decisions.reason: God calls Israel "my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, offspring of Abraham" (Isaiah 41:8). The servant here is the whole people; "servant" (a different word from "slave" in 1:48) can also mean child.

decisions.choice: remembering mercy ... to Abraham and his descendants forever
alternatives: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his descendants
decisions.reason: "To Abraham and his descendants" can say whom God remembers in mercy, or whom he spoke to. The first is likelier: the promise was made to the fathers, and the mercy reaches Abraham's descendants forever (compare Micah 7:20). A rendering that keeps the Greek order leaves both open.

decisions.choice: remembering mercy: acting now on the mercy he promised
decisions.reason: When God "remembers" in Scripture, he acts on his promise (Genesis 8:1; Exodus 2:24; Psalm 98:3).

decisions.choice: his seed: Abraham's descendants
decisions.reason: "Seed" is a collective word for offspring (Genesis 17:7).

decisions.choice: our ancestors
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means the forefathers of Israel, men and women. Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: "그분의 종 이스라엘" (L, B); "그분을 섬기는 백성 이스라엘" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word can mean child or servant; here it is the title "Israel my servant" of Isaiah 41:8-9 (meaning decision), so Korean says "종".

decisions.choice: "lòng thương xót" for mercy
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant word, as in Mark 10:47 ("xin thương xót"); kept for mercy through Luke 1.

source.text: Ἔμεινεν δὲ Μαριὰμ σὺν αὐτῇ ὡς μῆνας τρεῖς, καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: Remained then Mary with her about months three, and returned to the house of her.

en.L: And Mary stayed with her about three months, and returned to her home.
en.B: Mary remained with Elizabeth about three months before returning home.
en.R: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months, and then went back home.

es.L: Y María permaneció con ella unos tres meses, y regresó a su casa.
es.B: María se quedó con Isabel unos tres meses y luego regresó a su casa.
es.R: María se quedó con Isabel unos tres meses, y después volvió a su casa.

fr.L: Et Marie demeura avec elle environ trois mois, et elle retourna dans sa maison.
fr.B: Marie resta avec Élisabeth environ trois mois, puis elle rentra chez elle.
fr.R: Marie est restée avec Élisabeth à peu près trois mois. Ensuite, elle est rentrée chez elle.

sw.L: Na Mariamu alibaki pamoja naye karibu miezi mitatu, akarejea nyumbani kwake.
sw.B: Mariamu alikaa na Elisabeti muda wa miezi mitatu hivi, kisha akarudi nyumbani.
sw.R: Mariamu alikaa na Elisabeti kwa karibu miezi mitatu, kisha akarudi nyumbani kwake.

ko.L: 그리고 마리아는 그 여자와 함께 석 달쯤 머무르다가 자기 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.B: 마리아는 엘리사벳과 함께 석 달쯤 머무르다가 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 마리아는 엘리사벳과 함께 석 달쯤 지냈다. 그러고 나서 집으로 돌아갔다.

vi.L: Và Ma-ri ở với bà chừng ba tháng, rồi trở về nhà mình.
vi.B: Ma-ri ở với Ê-li-sa-bét chừng ba tháng rồi trở về nhà.
vi.R: Ma-ri ở với Ê-li-sa-bét khoảng ba tháng, rồi trở về nhà.

decisions.choice: about three months: until about the time Elizabeth's son was due
alternatives: Luke says she left before the birth
decisions.reason: Elizabeth was in her sixth month when Mary came (1:36), so three months brings them near the birth. Luke finishes Mary's part of the story before telling of John's birth; he does not say whether she stayed for it.

decisions.choice: Elizabeth
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Elizabeth, since "her" could be unclear after the song.

source.text: Τῇ δὲ Ἐλισάβετ ἐπλήσθη ὁ χρόνος τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν, καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱόν.

records.literal_gloss: To the then Elizabeth was fulfilled the time of the to give birth her, and she bore a son.

en.L: Now for Elizabeth the time was fulfilled for her to give birth, and she bore a son.
en.B: Elizabeth's time to give birth came, and she bore a son.
en.R: When the time came, Elizabeth had a baby boy.

es.L: Y para Isabel se cumplió el tiempo de que ella diera a luz, y tuvo un hijo.
es.B: A Isabel le llegó el momento de dar a luz, y tuvo un hijo.
es.R: Cuando llegó el momento, Isabel tuvo un niño.

fr.L: Or pour Élisabeth s’accomplit le temps d’enfanter, et elle mit au monde un fils.
fr.B: Pour Élisabeth vint le moment d’accoucher, et elle donna naissance à un fils.
fr.R: Quand le moment est arrivé, Élisabeth a eu un petit garçon.

sw.L: Na kwa Elisabeti muda wa kujifungua ulitimia, naye akazaa mwana.
sw.B: Wakati wa Elisabeti wa kujifungua ulifika, naye akazaa mtoto wa kiume.
sw.R: Wakati ulipofika, Elisabeti alipata mtoto wa kiume.

ko.L: 엘리사벳에게 해산할 때가 차서, 그는 아들을 낳았다.
ko.B: 엘리사벳은 해산할 때가 되어 아들을 낳았다.
ko.R: 때가 되어 엘리사벳은 아들을 낳았다.

vi.L: Và đối với Ê-li-sa-bét, thời kỳ sinh nở của bà đã trọn, và bà sinh một con trai.
vi.B: Đến ngày Ê-li-sa-bét sinh nở, bà sinh một con trai.
vi.R: Đến lúc, Ê-li-sa-bét sinh một bé trai.

decisions.choice: the time was fulfilled: the full time of her pregnancy had come
decisions.reason: Luke uses the language of fulfillment (compare 1:20, 23; 2:6). What the angel promised now happens.

source.text: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ περίοικοι καὶ οἱ συγγενεῖς αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνεν κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ μετ’ αὐτῆς, καὶ συνέχαιρον αὐτῇ.

records.literal_gloss: And heard the neighbors and the relatives of her that magnified [the] Lord the mercy of him with her, and they were rejoicing with her.

en.L: And her neighbors and relatives heard that [the] Lord had magnified {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy with her, and they rejoiced with her.
en.B: Her neighbors and relatives heard how greatly the Lord had shown {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy to her, and they celebrated with her.
en.R: Her neighbors and relatives heard how very kind the Lord had been to her, and they were happy with her.

es.L: Y oyeron sus vecinos y parientes que [el] Señor había engrandecido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia con ella, y se alegraban con ella.
es.B: Sus vecinos y parientes oyeron cuán grande era la misericordia que el Señor le había mostrado, y celebraron con ella.
es.R: Sus vecinos y parientes oyeron lo bueno que había sido el Señor con ella, y se alegraron con ella.

fr.L: Et ses voisins et sa parenté entendirent que le Seigneur avait magnifié {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde envers elle, et ils se réjouissaient avec elle.
fr.B: Ses voisins et sa famille apprirent combien le Seigneur avait été grand dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde envers elle, et ils se réjouirent avec elle.
fr.R: Ses voisins et sa famille ont appris que le Seigneur avait été très bon pour elle, et ils se sont réjouis avec elle.

sw.L: Na majirani na jamaa zake walisikia kwamba Bwana alikuwa ameikuza huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwake, nao wakawa wakifurahi pamoja naye.
sw.B: Majirani na jamaa zake walisikia jinsi Bwana alivyomwonyesha huruma {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuu, nao wakasherehekea pamoja naye.
sw.R: Majirani na jamaa zake walisikia jinsi Bwana alivyomtendea wema mkubwa, nao wakafurahi pamoja naye.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 이웃들과 친척들은 주님께서 그에게 그분의 자비를 크게 베푸셨다는 것을 듣고, 그와 함께 기뻐하였다.
ko.B: 이웃과 친척들은 주님께서 엘리사벳에게 큰 자비를 베푸셨다는 소식을 듣고, 함께 기뻐하였다.
ko.R: 이웃과 친척들은 주님께서 엘리사벳을 무척 불쌍히 여기시고 좋은 일을 해 주셨다는 이야기를 들었다. 그리고 엘리사벳과 함께 기뻐했다.

vi.L: Và láng giềng và bà con của bà nghe rằng Chúa đã làm cho lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lớn lao đối với bà, và họ cùng vui mừng với bà.
vi.B: Láng giềng và bà con nghe Chúa đã tỏ lòng thương xót lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho bà, thì cùng mừng vui với bà.
vi.R: Hàng xóm và bà con nghe Chúa đã thương xót bà rất nhiều, thì cùng vui với bà.

decisions.choice: magnified his mercy with her: showed her great mercy
decisions.reason: The verb Mary used for praising God (1:46) here has its plain sense, to make great: God's mercy to Elizabeth was great. The phrase echoes Genesis 19:19 in the Greek.

decisions.choice: they rejoiced with her: the joy promised in 1:14
decisions.reason: The angel said many would rejoice at John's birth (1:14). The verb can also mean "congratulate".

decisions.choice: how very kind the Lord had been to her
alternatives: the Lord had shown her great mercy
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for God's mercy here.

source.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἦλθον περιτεμεῖν τὸ παιδίον, καὶ ἐκάλουν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαχαρίαν.

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass on the day the eighth they came to circumcise the child, and they were calling it by the name of the father of him Zechariah.

en.L: And it happened on the eighth day [that] they came to circumcise the child, and they were calling him by the name of his father, Zechariah.
en.B: When the child was eight days old, they came to circumcise him, and they wanted to give him his father's name, Zechariah.
en.R: When the baby was eight days old, the family came together to circumcise him. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.

es.L: Y sucedió que en el día octavo llegaron para circuncidar al niño, y lo estaban llamando Zacarías, por el nombre de su padre.
es.B: Cuando el niño tuvo ocho días, fueron a circuncidarlo, y querían ponerle el nombre de su padre, Zacarías.
es.R: Cuando el bebé cumplió ocho días, la familia se reunió para circuncidarlo. Iban a ponerle Zacarías, como su padre.

fr.L: Et il arriva, le huitième jour, [qu’]ils vinrent circoncire l’enfant, et ils l’appelaient du nom de son père, Zacharie.
fr.B: Le huitième jour, ils vinrent pour circoncire l’enfant, et ils voulaient lui donner le nom de son père, Zacharie.
fr.R: Quand le bébé a eu huit jours, la famille s’est réunie pour le circoncire. On allait l’appeler Zacharie, comme son père.

sw.L: Ikawa, siku ya nane, walifika ili kumtahiri mtoto, nao walikuwa wakimwita Zakaria kwa jina la baba yake.
sw.B: Mtoto alipofikisha siku nane, walikuja kumtahiri, nao walitaka kumpa jina la baba yake, Zakaria.
sw.R: Mtoto alipokuwa na umri wa siku nane, jamaa walikusanyika ili kumtahiri. Walikuwa wanataka kumwita Zakaria, kama baba yake.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 여드레째 되는 날에 그들이 아이에게 할례를 행하러 왔다. 그리고 그들은 그 아이를 그의 아버지의 이름을 따라 사가랴라고 부르고 있었다.
ko.B: 아이가 태어난 지 여드레째 되는 날, 사람들이 아이에게 할례를 행하러 왔다. 그들은 아이의 이름을 아버지의 이름을 따서 사가랴라고 지으려 했다.
ko.R: 아기가 태어난 지 여드레째 되는 날, 친척들이 모여 아기에게 할례를 행하였다. 그들은 아기의 이름을 아버지의 이름을 따서 사가랴라고 지으려고 했다.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, vào ngày thứ tám, họ đến để làm lễ cắt bì cho đứa trẻ, và họ định gọi nó theo tên cha nó là Xa-cha-ri.
vi.B: Đến ngày thứ tám, họ đến làm lễ cắt bì cho đứa trẻ, và họ muốn đặt tên cho bé theo tên cha là Xa-cha-ri.
vi.R: Khi đứa bé được tám ngày, họ hàng đến làm lễ cắt bì cho bé. Họ định đặt tên bé là Xa-cha-ri, theo tên của cha bé.

decisions.choice: on the eighth day: circumcision as the law commanded
alternatives: a family custom with no command behind it
decisions.reason: God commanded Abraham to circumcise every boy on the eighth day (Genesis 17:12; Leviticus 12:3), as the sign of his covenant. Naming the child at the same time is not commanded in the Old Testament, but Luke shows it was the custom (2:21).

decisions.choice: they were calling him: they were about to name him, or tried to
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense here shows an action begun but not completed: they were going to name him, until his mother stopped them.

decisions.choice: after his father: a common custom, though not a rule
alternatives: a rule that the first son take his father's name
decisions.reason: Children were often named after a father or grandfather. The neighbors expect it; Elizabeth refuses (1:60).

decisions.choice: they wanted to give him (B); they were going to name him (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the tense means.

decisions.choice: "làm lễ cắt bì" for circumcise
decisions.reason: "cắt bì" is the Bible word, as in Colossians 2:11; "làm lễ" shows it is a rite, which the meaning decision describes.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν· Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ κληθήσεται Ἰωάννης.

records.literal_gloss: And answering the mother of him said, No, but he will be called John.

en.L: And his mother answered and said, "No, but he will be called John."
en.B: But his mother answered, "No. His name is to be John."
en.R: But his mother said, "No! His name will be John."

es.L: Y respondiendo su madre, dijo: «No, sino que se llamará Juan».
es.B: Pero su madre respondió: «No. Su nombre ha de ser Juan».
es.R: Pero su madre dijo: «¡No! Se va a llamar Juan».

fr.L: Et sa mère, prenant la parole, dit : « Non, mais il sera appelé Jean. »
fr.B: Mais sa mère intervint : « Non ! On l’appellera Jean. »
fr.R: Mais sa mère a dit : « Non ! Il s’appellera Jean. »

sw.L: Na mama yake akajibu, akasema, "Hapana, bali ataitwa Yohana."
sw.B: Lakini mama yake akajibu, "Hapana. Jina lake litakuwa Yohana."
sw.R: Lakini mama yake akasema, "Hapana! Jina lake ni Yohana."

ko.L: 그러나 그 아이의 어머니가 대답하여 말했다. "아닙니다. 오히려 요한이라고 불릴 것입니다."
ko.B: 그러나 아이의 어머니가 말했다. "안 됩니다. 이 아이의 이름은 요한이라고 해야 합니다."
ko.R: 그러나 아기의 어머니가 말했다. "안 됩니다! 이 아이의 이름은 요한입니다."

vi.L: Và mẹ nó đáp lời mà nói: "Không, nhưng nó sẽ được gọi là Giăng."
vi.B: Nhưng mẹ bé đáp: "Không. Tên cháu phải là Giăng."
vi.R: Nhưng mẹ bé nói: "Không! Cháu sẽ tên là Giăng."

decisions.choice: No, but he will be called John: Elizabeth insists on the name the angel gave
alternatives: a sudden choice of her own
decisions.reason: Luke does not say how Elizabeth knew the name; Zechariah could have written it to her. What matters is that both parents obey the angel's word (1:13).

decisions.choice: Elizabeth and the gathered neighbours and relatives speak to each other in 합쇼체 (1:60-61), and "your relatives" is said without a pronoun
decisions.reason: A mother speaking to a gathering of relatives and neighbours, among them her elders, uses the formal polite style, and they answer her in kind. Korean does not use "당신" to a respected woman, and "your" is clear without it, so no level writes it.

decisions.choice: Elizabeth speaks of her own baby to the guests as "cháu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A Vietnamese mother speaking to relatives and neighbors names her child from their side, as "cháu"; Literal keeps the plain pronoun "nó".

source.text: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτὴν ὅτι Οὐδείς ἐστιν ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας σου ὃς καλεῖται τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ.

records.literal_gloss: And they said to her, No one is from the relatives of you who is called by the name this.

en.L: And they said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name."
en.B: "But no one in your family is called by that name," they said to her.
en.R: The people said to her, "But no one in your family has that name!"

es.L: Y le dijeron: «Ninguno hay entre tus parientes que sea llamado con este nombre».
es.B: «Pero nadie de tu familia lleva ese nombre», le dijeron.
es.R: La gente le dijo: «¡Pero nadie en tu familia tiene ese nombre!».

fr.L: Et ils lui dirent : « Il n’y a personne dans ta parenté qui soit appelé de ce nom. »
fr.B: « Mais personne dans ta famille ne porte ce nom », lui dirent-ils.
fr.R: Les gens lui ont dit : « Mais dans ta famille, personne ne s’appelle ainsi ! »

sw.L: Nao wakamwambia, "Hakuna mtu katika ukoo wako anayeitwa kwa jina hili."
sw.B: "Lakini hakuna mtu katika jamaa yako mwenye jina hilo," wakamwambia.
sw.R: Watu wakamwambia, "Lakini hakuna mtu katika jamaa yako mwenye jina hilo!"

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 그 여자에게 말했다. "친척 가운데 이 이름으로 불리는 사람은 아무도 없습니다."
ko.B: "친척 가운데 그런 이름을 가진 사람은 아무도 없지 않습니까?" 하고 사람들이 엘리사벳에게 말했다.
ko.R: 사람들이 엘리사벳에게 말했다. "하지만 친척 가운데 그런 이름을 가진 사람은 한 사람도 없습니다!"

vi.L: Và họ nói với bà: "Trong bà con của bà không có ai được gọi bằng tên này."
vi.B: Họ nói với bà: "Nhưng trong họ hàng của bà đâu có ai mang tên đó."
vi.R: Người ta nói với bà: "Nhưng trong gia đình bà không có ai tên như vậy cả!"

decisions.choice: no one among your relatives: a name normally came from the family
decisions.reason: The relatives expect a family name. A new name breaks with custom, and so marks the child as given by God for a new purpose.

source.text: ἐνένευον δὲ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ τί ἂν θέλοι καλεῖσθαι αὐτό.

records.literal_gloss: They were making signs then to the father of him the what - he might want to be called him.

en.L: And they made signs to his father [to ask] what he might want him to be called.
en.B: Then they motioned to his father, asking what name he wanted the child to have.
en.R: Then they made signs to Zechariah to ask him what he wanted to name the baby.

es.L: Y hacían señas a su padre [para preguntar] cómo quería que se le llamara.
es.B: Entonces le hicieron señas al padre para preguntarle qué nombre quería que tuviera el niño.
es.R: Entonces le hicieron señas a Zacarías para preguntarle qué nombre quería ponerle al bebé.

fr.L: Et ils faisaient des signes à son père [pour savoir] comment il voudrait qu’on l’appelle.
fr.B: Alors ils demandèrent par signes au père quel nom il voulait donner à l’enfant.
fr.R: Alors ils ont fait des signes à Zacharie pour lui demander quel nom il voulait donner au bébé.

sw.L: Nao walikuwa wakimwashiria baba yake [ili kumwuliza] angependa mtoto aitwe jina gani.
sw.B: Kisha wakamwashiria baba yake, wakimwuliza alitaka mtoto apewe jina gani.
sw.R: Kisha wakamwashiria Zakaria ili kumwuliza alitaka kumpa mtoto jina gani.

ko.L: 그래서 그들은 그 아이의 아버지에게, 그가 아이를 무엇이라고 부르기를 원하는지 [묻느라] 손짓을 하였다.
ko.B: 그래서 사람들은 아이의 아버지에게 손짓으로, 아이의 이름을 무엇이라고 짓기를 원하는지 물었다.
ko.R: 그래서 사람들은 사가랴에게 손짓으로, 아기 이름을 무엇으로 짓고 싶은지 물었다.

vi.L: Và họ ra dấu với cha nó, [hỏi] ông muốn gọi nó là gì.
vi.B: Rồi họ ra dấu hỏi cha đứa bé muốn đặt tên cho con là gì.
vi.R: Rồi họ ra dấu hỏi Xa-cha-ri muốn đặt tên cho bé là gì.

decisions.choice: made signs: they used gestures, as to someone who cannot hear
decisions.reason: They do not simply ask him. This suggests that he was deaf as well as mute (see 1:22).

decisions.choice: [to ask]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies what English needs to introduce the question.

source.text: καὶ αἰτήσας πινακίδιον ἔγραψεν λέγων· Ἰωάννης ἐστὶν ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And having asked for a writing tablet he wrote saying, John is name of him.

en.L: And asking for a writing tablet, he wrote, saying, "John is his name."
en.B: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, "His name is John."
en.R: Zechariah asked for something to write on. Then he wrote, "His name is John."

es.L: Y habiendo pedido una tablilla para escribir, escribió así: «Juan es su nombre».
es.B: Él pidió una tablilla y escribió: «Su nombre es Juan».
es.R: Zacarías pidió algo para escribir. Luego escribió: «Su nombre es Juan».

fr.L: Et ayant demandé une tablette, il écrivit, disant : « Jean est son nom. »
fr.B: Il demanda une tablette et écrivit : « Son nom est Jean. »
fr.R: Zacharie a demandé quelque chose pour écrire. Puis il a écrit : « Son nom est Jean. »

sw.L: Naye akiisha kuomba kibao cha kuandikia, aliandika akisema, "Yohana ndilo jina lake."
sw.B: Aliomba kibao cha kuandikia, akaandika, "Jina lake ni Yohana."
sw.R: Zakaria aliomba kitu cha kuandikia. Kisha akaandika, "Jina lake ni Yohana."

ko.L: 그러자 그는 서판을 달라고 하여 써서 말했다. "요한이 그의 이름이다."
ko.B: 사가랴는 글 쓰는 판을 달라고 하여 "그의 이름은 요한이다" 하고 썼다.
ko.R: 사가랴는 글을 쓸 것을 달라고 했다. 그리고 "아기의 이름은 요한이다" 하고 썼다.

vi.L: Và xin một tấm bảng nhỏ, ông viết rằng: "Giăng là tên nó."
vi.B: Ông xin một tấm bảng nhỏ và viết: "Tên bé là Giăng."
vi.R: Xa-cha-ri xin một vật gì để viết. Rồi ông viết: "Tên của bé là Giăng."

decisions.choice: writing tablet: a small wooden board covered with wax
decisions.reason: Small tablets of wood coated with wax were used for notes; letters were scratched into the wax with a pointed tool.

decisions.choice: John is his name: a settled fact, not a proposal
decisions.reason: Zechariah writes in the present tense: the name has already been given, by God through the angel. He obeys at last (compare 1:20).

decisions.choice: something to write on
decisions.reason: Readable avoids a word new readers may not know.

source.text: καὶ ἐθαύμασαν πάντες.

records.literal_gloss: And marveled all.

en.L: And they all marveled.
en.B: Everyone was astonished.
en.R: Everyone was surprised.

es.L: Y se asombraron todos.
es.B: Todos quedaron asombrados.
es.R: Todos se sorprendieron.

fr.L: Et tous s’étonnèrent.
fr.B: Tout le monde fut stupéfait.
fr.R: Tout le monde a été surpris.

sw.L: Na wote wakashangaa.
sw.B: Kila mtu alishangaa.
sw.R: Watu wote walishangaa.

ko.L: 그러자 모두가 놀랐다.
ko.B: 모든 사람이 깜짝 놀랐다.
ko.R: 사람들은 모두 놀랐다.

vi.L: Và mọi người đều lấy làm lạ.
vi.B: Mọi người đều kinh ngạc.
vi.R: Ai nấy đều ngạc nhiên.

decisions.choice: marveled: were astonished
decisions.reason: They are amazed that the parents agree on a name nobody expected. The wonder grows when Zechariah speaks (1:64-65).

source.text: ἀνεῴχθη δὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ παραχρῆμα καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλει εὐλογῶν τὸν θεόν.

records.literal_gloss: Was opened then the mouth of him immediately and the tongue of him, and he was speaking blessing the God.

en.L: And immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue [freed], and he began to speak, blessing God.
en.B: In that instant Zechariah's mouth was opened and his tongue loosed, and he began to speak, giving praise to God.
en.R: Right away Zechariah could talk again, and he began to praise God.

es.L: Y en el acto fue abierta su boca, y su lengua [liberada], y comenzó a hablar bendiciendo a Dios.
es.B: En ese mismo instante a Zacarías se le abrió la boca y se le desató la lengua, y comenzó a hablar alabando a Dios.
es.R: Enseguida Zacarías pudo volver a hablar, y comenzó a alabar a Dios.

fr.L: Et sa bouche fut ouverte à l’instant, ainsi que sa langue, et il parlait en bénissant Dieu.
fr.B: Au même instant, la bouche de Zacharie s’ouvrit et sa langue se délia, et il se mit à parler en louant Dieu.
fr.R: Aussitôt, Zacharie a pu parler de nouveau, et il s’est mis à louer Dieu.

sw.L: Na mara kinywa chake kilifunguliwa pamoja na ulimi wake [ukalegezwa], naye akaanza kusema akimbariki Mungu.
sw.B: Papo hapo kinywa cha Zakaria kilifunguka na ulimi wake ukafunguliwa, naye akaanza kusema, akimtukuza Mungu.
sw.R: Mara moja Zakaria aliweza kusema tena, naye akaanza kumsifu Mungu.

ko.L: 그러자 즉시 그의 입이 열리고 그의 혀가 [풀려], 그는 하나님을 찬양하며 말하기 시작했다.
ko.B: 그 순간 사가랴의 입이 열리고 혀가 풀려서, 그는 말을 하며 하나님을 찬양하였다.
ko.R: 그러자 바로 사가랴는 다시 말을 할 수 있게 되었다. 그는 하나님을 찬양하기 시작했다.

vi.L: Và lập tức miệng ông mở ra và lưỡi ông [được thả lỏng], và ông nói, chúc tụng Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, miệng Xa-cha-ri mở ra, lưỡi ông được thong thả, và ông bắt đầu nói, ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Ngay lập tức, Xa-cha-ri nói lại được, và ông bắt đầu ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời.

decisions.choice: his mouth was opened and his tongue: one verb serves both nouns
decisions.reason: The Greek uses "was opened" for both; the tongue was set free to speak.

decisions.choice: was opened: God opened it
decisions.reason: The passive points to God. The silence ends at once, when Zechariah obeys the angel's word, as the angel said (1:20).

decisions.choice: blessing God: praising and thanking God
alternatives: giving God a blessing he lacks
decisions.reason: To "bless" God is to praise him with thanks. His first words are words of praise; 1:68 begins "Blessed be the Lord".

decisions.choice: giving praise to God (B); praise God (R)
decisions.reason: In English one blesses someone who needs a blessing. Balanced and Readable say "praise", and Literal keeps "blessing".

decisions.choice: ainsi que sa langue (L), with no supplied verb
decisions.reason: One verb serves both nouns (m1). French "ainsi que" lets Literal keep the single verb without the bracketed word the English Literal needs.

decisions.choice: "즉시" (L) for Luke's word for "at once", kept apart from Mark's "곧"; "찬양하다" for blessing God
decisions.reason: Luke's word is a different Greek word from the one Mark repeats, which the Korean Mark renders "곧" at Literal; "즉시" keeps them apart. A person "blesses" God by praising and thanking him (meaning decision), which Korean says with "찬양하다"; "축복하다" is used of giving blessing to someone below.

decisions.choice: "chúc tụng" (L); "ca ngợi" (B); "ngợi khen" (R) for blessing God
decisions.reason: People do not give God a blessing; the meaning decision says they praise and thank him. Literal keeps "chúc tụng", the Bible word for blessing God (Mark 11:9).

source.text: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πάντας φόβος τοὺς περιοικοῦντας αὐτούς, καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ὀρεινῇ τῆς Ἰουδαίας διελαλεῖτο πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα, καὶ ἔθεντο πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν, λέγοντες· Τί ἄρα τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο ἔσται;

records.literal_gloss: And came upon all fear the [ones] living around them, and in all the hill country of the Judea were being talked about all the words these, \v 66 and put all the [ones] having heard in the heart of them, saying, What then the child this will be?

en.L: And fear came upon all who lived around them, and in all the hill country of Judea all these words were being talked about, \v 66 and all who heard [them] laid [them] up in their heart, saying, "What then will this child be?"
en.B: Awe came over all their neighbors, and throughout the hill country of Judea people were talking about all these things. \v 66 Everyone who heard about them took them to heart and asked, "What then will this child turn out to be?"
en.R: All their neighbors were amazed, and filled with awe. People all through the hills of Judea were talking about what had happened. \v 66 Everyone who heard about it kept thinking about it. They asked, "What will this child become?"

es.L: Y vino temor sobre todos los que vivían alrededor de ellos, y en toda la región montañosa de Judea se comentaban todas estas palabras, \v 66 y todos los que [las] oyeron [las] pusieron en su corazón, diciendo: «Entonces, ¿qué llegará a ser este niño?».
es.B: Todos sus vecinos quedaron sobrecogidos, y por toda la región montañosa de Judea la gente hablaba de todas estas cosas. \v 66 Todos los que las oían se quedaban pensando en ellas y preguntaban: «¿Qué llegará a ser, pues, este niño?».
es.R: Todos sus vecinos se quedaron asombrados y llenos de reverencia. Por todas las montañas de Judea la gente hablaba de lo que había pasado. \v 66 Todos los que lo oían seguían pensando en ello. Se preguntaban: «¿Qué llegará a ser este niño?».

fr.L: Et la crainte vint sur tous ceux qui habitaient autour d’eux, et dans toute la région montagneuse de la Judée on s’entretenait de toutes ces paroles, \v 66 et tous ceux qui [les] entendirent [les] déposèrent dans leur cœur, disant : « Que sera donc cet enfant ? »
fr.B: Une crainte respectueuse saisit tous leurs voisins, et dans toute la région montagneuse de Judée, on parlait de tous ces événements. \v 66 Tous ceux qui en entendaient parler les prenaient à cœur et se demandaient : « Que deviendra donc cet enfant ? »
fr.R: Tous leurs voisins ont été très impressionnés et remplis de crainte devant Dieu. Partout dans les collines de Judée, les gens parlaient de ce qui s’était passé. \v 66 Tous ceux qui l’apprenaient y pensaient sans cesse. Ils se demandaient : « Qu’est-ce que cet enfant va devenir ? »

sw.L: Na hofu ikawajia wote walioishi karibu nao, na katika nchi yote ya milima ya Yudea maneno haya yote yalikuwa yakizungumzwa, \v 66 na wote walioyasikia wakayahifadhi moyoni mwao, wakisema, "Basi mtoto huyu atakuwa nini?"
sw.B: Majirani wao wote walijawa na hofu ya Mungu, na katika nchi yote ya milima ya Yudea watu walikuwa wakizungumza juu ya mambo haya yote. \v 66 Kila aliyeyasikia aliyatafakari moyoni mwake, akasema, "Basi mtoto huyu atakuwa mtu wa namna gani?"
sw.R: Majirani wao wote walishangaa na kujawa na hofu ya Mungu. Watu kote katika milima ya Yudea walikuwa wakizungumza juu ya yale yaliyotokea. \v 66 Kila aliyesikia habari hizo aliendelea kuzifikiria. Waliuliza, "Mtoto huyu atakuwa mtu wa namna gani?"

ko.L: 그리고 그들 주위에 사는 모든 사람에게 두려움이 임하였고, 유대의 온 산골에 이 모든 말들이 두루 퍼져 이야기되었다. \v 66 그리고 들은 사람들은 모두 [그것을] 마음에 두고 말했다. "그러면 이 아이가 무엇이 될까?"
ko.B: 이웃 사람들은 모두 경외감에 휩싸였고, 이 모든 일이 유대 산골 곳곳에서 화제가 되었다. \v 66 이 이야기를 들은 사람들은 모두 그것을 마음에 새기며 말했다. "이 아이가 장차 어떤 사람이 될까?"
ko.R: 이웃 사람들은 모두 놀랐고, 하나님께서 하신 일을 보고 두려운 마음이 들었다. 유대 산골 곳곳에서 사람들이 이 일에 대해 이야기했다. \v 66 이 이야기를 들은 사람들은 모두 그 일을 계속 생각하며 말했다. "이 아이가 커서 어떤 사람이 될까?"

vi.L: Và sự sợ hãi đến trên tất cả những người sống quanh họ, và khắp miền đồi núi Giu-đê người ta bàn tán về mọi điều này, \v 66 và tất cả những người nghe đều ghi nhớ trong lòng mình, mà nói: "Vậy đứa trẻ này sẽ ra sao?"
vi.B: Mọi người láng giềng đều kính sợ, và khắp miền đồi núi xứ Giu-đê, người ta bàn tán về mọi việc ấy. \v 66 Ai nghe cũng ghi nhớ trong lòng và hỏi: "Vậy rồi đứa trẻ này sẽ trở nên người thế nào đây?"
vi.R: Mọi người hàng xóm đều sững sờ và kính sợ. Khắp vùng đồi núi xứ Giu-đê, người ta bàn tán về những việc đã xảy ra. \v 66 Ai nghe chuyện ấy cũng cứ suy nghĩ mãi. Họ hỏi nhau: "Rồi đứa bé này sẽ trở thành người như thế nào?"

decisions.choice: fear: awe at God's work
decisions.reason: As in 1:12 and 5:26, people react with holy fear when God acts.

decisions.choice: all these words: all these events
decisions.reason: The noun means word or matter, as in 1:37-38 and 2:15, 19. Here it is the whole story of the birth and the naming.

decisions.choice: laid them up in their heart: kept them in mind and thought about them
decisions.reason: A Hebrew-style way of saying they treasured and pondered the events (compare 2:19, 51; 1 Samuel 21:12).

decisions.choice: awe (B); amazed, and filled with awe (R)
decisions.reason: In modern English "fear" sounds like terror. Balanced and Readable say what kind of fear it is.

decisions.choice: une crainte respectueuse (B); remplis de crainte devant Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: English Balanced says "awe", which French has no single everyday word for. French keeps "crainte", which unlike "peur" can mean reverence, and says what kind of fear it is (m1).

decisions.choice: hofu ya Mungu
decisions.reason: The fear here is awe at what God has done (meaning decision m1), not fright. "Hofu ya Mungu" says that, as the English says "awe"; Literal keeps plain "hofu".

decisions.choice: "kính sợ" for fear (B, R); "sự sợ hãi" (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says this is awe at God's work; "kính sợ" is fear mixed with reverence.

source.text: καὶ γὰρ χεὶρ κυρίου ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And for [the] hand of [the] Lord was with him.

en.L: For indeed [the] hand of [the] Lord was with him.
en.B: For the Lord's hand was clearly with him.
en.R: Everyone could see that the Lord was with him and was helping him.

es.L: Porque en verdad [la] mano del Señor estaba con él.
es.B: Porque era evidente que la mano del Señor estaba con él.
es.R: Todos podían ver que el Señor estaba con él y lo ayudaba.

fr.L: Car aussi la main du Seigneur était avec lui.
fr.B: Car il était évident que la main du Seigneur était avec lui.
fr.R: Tout le monde voyait bien que le Seigneur était avec lui et l’aidait.

sw.L: Kwa maana hakika mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa naye.
sw.B: Kwa maana ilikuwa wazi kwamba mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa naye.
sw.R: Kila mtu aliweza kuona kwamba Bwana alikuwa pamoja naye na kumsaidia.

ko.L: 참으로 주님의 손이 그와 함께 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 주님의 손길이 분명히 그와 함께하고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 주님께서 그 아이와 함께하시며 그를 돕고 계신다는 것을 누구나 알 수 있었다.

vi.L: Vì quả thật tay của Chúa ở cùng nó.
vi.B: Vì rõ ràng tay Chúa ở cùng đứa trẻ.
vi.R: Ai cũng thấy rằng Chúa ở cùng đứa bé và giúp đỡ bé.

decisions.choice: the hand of the Lord: God's power at work, guiding and protecting
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of God's power with his servants (Acts 11:21; Ezra 7:6).

decisions.choice: for the hand of the Lord was with him: Luke's own comment
alternatives: the end of what the people said
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT ends the people's question with a question mark and begins a new sentence. It explains why they asked: God's hand was plainly on the child. The comment covers John's whole life, as 1:80 goes on to show.

decisions.choice: clearly
decisions.reason: "And for" gives a strong reason: it was evident. Balanced says so with "clearly".

source.text: Καὶ Ζαχαρίας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐπλήσθη πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ ἐπροφήτευσεν λέγων·

records.literal_gloss: And Zechariah the father of him was filled of Spirit Holy and prophesied saying,

en.L: And Zechariah his father was filled with [the] Holy Spirit and prophesied, saying,
en.B: Then his father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke this prophecy:
en.R: Then John's father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit. He gave this message from God:

es.L: Y Zacarías, su padre, fue llenado del Espíritu Santo y profetizó, diciendo:
es.B: Entonces su padre Zacarías fue lleno del Espíritu Santo y pronunció esta profecía:
es.R: Entonces Zacarías, el padre de Juan, fue lleno del Espíritu Santo. Dio este mensaje de parte de Dios:

fr.L: Et Zacharie son père fut rempli de l’Esprit Saint et prophétisa, disant :
fr.B: Alors Zacharie, son père, fut rempli de l’Esprit Saint et prononça cette prophétie :
fr.R: Alors Zacharie, le père de Jean, a été rempli de l’Esprit Saint. Il a transmis ce message de Dieu :

sw.L: Na Zakaria baba yake alijazwa Roho Mtakatifu, akatabiri akisema,
sw.B: Kisha baba yake Zakaria akajazwa Roho Mtakatifu, akatamka unabii huu:
sw.R: Kisha Zakaria, baba yake Yohana, akajazwa Roho Mtakatifu. Akatoa ujumbe huu kutoka kwa Mungu:

ko.L: 그리고 그의 아버지 사가랴가 성령으로 충만하여 예언하며 말했다.
ko.B: 그때 아이의 아버지 사가랴가 성령으로 충만하여 이렇게 예언하였다.
ko.R: 그때 요한의 아버지 사가랴가 성령으로 가득 차서, 하나님께서 주신 이런 말씀을 전했다.

vi.L: Và Xa-cha-ri, cha nó, được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh và nói tiên tri rằng:
vi.B: Bấy giờ Xa-cha-ri, cha của đứa trẻ, được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh và nói lời tiên tri này:
vi.R: Bấy giờ Xa-cha-ri, cha của Giăng, được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh. Ông nói sứ điệp này từ Đức Chúa Trời:

decisions.choice: prophesied: spoke a message from God by the Spirit
decisions.reason: To prophesy is to speak for God. Zechariah's song praises God, explains what he is doing, and says what the child will do.

decisions.choice: gave this message from God
decisions.reason: Readable explains what prophesying is.

decisions.choice: "성령으로 충만하다" (L, B); "성령으로 가득 차다" (R), through Luke 1
decisions.reason: "충만하다" is the established word for being filled with the Spirit (1:15, 1:41, 1:67); Readable uses the plain native "가득 차다".

source.text: Εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, ὅτι ἐπεσκέψατο καὶ ἐποίησεν λύτρωσιν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤγειρεν κέρας σωτηρίας ἡμῖν ἐν οἴκῳ Δαυὶδ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ, καθὼς ἐλάλησεν διὰ στόματος τῶν ἁγίων ἀπ’ αἰῶνος προφητῶν αὐτοῦ, σωτηρίαν ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν μισούντων ἡμᾶς, ποιῆσαι ἔλεος μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ μνησθῆναι διαθήκης ἁγίας αὐτοῦ, ὅρκον ὃν ὤμοσεν πρὸς Ἀβραὰμ τὸν πατέρα ἡμῶν, τοῦ δοῦναι ἡμῖν ἀφόβως ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν ῥυσθέντας λατρεύειν αὐτῷ ἐν ὁσιότητι καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be the] Lord the God of the Israel, because he visited and did redemption for the people of him, \v 69 and raised a horn of salvation for us in [the] house of David servant of him, \v 70 as he spoke through [the] mouth of the holy from [the] age prophets of him, \v 71 salvation from enemies of us and from [the] hand of all the [ones] hating us, \v 72 to do mercy with the fathers of us and to remember covenant holy of him, \v 73 [the] oath which he swore to Abraham the father of us, to give to us \v 74 fearlessly from [the] hand of enemies having been rescued to serve him \v 75 in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of us.

en.L: "Blessed [be the] Lord, the God of Israel, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has visited and accomplished redemption for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, \v 69 and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in [the] house of David {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, \v 70 as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke through [the] mouth of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy prophets from of old, \v 71 salvation from our enemies and from [the] hand of all who hate us, \v 72 to show mercy to our fathers and to remember {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy covenant, \v 73 [the] oath that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to Abraham our father, to grant us \v 74 that, rescued from [the] hand of [our] enemies, [we might] serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} without fear \v 75 in holiness and righteousness before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all our days.
en.B: "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has come to help {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and set them free. \v 69 He has raised up a mighty power to save us in the house of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant David, \v 70 as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised long ago through the mouth of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy prophets: \v 71 salvation from our enemies and from the grip of all who hate us. \v 72 So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has shown the mercy promised to our ancestors and remembered {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy covenant, \v 73 the oath {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} swore to our father Abraham: to grant us \v 74 that we, rescued from the hand of our enemies, might serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} without fear \v 75 in holiness and righteousness before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all our days.
en.R: "Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to help {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and has set them free. \v 69 He has given us a mighty king from the family of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant David, to save us. \v 70 Long ago {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised this through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy prophets. \v 71 He promised to save us from our enemies and from all who hate us. \v 72 He promised to be kind to our ancestors and to remember {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy covenant. \v 73 He made a promise with an oath to our father Abraham. \v 74 He promised to rescue us from our enemies, so that we could serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} without fear, \v 75 and live holy and righteous lives before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} every day we live.

es.L: «Bendito [sea el] Señor, el Dios de Israel, porque ha visitado y ha realizado la redención para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, \v 69 y ha levantado un cuerno de salvación para nosotros en [la] casa de David, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, \v 70 como habló por [la] boca de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos profetas desde antiguo, \v 71 salvación de nuestros enemigos y de [la] mano de todos los que nos odian, \v 72 para mostrar misericordia a nuestros padres y recordar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto santo, \v 73 [el] juramento que juró a Abraham, nuestro padre, de concedernos \v 74 que, rescatados de [la] mano de [nuestros] enemigos, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirvamos sin temor \v 75 en santidad y justicia delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todos nuestros días.
es.B: «Bendito sea el Señor, el Dios de Israel, porque ha venido a ayudar a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y a darle libertad. \v 69 Ha hecho surgir para nosotros un gran poder para salvarnos en la casa de David, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, \v 70 como lo prometió hace mucho tiempo por boca de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos profetas: \v 71 salvación de nuestros enemigos y de las garras de todos los que nos odian. \v 72 Así ha mostrado la misericordia prometida a nuestros antepasados y se ha acordado de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo pacto, \v 73 el juramento que hizo a nuestro padre Abraham: concedernos \v 74 que, rescatados de la mano de nuestros enemigos, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirvamos sin temor \v 75 en santidad y justicia delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todos nuestros días.
es.R: «¡Alabado sea el Señor, el Dios de Israel! Ha venido a ayudar a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo y lo ha liberado. \v 69 Nos ha dado un rey poderoso de la familia de David, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, para salvarnos. \v 70 Hace mucho tiempo prometió esto por medio de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos profetas. \v 71 Prometió salvarnos de nuestros enemigos y de todos los que nos odian. \v 72 Prometió ser bondadoso con nuestros antepasados y acordarse de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo pacto. \v 73 Hizo una promesa con juramento a nuestro padre Abraham. \v 74 Prometió rescatarnos de nuestros enemigos, para que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirviéramos sin miedo \v 75 y viviéramos vidas santas y justas delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todos los días de nuestra vida.

fr.L: « Béni [soit] le Seigneur, le Dieu d’Israël, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a visité et accompli la rédemption de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, \v 69 et nous a suscité une corne de salut dans la maison de David {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, \v 70 comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a dit par la bouche de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints prophètes d’autrefois, \v 71 un salut [qui nous arrache] à nos ennemis et à la main de tous ceux qui nous haïssent, \v 72 pour faire miséricorde à nos pères et se souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte alliance, \v 73 du serment qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a juré à Abraham notre père, de nous accorder \v 74 que, délivrés de la main des ennemis, nous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servions sans crainte \v 75 dans la sainteté et la justice devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} tous nos jours.
fr.B: « Béni soit le Seigneur, le Dieu d’Israël, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est venu au secours de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et l’a libéré. \v 69 Il a fait se lever pour nous une puissance qui sauve, dans la maison de David, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, \v 70 comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait promis depuis longtemps par la bouche de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints prophètes : \v 71 un salut qui nous arrache à nos ennemis et à l’emprise de tous ceux qui nous haïssent. \v 72 Ainsi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a montré la miséricorde promise à nos ancêtres et s’est souvenu de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte alliance, \v 73 du serment qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait fait à notre père Abraham : nous accorder \v 74 qu’une fois délivrés de la main de nos ennemis, nous puissions {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir sans crainte, \v 75 dans la sainteté et la justice, en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence, tous les jours de notre vie.
fr.R: « Louons le Seigneur, le Dieu d’Israël ! Il est venu au secours de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a libéré. \v 69 Il nous a donné un roi puissant, de la famille de David, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, pour nous sauver. \v 70 Il y a longtemps, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait promis par {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} saints prophètes. \v 71 Il avait promis de nous sauver de nos ennemis et de tous ceux qui nous détestent. \v 72 Il avait promis d’être bon pour nos ancêtres et de se souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte alliance. \v 73 Il avait fait un serment à notre père Abraham. \v 74 Il avait promis de nous délivrer de nos ennemis, pour que nous puissions {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir sans avoir peur, \v 75 et vivre d’une manière sainte et juste devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, chaque jour de notre vie.

sw.L: "Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa kuwa amewatembelea na kuwafanyia ukombozi watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \v 69 na ametuinulia pembe ya wokovu katika nyumba ya Daudi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \v 70 kama alivyosema kupitia kinywa cha manabii {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu tangu zamani, \v 71 wokovu kutoka kwa adui zetu na kutoka mkononi mwa wote wanaotuchukia, \v 72 kuwatendea baba zetu huruma na kulikumbuka agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu, \v 73 kiapo alichomwapia Ibrahimu baba yetu, kutujalia \v 74 kwamba, tukiwa tumeokolewa kutoka mkononi mwa adui [zetu], tumtumikie bila hofu \v 75 katika utakatifu na haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} siku zetu zote.
sw.B: "Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa maana amekuja kuwasaidia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kuwaweka huru. \v 69 Ametuinulia nguvu kuu ya kutuokoa katika nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Daudi, \v 70 kama alivyoahidi zamani kupitia kinywa cha manabii {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu: \v 71 wokovu kutoka kwa adui zetu na kutoka katika mkono wa wote wanaotuchukia. \v 72 Hivyo ameonyesha huruma aliyowaahidi babu zetu na kulikumbuka agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu, \v 73 kiapo alichomwapia baba yetu Ibrahimu: kutujalia \v 74 kwamba sisi, tukiisha kuokolewa kutoka mkononi mwa adui zetu, tumtumikie bila hofu \v 75 katika utakatifu na haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} siku zetu zote.
sw.R: "Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, asifiwe! Amekuja kuwasaidia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, naye amewaweka huru. \v 69 Ametupa mfalme mwenye nguvu kutoka katika jamaa ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Daudi, ili atuokoe. \v 70 Zamani sana aliahidi jambo hili kupitia manabii {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu. \v 71 Aliahidi kutuokoa kutoka kwa adui zetu na kutoka kwa wote wanaotuchukia. \v 72 Aliahidi kuwahurumia babu zetu na kulikumbuka agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu. \v 73 Alimwahidi baba yetu Ibrahimu kwa kiapo. \v 74 Aliahidi kutuokoa kutoka kwa adui zetu, ili tumtumikie bila hofu, \v 75 na kuishi maisha matakatifu na ya haki mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kila siku ya maisha yetu.

ko.L: "찬양받으실 분, 주 이스라엘의 하나님! 그분께서 그분의 백성을 찾아오셔서 속량을 이루셨기 때문이다. \v 69 그리고 우리를 위하여 그분의 종 다윗의 집에 구원의 뿔을 일으키셨다. \v 70 예로부터 그분의 거룩한 예언자들의 입을 통하여 말씀하신 대로이다. \v 71 [그것은] 우리 원수들에게서, 그리고 우리를 미워하는 모든 사람의 손에서 [건지시는] 구원이다. \v 72 [이는] 우리 조상들에게 자비를 베푸시고 그분의 거룩한 언약을 기억하시려는 것이다. \v 73 [그 언약은] 그분께서 우리 조상 아브라함에게 하신 맹세이니, 우리에게 허락하시려는 것이었다. \v 74 우리가 원수들의 손에서 건짐을 받아 두려움 없이 그분을 섬기되, \v 75 우리의 모든 날 동안 그분 앞에서 거룩함과 의로 [섬기게 하시려는 것이다].
ko.B: "이스라엘의 하나님이신 주님을 찬양하여라! 그분께서 그분의 백성을 찾아와 도우시고 그들을 자유롭게 하셨다. \v 69 그분의 종 다윗의 집안에서 우리를 구원할 강한 능력을 일으키셨다. \v 70 이것은 오래전에 그분께서 거룩한 예언자들의 입을 통하여 약속하신 그대로이다. \v 71 곧 우리를 원수들에게서, 우리를 미워하는 모든 사람의 손아귀에서 구원하시겠다는 약속이다. \v 72 이렇게 그분께서는 우리 조상들에게 약속하신 자비를 베푸시고, 그분의 거룩한 언약을 기억하셨다. \v 73 그 언약은 우리 조상 아브라함에게 하신 맹세였다. 그분께서 우리에게 허락하시겠다고 하신 것은 \v 74 우리가 원수들의 손에서 구원받아 두려움 없이 그분을 섬기는 것, \v 75 평생 그분 앞에서 거룩하고 의롭게 섬기는 것이다.
ko.R: "이스라엘의 하나님이신 주님을 찬양하여라! 그분은 그분의 백성을 도우러 오셨고, 그들을 자유롭게 하셨다. \v 69 그분은 그분의 종 다윗의 집안에서 우리를 구원할 강한 왕을 보내 주셨다. \v 70 오래전에 그분은 거룩한 예언자들을 통해 이것을 약속하셨다. \v 71 우리를 원수들에게서, 우리를 미워하는 모든 사람에게서 구원해 주시겠다고 약속하셨다. \v 72 우리 조상들에게 자비를 베푸시고, 그분의 거룩한 언약을 기억하시겠다고 약속하셨다. \v 73 그분은 우리 조상 아브라함에게 맹세하며 약속하셨다. \v 74 우리를 원수들에게서 구해 주셔서, 우리가 두려움 없이 그분을 섬기게 하시겠다고 약속하셨다. \v 75 우리가 사는 날 동안 날마다 그분 앞에서 거룩하고 의롭게 살게 하시겠다는 것이다.
